SpikePy/Minesweeper.readme:
# 💣 Minesweeper

Classic Minesweeper in a single HTML file — no build step, no dependencies, works on desktop and mobile. Available in English and German.

**Play it:** https://spikepy.github.io/Minesweeper

## Features

- Three presets: Beginner (9×9, 10 mines), Intermediate (16×16, 40), Expert (30×16, 99)
- Custom boards up to 50×30
- No guessing: the first click is always safe and opens an area, and from there every cell can be worked out from the numbers (and the mine counter). The board is generated around your first click. Only extremely dense custom boards may still need a guess; the game says so
- Seeds: every game shows a short seed such as `B-K3F9QX` (level + 6 characters). Together with the cell you click first it fully describes the board: enter the seed and click the same first cell to replay exactly that board, including custom boards (`C20x12x35-K3F9QX`). Seeds from before the no-guess change give different boards now. Replays don't count for best times, and each best time stores the seed it was set with
- Chording: click a number with the matching number of flags to open all its neighbours
- Touch support: long-press to flag, or switch on the 🚩 button so that taps set and remove flags
- Shared high-score list: the 5 best times per difficulty with player name and seed, stored online in [Supabase](https://supabase.com) so it is the same on every device. Without Supabase configured, or when offline, the list is kept in the browser instead
- Automatic light and dark theme
- Installable as an app (PWA): on Android use the 📲 button or *Install app* in the Chrome menu, on iOS *Share → Add to Home Screen*, on desktop the install icon in the address bar. It then runs standalone without browser bars and also works offline (high scores need a connection)
- English and German interface: follows the browser language, switchable with the DE/EN toggle in the top right corner

## Controls

| Action | Mouse | Touch | Keyboard |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Open a cell | Left click | Tap | |
| Flag a cell (again: remove flag) | Right click | Long press / 🚩 mode | |
| Open neighbours (chord) | Click a number | Tap a number | |
| New game | Click the face, or the board once the game is over | Tap the face, or the board once the game is over | `R` or `F2` |
| Toggle 🚩 mode | | Tap 🚩 | `F` |
| Replay a board | Enter a seed and press ▶ | | `Enter` in the seed field |

## Shared high scores (one-time setup)

The game stays a static page on GitHub Pages; the browser talks to Supabase directly.

1. Create a free project at [supabase.com](https://supabase.com).
2. In the dashboard open **SQL Editor**, paste [`supabase/setup.sql`](supabase/setup.sql) and run it. It creates the `scores` table and allows visitors only to read scores and add new ones.
3. Under **Project Settings → API** copy the project URL and the publishable (anon) key into `SUPABASE_URL` and `SUPABASE_KEY` in `index.html`. That key is meant to be public.

Note: like any leaderboard in a static page, scores are submitted by the browser and can be faked by someone determined. Entries can be removed in the Supabase table editor.

## Run locally

Open `index.html` in any browser. That's it.

Installing and offline mode need the page served over HTTP(S), e.g. `python3 -m http.server` and then http://localhost:8000.

korniychukg-sudo/metacritic-games-servic.readme:
# Metacritic Games Digest

Сервис раз в час берёт с Metacritic (раздел Games) 20 новых игр, которые сегодня ещё не обрабатывал, и сохраняет
их в свою базу или обновляет уже известные. Для каждой игры он пишет отдельные резюме отзывов критиков и игроков,
находит самый популярный летсплей на YouTube, переводит речь блогера в текст и делает по нему заключение со ссылкой
на ролик. В веб-интерфейсе есть список с фильтрами, карточка игры с похожими играми, мониторинг в реальном времени
и кнопка принудительного запуска. Тестовое задание на позицию AI Automation Engineer; работает без единого секрета.

## Результат

- **Репозиторий:** https://github.com/korniychukg-sudo/metacritic-games-service
- **Работающий сервис:** https://web-production-0b15b.up.railway.app, мониторинг и кнопка запуска:
  https://web-production-0b15b.up.railway.app/monitor (Railway, volume `/data`, стартовые данные из снимка
  `seed/games.db`, дальше обработка раз в час).
- **Переписка с нейросетью:** [docs/ai-log/](docs/ai-log/README.md): по каждому агенту промпт, ход работы
  и итоговый ответ, а в [docs/ai-log/raw/](docs/ai-log/raw/) полные транскрипты в raw JSONL. Сервис собран
  конвейером агентов Claude Code: разведка, реализация, независимые ревью, исправления.
- **Важно про YouTube на сервере.** С IP дата-центров YouTube отдаёт поиск, но блокирует субтитры и аудио
  («Sign in to confirm you're not a bot», проверено из контейнера Railway). Поэтому полные расшифровки
  летсплеев в демо получены локальными прогонами (они в стартовом снимке), а новые игры на сервере получают
  ролик и пересказ его описания с честной пометкой. Полная расшифровка на сервере включается через
  `YOUTUBE_PROXY_URL`.

| Список игр | Карточка игры | Мониторинг |
|---|---|---|
| ![Список игр с фильтром по платформе](docs/screenshots/list.jpg) | ![Карточка игры](docs/screenshots/card.jpg) | ![Мониторинг во время запуска](docs/screenshots/monitor.jpg) |

## Как проверить за пять минут

1. Главная страница: поиск по названию (`dragons dogma`, `warhammer 40000`), фильтр по платформе (оценки
   в карточках переключаются на выбранную платформу), сортировка по Metascore и Userscore.
2. Карточка любой игры: платформы с обеими оценками, разработчик, описание, видео, резюме критиков и игроков,
   блок «Летсплей на YouTube» (откуда взят текст, какие более популярные ролики пропущены и почему,
   цитаты блогера), похожие игры по клику.
3. `/monitor`: воркеры, счётчики, история запусков с источником (New Releases или страница SEE ALL),
   живой журнал и кнопка «Запустить обработку сейчас» (после запуска пауза 5 минут с обратным отсчётом).

## Требования задания и где их смотреть

| Требование | Где видно | Код |
|---|---|---|
| Раз в час 20 новых игр | `/monitor`: «Следующий запуск», история запусков | `app/scheduler.py` |
| Сначала New Releases, потом SEE ALL по страницам, новый день заново | `/monitor`: колонка «Источник», плитка курсора | `app/selection.py`, таблица `day_state` |
| Сегодня не обрабатывал; добавить или обновить | `/monitor`: «Обработано сегодня»; в карточке «обработок: N» | таблица `processed`, `Database.upsert_game` |
| Название, обложка, разработчик, описание, ссылка на видео | карточка игры | `app/metacritic.py` |
| Все платформы с Metascore и Userscore | карточка: таблица «Оценки по платформам» | `app/metacritic.py` |
| Резюме: что нравится и что нет, отдельно критики и игроки, обновляется | карточка: «Что говорят критики/игроки» | `app/summarize.py` |
| Список, карточка, фильтр по платформам, поиск, сортировка по рейтингу | главная страница | `app/main.py`, `app/db.py` |
| Похожие игры из базы, клик открывает карточку | карточка: «Похожие игры» | `app/similarity.py` |
| Доп. 1: самый популярный летсплей, речь в текст, заключение со ссылкой | карточка: «Летсплей на YouTube» | `app/youtube.py`, `app/stt.py`, `app/pipeline.py` |
| Доп. 2: мониторинг в реальном времени и кнопка запуска | `/monitor` | `app/monitor.py`, `app/main.py`, `app/static/app.js` |

colakang/player-highlights.desc: Local basketball player highlights from game videos by jersey number & colour (Apple Silicon; Claude Code / Codex skill)
colakang/player-highlights.readme:
# player-highlights

Find one basketball player in your game videos — by **jersey number and colour** — and get, automatically:

- 🎬 **Highlight reel** – the player's possessions, passes and shots; original framing and/or a follow-cam zoom
  (1.2× / 1.6× / 2.0×), with clip times, a running game clock, transitions and a stats card at the end
- 📼 **Full on-court cut** – every stretch the player was on the court
- ⏱️ **Minutes played** – quarters or halves, stopped or running clock
- ✂️ **Editable clip list** – nudge, drop or add clips with one line of text

Everything runs **locally on an Apple Silicon Mac**. No footage is uploaded anywhere.

## The easy way: ask your AI assistant

Open **Claude Code** or **Codex** and paste:

> Install https://github.com/colakang/player-highlights and make highlights of my kid (number __, __ jersey) from the videos in ~/Movies/game1

The assistant installs everything, asks you a few questions (which file is which quarter, game format, zoom), runs it
in the background and tells you when your videos are ready. Problems or ideas? Just tell the assistant —
it can open an issue or a pull request for you.

## For AI assistants (Claude Code, Codex, …)

If a user asks you to install or use this repository:

1. **Check the machine**: macOS on Apple Silicon (`uname -m` = `arm64`); ~15 GB free disk for models plus ~6 GB
   temporary space per game. Intel Macs, Windows and Linux are not supported yet — tell the user.
2. **Install** (ask before installing Homebrew if it is missing — https://brew.sh):
   ```bash
   git clone https://github.com/colakang/player-highlights.git ~/player-highlights
   cd ~/player-highlights && ./setup.sh          # installs ffmpeg/uv via Homebrew if needed, Python env, models
   ```
   No API keys are needed. Optional: `./setup.sh --prefetch` downloads the vision models (~7 GB) up front.
3. **Use**: follow the skill [`.agents/skills/player-highlights/SKILL.md`](.agents/skills/player-highlights/SKILL.md)
   (also linked at `.claude/skills/`). It lists what to ask the user and how to run and report.
4. **Update** later with `git pull && ./setup.sh`.
5. **Report problems / suggest ideas**: with the user's OK, open an issue using the templates in `.github/`
   (`gh issue create --repo colakang/player-highlights`), including the output of `scripts/diag.sh`.
   Never attach videos, frames or screenshots — the players are minors; describe times instead (e.g. "Q3 09:51").
6. **Contribute code**: fork (`gh repo fork --clone`), branch, change, test with `pf.py` on a real game, then
   `gh pr create` following `.github/pull_request_template.md` (say how you measured the improvement).
   See [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md) for the code layout and rules.

## Requirements

- Mac with an Apple M-series chip (M1 or newer), 16 GB memory recommended
- ~15 GB disk for models; ~6 GB temporary per game (cleared automatically)
- Game videos: one file per quarter / half, or one full-game file. A steady camera and sharp video help a lot
  (4K, fast shutter, camera high and centred).

## Manual use (command line)

```bash
cd ~/player-highlights
.venv/bin/python pf.py \
  --videos ~/Movies/game1 \            # a folder (sorted by file name) or the files in game order
  --periods Q1,Q2,Q3,Q4 \              # one per file: Q1..Q4 / H1,H2 / FULL
  --format quarters:8:stop \           # quarters|halves|full : minutes per period : stop|running
  --number <your kid's number> --color <jersey colour> --name <label, e.g. 7_ALEX> \
  --zooms 1,1.6                        # 1 = original framing; any of 1.2 / 1.6 / 2.0
```

Results go to `~/Movies/player-highlights/<game folder>/` (change with `--out`, a network share works too):

| File | Content |
|---|---|
| `<name>_highlight.mp4` | highlight reel, original framing |
| `<name>_highlight_zoom1.6.mp4` | highlight reel, 1.6× follow-cam |
| `*_clips.txt` | clip list |
| `<name>_full_game.mp4` | full on-court cut |

About 40–60 minutes of processing per 15 minutes of video. Re-r

basildiana/wedding-maze-game.readme:
# Path to the Chuppah 💍

A romantic, wedding-themed 2D maze game that runs entirely in the browser. Two partners start in opposite corners of a randomly generated maze. Find the **wedding ring**, dodge the wedding chaos, and meet under the **chuppah** at the exact centre of the maze for the wedding kiss.

**Play:** https://basildiana.github.io/wedding-maze-game/

## Setup

1. **Choose your couple:** Woman & Man, Two Women, or Two Men.
2. **Choose a game mode:**
   - **Single Player:** you guide the first partner (WASD *or* Arrow keys) from the top-left corner. The second partner walks from the bottom-right corner to the chuppah on their own.
   - **2 Players (Co-op):** both partners are controlled at the same time and share lives.
     - **Player 1:** WASD (top-left partner)
     - **Player 2:** Arrow keys (bottom-right partner)

| Key | Action |
| --- | --- |
| W A S D | Player 1 (or the solo player) |
| Arrow keys | Player 2 (or the solo player) |
| P / Esc | Pause |
| M | Toggle sound |

On touch devices an on-screen D-pad controls Player 1.

## Rules

- There is exactly **one wedding ring** per level. It is **required**: the kiss can't happen until it has been collected. Picking it up gives **+500 points** and a 3-second golden shield.
- Collect **hearts** for +100 points each.
- Avoid the hazards — each hit costs one shared life (3 in total):
  - **Wedding guests** wander unpredictably (and sometimes stop to chat).
  - **Champagne corks** shoot out of bottles — watch for the bottle shaking.
  - **Alarm clocks** are safe until they shake and start ringing.
- The chuppah plaza at the centre is a **safe zone**.
- When both partners are under the chuppah with the ring, the kiss animation plays and the level is won. Each level gets bigger and faster; finishing a level restores one life.
- Score = hearts + ring + time bonus + lives bonus + level bonus. Your best score and setup choices are saved in your browser.

## Tech

- Vanilla HTML, CSS and JavaScript — no frameworks, no build step, no backend, no external requests.
- HTML5 `<canvas>` rendering; all art is drawn in code and all sounds are synthesised with the Web Audio API.
- Mazes are generated with a recursive backtracker plus a little "braiding" so there are multiple routes, with a 3×3 plaza opened at the centre for the chuppah.

## Run locally

Just open `index.html` in a browser.

## Files

- `index.html` — markup, HUD, setup screens and overlays
- `style.css` — wedding-palette styling
- `game.js` — maze generation, game loop, characters, collisions, hazards, particles and audio

Xalcker/SMSRecomp.readme:
# SMSRecomp

Recompilador estático de juegos de Sega Master System y Game Gear (EE. UU., NTSC), con la misma arquitectura que
[NESRecomp](https://github.com/Xalcker/NESRecomp), [GBRecomp](https://github.com/Xalcker/GBRecomp),
[GENRecomp](https://github.com/Xalcker/GENRecomp) y [NEORecomp](https://github.com/Xalcker/NEORecomp): tomará una
ROM y generará un proyecto C99 portable que se compila en un ejecutable nativo con SDL2. Será híbrido (código
recompilado más un intérprete Z80 de respaldo), sin datos de la ROM en el proyecto generado (valida su SHA1) y con
`difftest` para comprobar el código recompilado contra el intérprete.

Hay que clonar con el submódulo de retrorecomp, que trae el código que comparten los cinco recompiladores (el Z80,
`random_pad.h`, `trace_line.h`...): `git clone --recursive`, o `git submodule update --init` en un clon ya hecho. El
ZIP de GitHub no lo incluye.

**Estado: fases 0 a 6 de 8.** Recompila juegos de Master System y Game Gear a C99: `smsrecomp` genera un proyecto
que se compila en un ejecutable nativo, con el Z80 en código nativo y la ROM del usuario cargada al arrancar. Con el
intérprete, los juegos corren en la ventana `sms` o sin ella (`smsrun` y las herramientas comunes: `smstrace`,
`smsshot`, `smsaudio`, `smsramdump`, `smsbench`), con el contrato común de los cinco en verde. El proyecto generado
también se arma para el navegador (`make web`) y para Android (`make apk`), con el mando en pantalla. El plan completo
está en [docs/PLAN.md](docs/PLAN.md).

- **Recompilador:** el Z80 con el recompilador común (`z80_recomp.h`, el de GENRecomp y NEORecomp) por vistas (una
  página del mapper en una ranura), las heurísticas de tablas de saltos, la traza y el código que el juego copia a la
  RAM (con una guarda). `difftest` compara el recompilado con el intérprete cuadro a cuadro; los 15 juegos de prueba
  corren sin diferencias con el 99-100 % de los ciclos en código nativo.

- **Cartucho:** `.sms` y `.gg` (con o sin cabecera de copiador), la cabecera TMR SEGA con su suma (calculada como
  la BIOS), la de Codemasters y la SDSC, el mapper (Sega, Codemasters o ninguno) y el modelo con que correría el
  juego (Master System II o Game Gear, y el modo SMS del Game Gear).
- **Bus y E/S:** los mappers Sega y Codemasters con la RAM del cartucho (y su partida), los puertos del Master
  System y del Game Gear con su decodificación parcial, los mandos, la detección de consola de exportación y la
  Pausa por NMI. Arranca con el estado que deja la BIOS de EE. UU., sin necesitarla.
- **VDP:** el modo 4 completo (fondo con scroll y sus bloqueos, prioridad, sprites con su límite, zoom, desborde y
  colisión, 224 líneas), los modos gráficos del TMS9918, la CRAM de 12 bits y la pantalla de 160×144 del Game Gear;
  contadores V y H e interrupciones de cuadro y de línea, al ciclo de cada acceso a sus puertos, calibrados con el
  VDPTEST de FluBBa (todo Ok). ZEXDOC y ZEXALL pasan sus 79 pruebas.
- **Sonido:** el SN76489, el mismo de GENRecomp (retrorecomp/shared), con el estéreo del Game Gear.
- **Ventana `sms`:** la de los otros cuatro (menús, español e inglés, estados guardados, captura, mandos, pantalla
  táctil), con la consola a elegir (Master System o Game Gear) y los pixeles de 8:7 del televisor.
- **Z80:** el núcleo común de GENRecomp y NEORecomp (retrorecomp/shared), con la semántica de cada instrucción en
  un solo lugar (`z80_ops.h`) para el intérprete y el código generado, como el 68000 de GENRecomp. Pasa las
  1 604 000 [SingleStepTests](https://github.com/SingleStepTests/z80) por los dos caminos, con su decodificador
  y el ciclo de cada acceso a un puerto.

## Compilar

Los mismos paquetes que en NESRecomp, GBRecomp, GENRecomp y NEORecomp: compilador C99, `make`, `pkg-config` y SDL2
(para la ventana `sms`).

| Sistema | Paquetes |
|---|---|
| Windows | [MSYS2](https://www.msys2.org/) UCRT64: `pacman -S --needed make git unzip mingw-w64-ucrt-x86_64-gcc mingw-w64-ucrt-x86_64-pkgconf mingw-w64-ucrt-x86_64-S

gamboozino/ngbrecomp.desc: Ninja Gaiden Black (Xbox, 2005) statically recompiled into native Linux and Windows builds, drawn by its own Vulkan renderer. A steady 60 fps, widescreen and ultrawide, keyboard and mouse, Steam Deck ready. Bring your own copy of the game.
gamboozino/ngbrecomp.readme:
![Ninja Gaiden Black Recompiled](docs/images/banner.jpg)

# Ninja Gaiden Black Recompiled

**A PC port of Ninja Gaiden Black by static recompilation.**

A native Linux and Windows version of *Ninja Gaiden Black* (Xbox, 2005), made by statically
recompiling the game's own code to run directly on a PC — not an emulator. It draws with its own
Vulkan renderer, which takes over the game's Direct3D calls instead of emulating the Xbox GPU. It
plays at a steady 60 fps on modest hardware (including the Steam Deck) and adds PC options: higher
resolutions, widescreen and ultrawide, keyboard and mouse, rebindable controls and more.

**You need your own copy of the game.** This project contains none of the game's data (graphics,
sound, movies, text): on first start it asks for your disc image and installs the game from it. It is made for the **retail USA
release** (NTSC-U, title ID `5443000D`) and checks for it.

## Features

- Native Linux (AppImage) and Windows (x64) builds; Steam Deck friendly
- Render resolution up to 10x, anisotropic filtering, MSAA, sharper shadows
- 16:9, 16:10 and 21:9 as well as 4:3: the 3D fills the screen, the HUD goes to the screen's
  corners, menus keep the game's own 16:9 look
- Keyboard and mouse with key prompts in the game, rebindable controls for keyboard, mouse and
  controller, mouse support in the menus
- Skippable intros and movies, unlock-all options for difficulties and costumes, optional cheats
- Smooth frame pacing and low input latency; shaders prepared in the background (no first-time
  stutter)

## Getting started

### Linux and Steam Deck

1. Download `NinjaGaidenBlack-x86_64.AppImage` from the releases page and make it executable
   (`chmod +x`, or Properties → Allow executing).
2. Run it. On the first start a window asks for your copy of the game: a disc image (`.iso`, a full
   Redump dump, or the `.7z`/`.zip` it came in) or a folder of extracted files with `default.xbe`.
   The game is installed once (about 6 GB).
3. On a Steam Deck, add the AppImage to Steam (Add a Non-Steam Game) to play it in Game Mode, and
   choose 16:10 in the settings.

Needs a 64-bit Linux with glibc 2.35 or newer and a GPU with Vulkan 1.3 drivers.

### Windows

1. Download `NinjaGaidenBlack-windows-x64.zip` and extract it anywhere.
2. Run `NinjaGaidenBlack.exe` and choose your disc image as above.

Needs Windows 10 or 11 (64-bit) and a GPU with Vulkan 1.3 drivers.

### Where things are kept

| | Linux | Windows |
|---|---|---|
| Installed game, saves | `~/.local/share/NinjaGaidenBlack` | `%LOCALAPPDATA%\NinjaGaidenBlack` |
| Settings (`settings.ini`, `controls.ini`) | `~/.config/NinjaGaidenBlack` | `%APPDATA%\NinjaGaidenBlack` |
| Shader cache | `~/.cache/NinjaGaidenBlack` | `%LOCALAPPDATA%\NinjaGaidenBlack\shaders` |
| Log | the terminal | `log.txt` beside the saves (or the console it was started from) |

## Settings

Everything is in the game's own menus: **RECOMP SETTINGS** on the main menu, and the **Settings** tab
of the pause menu. Changes apply at once and are saved.

- **Graphics**: render resolution (1x–10x), texture filtering (the console's, or 2x–16x
  anisotropic), anti-aliasing (MSAA), shadow resolution
- **Display**: aspect ratio (4:3, 16:9, 16:10, 21:9), window size, windowed / fullscreen /
  borderless, V-Sync (Off, On, Adaptive), frame-rate counter
- **Startup**: skip the warnings and intro movies, all difficulties from the start, all costumes
- **Cheats** (for the session only): infinite health, ninpo, essence; golden scarabs
- **Controls**: rebind every action (two keys or mouse buttons and a controller button each)

The game's own Options (sound, movie aspect, controller vibration and so on) are where they always
were.

## Controls

A controller works as on the Xbox. The keyboard and mouse can be used at any time — the game follows
whichever was touched last, and its button prompts change to match.

| Move | W A S D | | Camera | mouse (

Windows: preemption that Windows drops is tried again

The cause of "There's a problem with the disc you're using" on Windows
(issue #1). A guest thread is preempted by suspending it and pointing its
context at vcpu_win_trampoline. When the thread is suspended while Windows
is delivering it an exception, the new context can be dropped: the thread
never reaches the trampoline, `redirected` stays set, and redirect() then
refused every later attempt, while request_preempt() asked only once
anyway.

Harlock123/AVADKongJr.readme:
# AVA DKong Jr

[![Build](https://github.com/Harlock123/AVADKongJr/actions/workflows/build.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/Harlock123/AVADKongJr/actions/workflows/build.yml)

A vine-climbing rescue game in the style of Nintendo's 1982 arcade game **Donkey Kong Jr.**, built with
.NET 10 and Avalonia UI. The Keeper has locked Papa, the big ape, in a cage. His son Kip climbs to the
rescue through a jungle of vines over the water, a hideout of live wires and sliding platforms, and a
wall of chains with the six keys to Papa's cage. The characters are this game's own, and Papa is the ape
from [AVAKong](https://github.com/Harlock123/AVAKong).

## Features

- **Climbing**:
  - **One vine or two:** with a hand on each of two vines, Kip climbs up quickly and slides down slowly. With one vine he climbs slowly and slides down fast.
  - **Changing vines:** press towards the vine beside him to take hold of both, and press again to let go with one hand. Letting go with one is how a Nipper on the other vine gets past him.
  - **Getting on and off:** he jumps to catch a vine, leaps from one vine to another, and climbs off the top onto the platform it hangs from.
  - **Falling:** slide off the bottom of a vine and he drops to whatever is below. That's fine if it's near, but a long fall, the water or the pit is the end of him.
- **Three stages to a level**:
  - **The Jungle:** start on the islands, climb up the vines and ledges to the key by Papa's cage. The Keeper sends Nippers along the top and down the vines. Red ones patrol up and down, and blue ones crawl down and drop off the bottom.
  - **The Hideout:** ride a sliding platform over the pit, climb a wire, and leap for the pair of wires that lead to the top. Sparks run up and down the wires, and Squawkers fly across dropping eggs.
  - **The Keys:** six chains, each with a key. Climb up under a key to push it up its chain into Papa's cage lock. Let go, and it slides back down. Lock all six and Papa is free. Red Nippers patrol the chains and Squawkers fly across.
  - **Going round again:** after the Keys the next level starts, faster and with a bigger bonus.
- **Fruit** hangs on the vines. Touch it and it drops, crushing every Nipper, Spark or bird in its way: 400 for the first, 800 for the next, then 1,200, and so on.
- **Scoring**:
  - **Jumping over things:** jump over a Nipper or a Spark on a platform for 100.
  - **The bonus:** it counts down by 100 every two seconds. Finish the stage to bank what's left. If it reaches nothing, Kip is lost.
  - **Keys:** 200 for each one locked.
  - **Extra life:** one at 10,000 and every 40,000 after that.
- **Sound**:
  - **The music:** a jaunty swing for the stages and a lazy jungle stroll for the title, both new.
  - **The effects:** jumps, grabs, the patter of climbing, the Keeper's whip, Sparks crackling, Squawkers, eggs, fruit dropping and landing, keys clicking into their locks, splashes and a fanfare for Papa's freedom.
  - All of it is synthesised and mixed by OpenAL.
- **Attract mode**: leave the title alone for 15 seconds and a computer Kip plays.
  - **Routes:** it knows a way up each stage and follows it from wherever it finds itself.
  - **Vines:** it holds a pair where it can and lets go of one to let a Nipper by. It waits for a vine to be clear before leaping, and won't climb out at the top into something walking past.
  - **Avoiding trouble:** it steps out from under eggs and jumps whatever comes along the platform.
- **A top-ten high-score table** with arcade-style initials entry. It records the level reached.
- **Gamepads** through SDL2, as well as the keyboard.
- **Any window size**: the screen scales to fit, letterboxed. **Ctrl+S** saves a screenshot.
- **One self-contained executable** per platform: Windows, macOS and Linux on Intel/AMD and ARM.

georstar/DuckHuntGame.readme:
# Duck Hunt

A classic-style Duck Hunt game for the browser. It uses plain HTML5 Canvas and JavaScript, with no dependencies and no build step.

## Play

Open `index.html` in a browser, or serve the folder:

```sh
python3 -m http.server 8000   # then visit http://localhost:8000
```

## Home screen

- **New game · 1 duck / 2 ducks**: one duck per wave (10 waves) or two at once (5 waves). Either way, a round has 10 ducks.
- **Score history**: your last 100 games with date, mode, difficulty, round reached, accuracy and score, plus overall stats.
- **Settings**: sound on/off, volume, art style (classic vector or pixel art), difficulty (easy/normal/hard), crosshair color, fullscreen.

## How to play

- Aim with the mouse (or tap on touch screens) and click to shoot. You get 3 shots per wave.
- Hit the required number of ducks (blue bar) to advance; it rises in later rounds.
- Black ducks score 500, blue 1000, red 1500, multiplied by the round number. A perfect round (10/10) gives +10000.
- `P` / `Esc` pause (resume, settings, quit) · `M` mute. The game pauses when you switch tabs.

Settings and history are saved in your browser (localStorage).

# Underneath **An idle game about hidden worlds that keep working while nobody watches.** [![Play in the browser](https://img.shields.io/badge/play-in%20the%20browser-6e56cf?style=for-the-badge)](https://mundaplus.github.io/Underneath/) [![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-blue.svg)](LICENSE) ![TypeScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/TypeScript-3178c6?logo=typescript&logoColor=white) ![Vite](https://img.shields.io/badge/Vite-646cff?logo=vite&logoColor=white) ![No backend](https://img.shields.io/badge/backend-none-lightgrey) ![Fungal Network](docs/screenshots/fungal.webp)
## About Underneath is an incremental (idle) game engine with plug-in themes. Each theme uses the same rules but has its own world, text and art. Three themes are ready: | Theme | What you do | |---|---| | 🍄 **Fungal Network** | You are a mycelium under a forest floor | | ⚙️ **Clockwork Afterlife Bureau** | You run the paperwork office of the underworld | | 🌙 **Dream Weaver** | You harvest the dreams of a sleeping city, by night | Play it at **https://mundaplus.github.io/Underneath/** on a PC or a phone. No account and no install. The game saves in your browser. ## Features - **Two resources in balance.** Two resources pull against each other. Their ratio puts you in a zone with bonuses or penalties. - **A map to claim.** Claim tiles next to your network. Special terrain gives bonuses or unlocks generators. - **Generators and upgrades.** Generators produce every second. Upgrades multiply production, make clicks stronger or make tiles cheaper. - **Prestige.** Reset the run for a permanent currency and spend it in a shop. Each run gets a new random map. - **Time cycle.** A theme can add a repeating cycle, such as night and day, that changes production. - **Offline progress.** The game calculates up to 8 hours of progress while you are away. It saves every 15 seconds. - **Plug-in themes.** A theme is content, a renderer and CSS. The engine does not change. ## Screenshots | Clockwork Afterlife Bureau | Dream Weaver | |---|---| | ![Clockwork Afterlife Bureau](docs/screenshots/clockwork.webp) | ![Dream Weaver](docs/screenshots/dream.webp) | Pick the theme in **Options**, or open the game with `?theme=clockwork` or `?theme=dream`. Each theme has its own save.
Theme details ### Fungal Network | Engine term | Fungal Network | |---|---| | Resources | Nutrients (decay), Sugar (symbiosis), Spores (prestige) | | Generators | Growths: Hyphal Tip … Saprotroph Mat (decay), Root Handshake … Ancient Grove Pact (symbiosis) | | Balance | Forest Health: Rot Bloom, Hungry Soil, Harmony, Lush Canopy, Starved Ground | | Map | Forest Floor: leaf litter, fallen logs, oak roots, Mother Trees, streams, stone, bedrock | | Prestige | Fruiting: release spores into a new forest | Decay growths cost sugar, and symbiosis growths cost nutrients. You need both sides. ### Clockwork Afterlife Bureau | Engine term | Clockwork Afterlife Bureau | |---|---| | Resources | Paperwork (order), Favors (chaos), Seniority (prestige) | | Generators | Staff: Junior Clerk … Grand Difference Engine (order), Restless Ghost … Department of Exceptions (chaos) | | Balance | Office Climate: Total Paralysis, By the Book, Running Like Clockwork, Lax Oversight, Ghostly Anarchy | | Map | Bureau Floor, drawn as a blueprint: desk pools, filing rooms, break rooms, back rooms, Forbidden Archives, Great Clock Rooms, tube junctions, walls, the Void | | Prestige | Audit: move to a new building with more seniority | ### Dream Weaver | Engine term | Dream Weaver | |---|---| | Resources | Reverie (sweet dreams), Dread (nightmares), Lucidity (prestige) | | Generators | Dreamcraft: Sandman's Apprentice … Cradle of Stars (sweet), Shadow Under the Bed … The Recurring Nightmare (dark) | | Balance | Sleep Quality: Saccharine Haze, Pleasant Drift, Deep Sleep, Restless Night, Night Terrors | | Cycle | Night and Day, 4 minutes: Deep

arKharashi/mergeup.readme:
# MergeUp **Learn git the way teams use it: by joining one.** A free browser game in English and Arabic. You're the new hire on a small dev team: take tasks from your team lead, answer their questions, and ship your work in a terminal that behaves like real git. ### [▶ Play now](https://arkharashi.github.io/mergeup/)  ·  [اقرأ بالعربي](README.ar.md) [![Build and deploy](https://github.com/arKharashi/mergeup/actions/workflows/deploy.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/arKharashi/mergeup/actions/workflows/deploy.yml) [![MIT license](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-2ea043)](LICENSE) ![React 19](https://img.shields.io/badge/React-19-149eca?logo=react&logoColor=white) ![TypeScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/TypeScript-5.9-3178c6?logo=typescript&logoColor=white) ![Vite](https://img.shields.io/badge/Vite-8-646cff?logo=vite&logoColor=white)
![MergeUp on a desktop: the task and team chat on the left, the terminal in the middle, the project's files on the right](docs/screenshots/desktop-en.png) ## Why Most developers learn git alone: `add`, `commit`, `push`, done. The hard parts only show up in a team: reading other people's history, keeping commits clean enough to review, not pushing secrets, and later branches, conflicts and code review. MergeUp puts you in that team. You join the developers behind Bun, a Saudi specialty coffee shop's website, and every mistake has a consequence you can learn from instead of ending the game. ## What you learn | Level | Rank | You practise | | --- | --- | --- | | 1 · First day | Intern | Clone the team's repo, edit a file, then `add`, `commit` and `push`. A vague commit message costs reputation. | | 2 · Project history | Intern | Read the history with `git log` and `git show` to answer your team lead's questions. | | 3 · Tidy commits | Intern | Split three changes into three commits, keep a password file out with `.gitignore`, and undo a commit with `git reset`. | | 4–16 | Junior → Team Lead | Designed, and next to build: branches, merge conflicts, pull requests and code review, then `stash`, `revert`, `cherry-pick`, `rebase`, and leading the team. | ## Features - **Real git, in the browser.** `clone`, `status`, `add`, `restore`, `reset`, `rm`, `commit` (with `--amend`), `log`, `show`, `diff`, `fetch`, `pull` and `push` print the same messages as git itself. The shell has `cd`, `ls`, `cat`, `echo` with `>` and `>>`, `&&` chains, quotes, history and Tab completion. - **A team that reacts.** Your team lead explains the why behind every rule. A vague commit message, a pushed password or two tasks in one commit all cost reputation and stars, and more teammates join in the later ranks. - **Teaching, not just checking.** Coaching tips explain each mistake, every level has three tiers of hints, and you can rewind a level at any time. - **English and Arabic.** Every line of copy exists in both, and the whole layout mirrors between left-to-right and right-to-left. - **Designed with care.** An Apple-style layout with iMessage-style chat and a macOS Terminal window, in GitHub's colors, in light and dark mode, on phones, tablets and desktops. - **No account, no server.** It's a static site, and your progress stays in your browser.

(React)"] -- "game.run(line)" --> G["Game
levels, objectives,
reputation, chat"] G -- "runLine" --> E["Engine
git + shell simulator"] E -- "reads and writes" --> W[("World
team repo, your clone,
files")] E -- "onCommit, onPush" --> G G -- "subscribe / getVersion" --> U[

# Tetris

Implementación del clásico **Tetris** en JavaScript vanilla, usando HTML5 Canvas y CSS. Sin dependencias externas, sin frameworks, sin proceso de build: solo abrir y jugar.

![Tech](https://img.shields.io/badge/HTML5-Canvas-orange)
![Tech](https://img.shields.io/badge/CSS3-blueviolet)
![Tech](https://img.shields.io/badge/JavaScript-Vanilla-yellow)

---

## Tabla de contenidos

- [Tetris](#tetris)
  - [Tabla de contenidos](#tabla-de-contenidos)
  - [Qué hace el proyecto](#qué-hace-el-proyecto)
  - [Cómo ejecutar el juego](#cómo-ejecutar-el-juego)
    - [Opción 1: abrir el archivo directamente](#opción-1-abrir-el-archivo-directamente)
    - [Opción 2: servidor local (recomendado)](#opción-2-servidor-local-recomendado)
  - [Controles](#controles)
  - [Cómo funciona](#cómo-funciona)
    - [1. `index.html`](#1-indexhtml)
    - [2. `style.css`](#2-stylecss)
    - [3. `game.js`](#3-gamejs)
    - [Flujo del juego](#flujo-del-juego)
  - [Tecnologías](#tecnologías)
  - [Estructura del proyecto](#estructura-del-proyecto)
  - [Personalización](#personalización)
  - [Licencia](#licencia)

---

## Qué hace el proyecto

Es una versión jugable del Tetris clásico con todas las mecánicas que esperarías:

- Tablero de **10 × 20** celdas.
- Las **7 piezas estándar** (I, O, T, S, Z, J, L) con colores diferenciados.
- Una **pieza reto, la Tuerca**: un anillo 3×3 con el centro vacío que aparece con poca frecuencia (~5%).
- **Habilidades cargables**: limpiar líneas llena la barra de energía (1 línea: 20, 2: 40, 3: 70, 4: 100). Con la barra llena, `E` abre un menú (el juego se detiene) y la habilidad elegida gasta toda la barra: ver las siguientes 5 piezas (10 s), intercambiar la pieza actual por una de 3 opciones, ralentizar la caída 10 s o deshacer la última colocación (solo una; no devuelve energía). El Hold no está en este menú: siempre está disponible con `C` / `Shift`. Si una habilidad no es posible (p. ej. la pieza no cabe) no se consume la energía.
- **Pentominós** (`+`, `U`, `Y`): piezas de 5 bloques que aparecen ocasionalmente (~3% cada una).
- **Pieza 1×1 de recompensa**: tras limpiar 4 líneas a la vez (Tetris), la siguiente pieza generada es un bloque único.
- **Power-ups**: cada 10 líneas la siguiente pieza es una pieza especial 1×1 que se activa al aterrizar: 💣 Bomba (área 3×3), ⚡ Rayo (limpia su fila), 🎨 Tinte (los bloques del color sobre el que cae pasan a comodín), ⬇ Gravedad (compacta huecos) y ❄ Congelar (pausa la caída 5 s). Para probar uno, abre `index.html?powerup=bomb` (`bomb`, `lightning`, `dye`, `gravity`, `freeze`).
- **Rotación** con _wall kicks_ básicos (pequeños desplazamientos para que la pieza pueda rotar pegada a la pared).
- **Soft drop** (bajada acelerada) y **hard drop** (caída instantánea).
- **Pieza fantasma** (_ghost piece_): muestra dónde aterrizará la pieza actual.
- **Vista previa** de la siguiente pieza.
- **Sistema de puntuación** clásico de Tetris (100 / 300 / 500 / 800 multiplicado por nivel).
- **Niveles** que aumentan cada 10 líneas y aceleran la caída.
- **Menú de pausa** (`P` o `Esc`): Reanudar, Reiniciar (nueva partida sin recargar), Ver controles y **Nivel inicial** (1–15, se aplica en la próxima partida y se guarda en `localStorage`). Se navega con `↑`/`↓`, `←`/`→` cambia el nivel y `Enter` elige. Mientras está abierto, las teclas no mueven piezas, y al reanudar se ignoran los inputs ~150 ms para evitar movimientos accidentales.
- **Game Over** con opción de reinicio.
- **Tema oscuro / claro**: arranca en oscuro; el botón de la esquina superior derecha cambia a claro y la elección se guarda en `localStorage`.

---

## Modo desafío

El selector **MODO** del panel permite elegir un desafío (cambiarlo reinicia la partida; el modo Clásico sigue siendo el predeterminado):

- **Sprint**: limpia 40 líneas en 2 minutos. Si se acaba el tiempo, pierdes; si lo logras, aparece «¡DESAFÍO COMPLETADO!».
- **Basura**: cada 10 s sube una fila de basura (gris, con un hueco) desde abajo.

AhmedShela/firefly-run.readme:
# Firefly Run — app project

This folder turns the Firefly Run web game into real iOS and Android apps using
[Capacitor](https://capacitorjs.com). The game itself lives in `www/index.html`;
Capacitor wraps it in a native shell you can submit to the App Store and Google Play.

```
firefly-run/
├── www/index.html          the game
├── assets/                 app icon + splash source images (1024px / 2732px)
├── capacitor.config.json   app name, bundle ID, colors
└── package.json            dependencies and helper scripts
```

---

## 0. Before you start

| You need | For | Cost |
|---|---|---|
| [Node.js](https://nodejs.org) 20 or newer | both | free |
| [Android Studio](https://developer.android.com/studio) | Android | free |
| A **Mac** with [Xcode](https://apps.apple.com/app/xcode/id497799835) | iOS (no way around this, Apple requires it) | free |
| [Google Play Console](https://play.google.com/console/signup) account | publishing on Android | $25 one-time |
| [Apple Developer Program](https://developer.apple.com/programs/) membership | publishing on iOS | about $99 / year |

Check both stores' sign-up pages for current prices before you pay.

**Change the app ID first.** Open `capacitor.config.json` and replace
`com.example.fireflyrun` with something unique to you, e.g. `com.yourname.fireflyrun`.
Stores reject `com.example.*`, and the ID can never change after you publish.

---

## 1. Set up the project (once)

Open a terminal in this folder:

```bash
npm install
npx cap add android
npx cap add ios          # Mac only
npm run icons            # generates every icon + splash size from assets/
npx cap sync
```

## 2. Try it on your phone

**Android:** `npm run android` opens Android Studio. Plug in your phone with USB
debugging on (Settings → About phone → tap *Build number* 7 times → Developer options),
pick it in the device menu, and press ▶ Run.

**iPhone:** `npm run ios` opens Xcode. Select the *App* target → *Signing & Capabilities*,
choose your Apple ID as the Team, plug in your iPhone, and press ▶ Run.

Whenever you change `www/index.html`, run `npx cap sync` and press Run again.

## 3. Publish to Google Play

1. In Android Studio: **Build → Generate Signed App Bundle / APK → Android App Bundle**.
   Create a new keystore when asked. **Back it up and keep the password** — losing it
   means you can never update the app.
2. In [Play Console](https://play.google.com/console): *Create app* → fill in name,
   language, "Game", "Free".
3. Complete the setup checklist: privacy policy URL, content rating questionnaire,
   target audience, data safety form (Firefly Run collects no data; the best score
   stays on the device), store listing (description, icon, at least 2 screenshots,
   a 1024×500 feature graphic).
4. **New personal accounts must run a closed test first**: upload the `.aab` to a
   closed testing track and get at least 12 testers opted in for 14 days in a row
   before you can apply for production. Recruit a few extra in case people drop out.
5. Then promote the build to *Production* and submit for review.

## 4. Publish to the App Store

1. Enroll in the Apple Developer Program and sign in to Xcode with that account.
2. Create the app in [App Store Connect](https://appstoreconnect.apple.com) → *My Apps* → **+**,
   using the same bundle ID as `capacitor.config.json`.
3. In Xcode, set the version (1.0) and build number (1), choose *Any iOS Device*, then
   **Product → Archive → Distribute App → App Store Connect → Upload**.
4. Back in App Store Connect: add screenshots (6.7" and 6.5" iPhone sizes at minimum),
   description, keywords, support URL, privacy policy URL, age rating, and mark
   "Data Not Collected" in App Privacy.
5. Select the uploaded build and **Submit for Review**. Reviews usually take a day or two.
   You can also share it first with friends through **TestFlight**.

---

## Tips for passing review

- **Apple guideline 4.2 (minimum functionality)** rejects apps that feel like a thin
  website wr

rios-kitchen/PokePet.readme:
# PokePet 🐭⚡

A pixel Pokémon desktop pet for **macOS and Windows** with a built-in **Pomodoro timer** and **to-do list**.
English / 中文. Everything is stored locally.

> **Want more than a desktop pet and a timer?** Try
> [**宝可宠探索 · PokePet Explorer**](https://github.com/rios-kitchen/PokePetExplorer), PokePet's big
> sibling. It has everything here plus a QQ-Pet style raising game: choose a starter at Professor Oak's,
> evolution, status conditions and medicine, outings with photos, fishing, daily tasks and more.
> PokePet stays the simple one – both can be installed side by side.
>
> 想要的不只是桌宠和计时？试试 PokePet 的进阶版 [**宝可宠探索**](https://github.com/rios-kitchen/PokePetExplorer)：
> 包含这里的全部功能，再加上 QQ 宠物式的养成——在大木博士那里选初始宝可梦、进化、异常状态与用药、外出合影、钓鱼、每日任务等。
> PokePet 会继续保持简单，两个应用可以同时安装。

## Run

```bash
npm install
npm start
```

## Build an installer

```bash
npm run dist       # both → install/PokePet-<version>-macOS.dmg + install/PokePet-<version>-Windows-Setup.exe
npm run dist:mac   # only macOS (universal: Apple Silicon + Intel)
npm run dist:win   # only Windows (x64 installer)
```

`install/` only keeps the two installers (unpacked builds and blockmaps are removed afterwards).

The builds are unsigned: on macOS right-click the app → *Open* the first time; on Windows click
*More info → Run anyway* in the SmartScreen dialog.

## How to play

| Action | Result |
| --- | --- |
| Click the pet | Pat it (hearts, mood ↑, a bit of XP) |
| Drag the pet | Carry it anywhere on screen |
| Double-click | Open the to-do list |
| Right-click / tray icon | Menu: timer, switch Pokémon, size, language, … |
| Click the timer pill | Open the Pomodoro view |

### How the pet, timer and to-dos work together

- **Focus session**: the pet stops wandering, shows a 🍅 countdown above its head and cheers you on
  when you pat it. Pick a to-do as the task you're working on (or press ▶ next to a to-do).
- **Session finished**: fanfare, stars, +20 XP. The pet then asks *“Did you finish …?”* – answer
  in the speech bubble to tick the task off.
- **Break**: the pet gets playful, walks around and suggests stretching / drinking water. When the
  break ends it asks whether to start the next round.
- **To-do done**: a berry drops from the sky and the pet eats it (+10 XP, mood ↑). Finishing all
  tasks triggers a celebration.
- **Reminders**: every N minutes (configurable, never during focus) the pet reminds you of open
  to-dos with a one-click “Start” button. To-dos with a due time ring an alarm when they're due.
- **Mood & levels**: each Pokémon levels up separately. Mood drops slowly if you ignore your pet;
  when it's lonely it will tell you.

### Reacting to your keyboard & mouse

No keyboard hook and no special permissions. The app only learns *when* a key was pressed, never which:
on macOS via `CGEventSourceSecondsSinceLastEventType`, on Windows via `GetAsyncKeyState`. Mouse clicks
and scrolling never count as typing, and the keyboard never appears during baths, meals, sleep etc.

- **Typing** → the pet sits down and types along on a tiny keyboard. After 15 min of typing
  without a focus session it suggests starting one.
- **Moving the mouse** → the pet looks towards the cursor (eyes for the built-ins, whole body for
  downloaded Pokémon). During breaks it sometimes chases the cursor.
- **Hovering over the pet** → it gets shy and happy. **Shaking the mouse fast** → it gets dizzy.
- **Away for 3 min** → it naps; when you come back it says hello.

### Care (QQ-Pet style)

Each Pokémon has **hunger, cleanliness and health** (plus mood). They drop over time – more slowly
while you're away or the app is closed (max. 12 h are counted).

- **Hungry** → the pet asks for food. **Dirty** → dirt spots and a fly; it wants a bath.
- Neglected for long (health < 60) it can **catch a cold**: green tint, sweat drops, droopy eyes,
  it barely walks. At 0 health it **faints** and only a Potion helps.
- **Berries 🍓 are the currency**: +3 per Pomodoro, +1 per finished to-do, +2 per day.

SpaseCases/ski-game.readme:
# Park Laps

A small, physics-driven, low-poly 3D freeski game that runs in the browser on school Chromebooks. Keyboard only, no accounts, no backend.

- **Play:** https://spasecases.github.io/ski-game/
- **Embed test:** https://spasecases.github.io/ski-game/embed-test.html (loads the game in an iframe like a Google Sites page)
- **Skier poses:** https://spasecases.github.io/ski-game/poses.html (the low-poly skier in every pose, side by side; ← → rotates)

`GAME_DESIGN.md` describes what is being built and the milestone order. `CLAUDE.md` holds the technical rules.

## Develop

Requires Node.js 20.19+ (22 or 24 recommended).

```bash
npm install
npm run dev       # dev server at http://localhost:5173/ski-game/
npm run build     # type-check and build to dist/
npm run preview   # serve the built dist/ at http://localhost:4173/ski-game/
```

Every push to `main` builds the game and deploys `dist/` to GitHub Pages through GitHub Actions.

## Status

See the Status section at the bottom of `GAME_DESIGN.md`: milestones done, known issues, and tuned config values. A frame-rate readout sits in the bottom-left corner for checking performance on real hardware.

`npm run dev` also shows a lil-gui panel for live-tuning the physics and camera numbers in `src/config.ts` ("Copy config as JSON" copies the tuned values), a quality switch, and "Test spots" that put the skier in front of each feature. The panel is left out of production builds; `?quality=low` in the URL picks a quality preset.

## Maps

Maps are JSON files in `src/maps/`, listed for the map-select menu in `src/maps/registry.ts`. `?map=park` (or `test`) in the URL skips the menu. The Park is laid out by a script that works positions out from a few section lengths; edit the script and rerun it rather than editing `park.json` by hand:

```bash
node tools/maps/park.ts   # writes src/maps/park.json and reports the terrain lanes
```

## Headless sim checks

`tools/sim/` runs the real simulation in Node with scripted keys, no browser, for sizing features:

```bash
node tools/sim/spin720.ts                                       # airtime a clean 720 needs
node tools/sim/jumps.ts src/maps/test-slope.json 14,18          # every jump, no pop and full pop
node tools/sim/line.ts src/maps/park.json 102 1091 1340 tuck pop 720  # ride a line from a flag: every air, landing and crash
```

`tools/sim/harness.ts` (`loadMap`, `Rider`) is the base for new checks. In `npm run dev`, `window.parkLaps` also has `loadMap(id)`, `teleport(...)` and `lookFrom(x, y, z, tx, ty, tz)` (a fixed camera for looking over a map; call it with no arguments to go back to the chase camera).

# 🔍 Find It! — game belajar bahasa Inggris bareng anak

Game "cari benda" untuk iPad (lewat browser). Satu gambar besar tampil, lalu game bilang
**"Find the lamp!"**. Siapa yang paling cepat menemukan dan men-tap lampunya, dia dapat bintang.
Setelah ketemu muncul kalimat (**"The lamp can turn on."**) dan pertanyaan **"Let's talk!"**
untuk ngobrol bareng dalam bahasa Inggris. Semua kalimat bisa dibacakan (tombol 🔊).

## Mode permainan

| Mode | Cara main |
|---|---|
| 🤝 **Together** | Satu gambar besar. Siapa pun yang ketemu, tap bendanya, lalu pilih siapa yang menemukan (Kiddo / Both / Mommy). |
| 🏁 **Race** | Layar dibagi dua, tiap pemain punya gambar sendiri, tap pertama yang benar menang. iPad **tegak**: duduk berhadapan (layar atas terbalik). iPad **miring**: duduk bersebelahan. Pemain 2 (orang tua) bisa diberi waktu tunggu supaya si kecil dapat kesempatan duluan. |
| 👀 **Explore** | Tanpa lomba: tap apa saja untuk mendengar nama dan kalimatnya. Cocok untuk pemanasan. |

Tema bawaan: Bedroom, Living Room, Bathroom, Kitchen, Zoo, Busy Street.

Fitur lain:
- **Tap salah = tetap belajar**: game bilang "Oops! That's the bed."
- **💡 Hint**: benda target berkedip dan muncul panah 👇 (otomatis setelah 15 detik, bisa diatur).
- **📒 Sticker Book**: setiap benda yang ditemukan jadi stiker koleksi.
- **📷 Photo Scenes**: foto halaman buku bergambar (seperti buku *Busy Street*), crop, lalu tap
  benda-bendanya dan ketik nama Inggrisnya. Jadi level baru!
- **⚙️ Settings**: nama & avatar pemain, arti Indonesia on/off, mode sulit (tanpa gambar petunjuk),
  pilihan suara & kecepatan bicara.

## Menjalankan

Butuh Node.js (sudah ada di Mac ini).

```bash
npm install
```

```bash
npm run dev
```

Lalu buka di iPad (iPad dan Mac harus di Wi-Fi yang sama):

```
http://192.168.1.10:5173
```

(Alamat IP Mac bisa berubah; terminal `npm run dev` menampilkan alamat "Network" yang benar.)

Supaya tampil penuh seperti aplikasi: di Safari iPad tekan **Share › Add to Home Screen**.

> Tips suara: pastikan iPad tidak dalam mode Silent dan volume cukup. Suara Inggris yang lebih
> bagus bisa diunduh di iPad: Settings › Accessibility › Spoken Content › Voices › English.

### Versi siap-pakai (tanpa Mac menyala)

```bash
npm run build
```

Folder `dist/` berisi website statis yang bisa di-upload ke hosting gratis mana pun
(Netlify Drop, GitHub Pages, Vercel, dll.).

## Untuk pengembang

- `src/scenes/*.jsx` — tema/scene bawaan. Format & aturan: `src/scenes/README.md`.
- `npm run validate` — cek semua scene (teks lengkap, area tap tidak bertabrakan, dll.).
- `npm run render -- <id>` — render scene ke PNG di `.renders/` (butuh Google Chrome).
- Tambah `?debug=1` di URL untuk melihat area tap setiap benda.

zhuqipaopao-maker/night-racer-public.readme:
# 夜行赛车 Night Racer

浏览器里直接玩的 3D 赛车游戏，手机和电脑都能玩。

**在线试玩：https://night-racer.pages.dev**

## 地图

霓虹街区（雨夜）· 雾岭山道（黄昏）· 碧海长桥（晴天）· 长安灯火（元宵夜）· 天空工地 · 赤岩峡谷 · 云港城区（岔路）· 珊瑚深海 · 冰原极光（雪夜）· 坠梦，还有一张要倒着开才能找到的隐藏地图。

支持对战 AI、计时赛（挑战自己的幽灵车）、联机房间、排行榜、车库改装。

## 技术

- [Three.js](https://threejs.org) 渲染，esbuild 打包成一个网页文件，部署在 Cloudflare Pages
- 大部分场景用代码生成：地形、天空、赛道、建筑
- 冰原极光的场景物件和 GT 车模型是用 [Tripo](https://www.tripo3d.ai) AI 生成的 3D 模型，再用 Blender 脚本减面、烘焙法线、压缩

## 目录

| 路径 | 内容 |
|---|---|
| `src/` | 游戏代码。`main.js` 主循环，`car.js` 车辆物理，`track.js` 赛道，`maps.js` 地图定义，其余每个文件是一张地图的场景 |
| `public/models/` | 3D 模型（`gt.glb` 赛车，`ice.glb` 冰原场景） |
| `tools/tripo.mjs` | 调用 Tripo API 生成模型（需要自己的 API key，放在 `~/.config/tripo/api-key`） |
| `tools/pack-assets.py` | Blender 脚本：把生成的模型打包、缩小贴图 |
| `tools/gt-model.py` | Blender 脚本：把 Tripo 的车拆出轮子、减面、烘焙法线 |
| `tools/track-layout.mjs` | 用直道和弯道拼出闭合赛道 |
| `functions/` | Cloudflare Pages Functions，转发联机和排行榜请求 |

排行榜和联机房间的服务器代码没有放在这里。

## 本地运行

```bash
npm install
node build.mjs          # 生成 dist/index.html
cd dist && python3 -m http.server 8000
```

然后打开 http://localhost:8000 。本地运行时联机和排行榜用不了，比赛照常能玩。

## 许可证

[MIT](LICENSE)：可以随意使用、修改、再发布，保留原来的版权声明就行。`public/models/` 里的 3D 模型也一样适用。

# MORTAL BRAINROT

An absurdly serious single-file browser fighting game. Mortal Kombat-style mechanics, brainrot aesthetic, zero dependencies. One HTML file, everything drawn procedurally on canvas — no sprites, no assets, no build step.

## Play

Open `public/index.html` in any modern browser. That's it. Or serve it locally:

```bash
python3 -m http.server 8471 -d public
# → http://localhost:8471/
```

**1 Player** (press F or gamepad A) fights a CPU opponent. **2 Players** (press G) share one keyboard or use two gamepads.

## Controls

| Action | P1 keyboard | P2 keyboard | Gamepad |
|---|---|---|---|
| Move / jump / crouch | WASD | Arrow keys | Left stick or D-pad |
| Light attack | F | Numpad1 or `,` | A / X (Cross/Square) |
| Heavy attack | G | Numpad2 or `.` | B / Y (Circle/Triangle) |
| Block (hold) | H | Numpad3 or `/` | Any shoulder/trigger |
| Pause | Esc | Esc | Start |

In 1-player mode, **both** keyboard sets and **any** gamepad control you. Gamepad 1 = P1, gamepad 2 = P2. Browsers hide controllers until you press a button on one — tap any button and the title screen shows a green 🎮 line when it's detected.

**Universal mechanics:** ↓ + heavy = launcher (starts juggle combos) · double-tap toward/away = dash/backdash · ↓ ↘ → (or ← ↙ ↓, or ↓ ↓) + attack = special · both attack buttons together on a special = EX version (costs ⅓ meter) · ↓ ↘ → ↓ ↘ → + attack with full meter = super. Lights chain into heavies into specials into supers. Blocking high/low matters: crouch-block lows, stand-block jump-ins and overheads. Chip damage is recoverable (the lighter shade on your health bar regenerates if you avoid getting hit).

**Finishers:** win the match point round and the loser staggers for ~4 seconds while the screen shows your finisher input. Land it. You've earned it.

## Roster

| Fighter | Archetype | Gimmick |
|---|---|---|
| Strawberry Elephant | Grappler | Command grab (← ↙ ↓ + H), armored EX Trunk Cannon |
| Cappuccino Assassino | Rushdown | Dash-cancels everything, Caffeine Overdose speed install |
| Pipi Watermelon | Zoner | Seed projectiles, melon mortars, melon monsoon |
| Frigo Camelo | Weirdo | Fridge spawns pickups (heal/meter/speed), frost breath slows |
| Tung Tung Sahur | Mixup | TUNG TUNG TUNG rekka, megaphone shockwave |
| Bombardiro Crocodilo | Bomber | 1200 HP tank, armored chomp run, carpet bombs |
| Ballerina Cappuccina | Tempo | Fastest fighter, traveling spin multi-hits, overhead Grand Jeté |
| Brainrot God | Boss | Full-screen eye laser, targeted lightning, teleport dash |

## Extras

`` ` `` (backquote) toggles **debug view**: hitboxes (red), hurtboxes (green), pushboxes (blue), state machine readouts, input history, frame counter. `M` mutes the synthesized music/announcer.

## Tech (for the curious)

Fixed-timestep 60Hz logic decoupled from render with interpolation — identical gameplay at any refresh rate. Every move is frame data (startup/active/recovery, hitboxes, cancels); the engine contains no per-move logic. Input ring buffer with motion parsing and a buffer clock that freezes during hitstop. All audio (hits, announcer voice, music) synthesized live via WebAudio. See `AGENTS.md` for the full architecture.

```bash
node test/smoke.js   # headless engine test suite (no browser needed)
```

## Deploy (optional)

The game is plain static files, so any static host works. `wrangler.toml` is set up for Cloudflare Workers static assets:

```bash
npx wrangler deploy
```

## Contributing

New fighters, moves and bug fixes are welcome. Read `AGENTS.md` first (it covers the architecture rules and how to add a character), make your change in `public/index.html`, and make sure `node test/smoke.js` still ends with `ALL PASS` before opening a pull request.

## License

MIT, see [LICENSE](LICENSE).

anq308/AVANTISgame.readme:
# AVANTIS Moto Tycoon

2D-пиксельная arcade idle / tycoon игра: строим мотоимперию AVANTIS с пустого участка до флагманского дилерского центра с сервисом и тест-драйв трассой.

## Запуск
Откройте `index.html` в браузере, сервер не нужен. Для теста на телефоне: `npx serve .`.

## Управление
На телефоне: тяните пальцем по экрану — движение, круглая оранжевая кнопка «Действие» — то же, что клавиша E. Панель бизнеса открывается кнопкой-портфелем.

| Клавиша | Действие |
|---|---|
| WASD / стрелки, или тянуть пальцем | движение |
| E | купить площадку сразу / открыть управление в офисе |
| Tab | панель управления бизнесом |
| M | карта территории |
| Esc | меню и настройки |
| P | пауза |

## Прогрессия (уровни мотосалона)
1. **Начинающий мотосалон**: склад, первый стенд, касса, офис.
2. **Развитие продаж**: гараж, скутеры, экипировка, детские квадроциклы, кассир и продавцы.
3. **Склад и логистика**: второй паллет, кладовщики, логистика, мотосалон, эндуро.
4. **Сервис**: сервисный бокс, подъёмники, механики, запчасти.
5. **Большой мотосалон**: Tourist, City, MX 300, тест-драйв трасса, акции, декор.
6. **Мотоимперия**: дилерский центр, квадроциклы, Koshine, снегоходы, менеджеры, флагман.
7. **Мотоимперия II и дальше**: бесконечные задания.

Уровень растёт после выполнения всех заданий текущего уровня (левая панель). Новые площадки открываются по уровню, деньгам и выполненным заданиям.

## Бизнес-центр и кабинет босса (v3)
- **Бизнес-центр AVANTIS** (уровень 3) стоит рядом со складом. Войти можно через дверь, выйти через лобби. Здание растёт вверх с каждым этажом.
- **Этажи**: лобби с ресепшн и постом охраны, затем отделы SMM, финансов и HR, а на самом верху кабинет босса. Этажи переключаются в лифте.
- **Офисные сотрудники** (9 ролей) сидят за столами и дают пассивные бонусы: клиенты, цены, выручка, скидки на стройку и найм, скорость персонала.
- **Кабинет босса**: кубки по уровням, аквариум, сейф. У ПК нажмите **E**, откроется **AVANTIS OS**: отчёты с графиками, акции, персонал, почта с предложениями партнёров, этажи бизнес-центра.
- **Улучшения здания**: окна, двери (автоматические разъезжаются), фасад с LED, освещение, климат, видеонаблюдение. Всё видно на здании.
- **Охрана и воры**: вор хватает товар со стенда и убегает. Догоните его сами или наймите охранников. Камеры снижают число краж.

## Улучшения на карте (v4)
- Закрытые площадки всегда видны: серые, с замком и требуемым уровнем.
- **Вторая касса** со своей очередью и вторым кассиром. Покупатели выбирают короткую очередь.
- **Интерьер салона**: видеостена с рекламой (+6% клиентов), мраморный пол (+4% к ценам), фотозона (репутация каждые 20 с).
- **Защита**: ограждение территории (−25% краж), служба инкассации (броневик каждые 45 с сам собирает все стопки денег).
- **Сервисная территория** (восток карты): мойка, шиномонтаж, прокат. Они зарабатывают сами, деньги копятся в стопке у станции.
- **VIP-зал на 2 этаже салона**: лестница в зале, 3 VIP-подиума с премиум-техникой, VIP-менеджер, бар, VIP-клиенты и крупные сделки.

## Кадры, обустройство и площадки (v5)
- **Всё покупается на карте.** Синие площадки «Нанять» стоят у рабочих мест (касса, склад, сервис, вход, зал). Встаньте на площадку, и откроется выбор кандидатов. Улучшения, изменения здания и декор — оранжевые площадки там, где они действуют. Меню Tab работает как каталог: кнопки «Показать» и «Где нанять» ведут стрелкой.
- **У заданий есть кнопка «→»**: она показывает, куда идти или что открыть.
- **Сотрудники-личности**: имя, характеристики (скорость, навык, харизма) и зарплата за игровой день. Характеристики влияют на работу. Уволить можно в Tab → Персонал.
- **Бизнес-центр строится пустым.** Каждый этаж сначала нужно отремонтировать, затем купить мебель: рабочие места, переговорную, кофе-поинт и другое. Уют этажа усиливает сотрудников. Компьютер в кабинете работает только со столом босса.
- **Новые этажи**: Кадровый центр (стойка собеседований, до 6 кандидатов, кандидаты лучше), SEO и реклама, IT-отдел с интернет-м

NiceWorkLad/pool-game.desc: Run Out: pool puzzles, Learn mode, survival, Blackout and two-player 8-ball in one HTML page.
NiceWorkLad/pool-game.readme:
# Run Out

A pool game in a single HTML page: chess-style 8-ball puzzles, a Learn mode that teaches aiming, cut angles, spin and position, an endless Survival run against the clock, Blackout (36 black balls, fewest shots wins) and two-player pass-and-play 8-ball. Five themes, levels and XP, works on desktop and phones in portrait or landscape.

## Play

Open `index.html` in a browser (or play it at https://pool.whittleadams.com), or serve the folder:

```bash
npm run serve        # http://localhost:8080
```

## Build

`index.html` is generated. Edit the source files, then:

```bash
npm run build        # writes index.html
npm run check        # build + JavaScript syntax check
```

## Content pipeline

Every position in the game is verified with the same physics the game uses.

| Script | What it does |
|---|---|
| `solver.js` | Solves the hand-made puzzles, writes `solutions.json` |
| `gen2.js` | Generates graded survival positions into `bank/` (`node gen2.js <worker> <seconds> [theme]`) |
| `grade.js` | Tiers the generated positions and writes `survival.json` |
| `rate.js` | Writes `ratings.json` (puzzle and survival difficulty) |
| `genlessons.js` | Builds and verifies the Learn mode drills, writes `lessons.json` |
| `verifybank.js` | Replays every survival position to a win |
| `validate.js` | Checks the difficulty grader against published pool research |

Difficulty is a margin-of-error model: for each shot, how far the aim can be off and still succeed, turned into how often a club-level player makes the line. See `tol.js`.

DoctorB/forever-one-button.readme:
# Forever One Button

An Action Panel for **WoW Forever** that puts
[JustAC](https://github.com/wealdly/JustAC) suggestions on a grid of action
buttons you configure yourself, and keeps the HCOneButton **Diagnostic Pixel
protocol v3** for passive external readers.

- **JustAC decides.** The only source of suggestions is JustAC's public
  `JustAC-SpellQueue` / `GetCurrentSpellQueue`. Forever One Button has no
  rotation, no priorities and no fallback of its own.
- **You press every key.** Cells are secure action buttons that run only when
  you click them or press their key. There is no spam button, no repeat, no
  pull automation and no pull advisor.
- **The pixel keeps its contract.** The 8×8 diagnostic square encodes the cell
  holding JustAC's first suggestion exactly as HCOneButton protocol v3 does.

Status: **0.2.0, partial / runtime verification pending**. The offline suites
pass; the in-game checks listed in [docs/TEST_REPORT.md](docs/TEST_REPORT.md)
and the round trip with the original external reader are still open.
Compatibility with that reader is therefore not claimed.

## Requirements

- WoW Forever client (`_classic_beta_`, build 1.60.1.x, Interface `16001`).
- JustAC 5.9.0-beta2 or later (verified against SpellQueue minor 43). Without
  JustAC the grid works as plain action buttons and says "JustAC not loaded".

## Installation

1. Download `ForeverOneButton-<version>.zip` (or build it, see below).
2. Extract it into `World of Warcraft\_classic_beta_\Interface\AddOns\` so the
   folder `AddOns\ForeverOneButton\ForeverOneButton.toc` exists.
3. Install JustAC in the same `AddOns` folder.
4. Restart the client or `/reload`.

## Configuration

Open the options with `/fob`.

1. **Cells fill themselves.** Every spell JustAC can suggest for your
   character (the spells on your action bars, the known abilities of
   JustAC's Forever list and JustAC's gap closers such as Charge) takes the
   first free cell and **keeps it**. A new
   spell you learn goes to the next free cell; a new rank replaces the old one
   in the same cell. Nothing is ever moved. Cells are saved per character.
   You can still drag a spell or item onto a cell, or use
   `/fob assign <cell> spell <id or name>` / `/fob assign <cell> item <id>`.
   **Clear** empties a cell and keeps that spell out of the automatic fill
   (`/fob autofill reset` undoes this). Turn the fill off in the options or
   with `/fob autofill off`.
2. **Keys.** Cells 1–10 use `SHIFT-1`…`SHIFT-0`, cells 11–20
   `CTRL-SHIFT-1`…`CTRL-SHIFT-0` by default. In *Cells & keys* press **Bind**
   and a key to change one (Esc cancels), **Unbind** for no key, **Default** to
   go back. A key used by another cell is refused. A key that also has a normal
   WoW binding is marked with `!`: the cell overrides it while the addon is
   loaded (by default `SHIFT-1`…`6` switch action bar pages).
3. **Layout.** In *Layout & pixel*: number of cells (1–20, default 20 in 10 columns), columns, cell size,
   spacing, scale, how many JustAC positions are labelled, show/lock grid.
   Unlock the grid to drag it by the bar above it.
4. **Pixel.** Show/hide it, unlock it to drag it by its yellow frame, lock it
   again. Keep it where your reader expects it and away from other UI.

5. **Blizzard's bottom bar.** "Hide Blizzard's bottom bar" in *Layout & pixel*
   (or `/fob blizzardbar hide|show`) makes the main action bar, the micro menu
   and the bags invisible and click-through. The stance and experience bars
   stay; the action bar keys keep working. Applied out of combat.

Changes to cells, keys and layout are blocked in combat; the options window
closes when combat starts.

## Using it

- The cell holding JustAC's first suggestion has a **gold frame and "1"**; the
  next positions have cyan frames and their numbers. The strip below the grid
  lists JustAC's queue **in JustAC order** with the cell of each entry
  (`c3`) or `--` when no cell holds it.
- If JustAC suggests something that is not on the grid

# Gardener Survivor

A Vampire Survivors–style browser game: you're a gardener holding off waves of angry plants.
Your tools attack on their own. Move around, collect seeds to level up, choose upgrades, and
survive 10 minutes to face the **Mutant Sunflower**.

## Run

No build step and no dependencies. ES modules need an HTTP server, so `file://` won't work:

```sh
python3 -m http.server 8000
# open http://localhost:8000
```

## Controls

- **WASD / arrow keys**: move (on touch screens, drag to move)
- **1 / 2 / 3** or click: pick a level-up card
- **Esc / P**: pause

## Content

- **Plants:** Weedling, Thorn Bush, Cactus (shoots spines), Venus Flytrap (lunges),
  Creeping Vine (splits when killed), golden elites, and the Mutant Sunflower boss at 10:00
- **Tools (5 levels each):** Pruning Shears, Boomerang Trowel, Weedkiller Spray, Garden Hose,
  Weed Torch (sets plants on fire), Lawn Gnomes, Earthquake Rake
- **Passives:** Garden Boots, Work Gloves, Straw Hat, Fertilizer, Seed Pouch, Sundial
- **Pickups:** seeds (XP, bigger plants drop richer seeds), tomatoes (heal), bees (pull in every seed on the map), golden watering cans (wilt every plant on screen)

## Debug

Open with `?debug` (for example `http://localhost:8000/?debug`) to enable:
`` ` `` skips ahead 1 minute, `L` grants a level-up, `H` heals to full. `window.game` is exposed.

## Code layout

`src/main.js` (loop and state machine), `game.js` (simulation), `player.js`, `enemies.js`,
`spawner.js` (wave timeline), `weapons.js`, `upgrades.js`, `pickups.js`, `projectiles.js`,
`particles.js`, `world.js` (procedural lawn), `icons.js`, `ui.js` (DOM HUD and menus), `utils.js`.

# Worlds 2026 Forecast [![Tests](https://github.com/Kmunoz2022/worlds-2026-forecast/actions/workflows/tests.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/Kmunoz2022/worlds-2026-forecast/actions/workflows/tests.yml) [![Prediction ledger](https://github.com/Kmunoz2022/worlds-2026-forecast/actions/workflows/ledger.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/Kmunoz2022/worlds-2026-forecast/actions/workflows/ledger.yml) A League of Legends pro-match prediction system built for the 2026 World Championship. It covers: - calibrated win probabilities for every game and series - a full tournament simulator for pick'em - live in-game win probabilities from the official broadcast's stats feed, computed in the visitor's browser - a public ledger where every 2026 prediction is committed **before** the match and graded after, by a scheduled GitHub Actions job (no manual step) - grading of the live model's minute-by-minute calls against who actually won **Site:** https://kmunoz2022.github.io/worlds-2026-forecast/ (the Today tab shows the live game during matches) ![Pick'em page](docs/img/pickem.png) ## Results All numbers are **out-of-sample**: each prediction comes from a model trained only on games played before it (monthly walk-forward retraining). **Pre-game, Worlds 2022–2025** (430 games): | Model | Accuracy | Log loss | Brier | |---|---|---|---| | **This model** | **66.0%** | **0.608** | **0.211** | | "Stronger region" rule | 65.6% | 0.614 | 0.213 | | Elo with cross-region linking | 62.8% | 0.622 | 0.217 | | Coin flip | 54.9% | 0.693 | 0.250 | On all 4,226 cross-region games since 2023: **69.5% accuracy / 0.590 log loss**, vs 64.8% / 0.627 for the region rule. **Calibration.** When the model gives the favourite 60–65%, that team wins 63.6% of the time. Every probability band is within a few points. **Why not higher pre-game?** For calibrated probabilities, expected accuracy equals the average favourite's probability, which is 66.1% for these Worlds games; the model scored 66.0%. Raising it takes new information, which is what the live model adds. **Live in-game** (18.7k games from 2025–26, trained on 2022–24): | Game minute | Accuracy | Games with a ≥90% call | Those calls correct | |---|---|---|---| | 10 | 71.6% | 10% | 96.1% | | 15 | 75.4% | 24% | 94.8% | | 20 | 79.7% | 38% | 95.4% | | 25 | 83.8% | 48% | 96.6% | **Worlds 2026:** graded live in [`ledger/predictions.jsonl`](ledger/predictions.jsonl) as the tournament is played. ## How it works ```mermaid flowchart LR A[Oracle's Elixir CSVs
53k pro games 2022-26] --> B[Clean + game, series tables] B --> C[Elo with cross-region
league strength] B --> D[Rolling form features] C --> E[Logistic regression
+ temperature calibration] D --> E E --> F[Series model
beta-binomial Bo1/3/5] F --> G[Monte Carlo tournament
Play-In, Swiss, knockouts] G --> H[Pick'em + Crystal Ball] E --> I[Live model
pre-game + gold, kill, CS leads] J[LoL Esports live feed] --> I E --> K[Prediction ledger
logged before, graded after] G --> L[Static website] H --> L K --> L ``` - **Cross-region strength.** Teams rarely play other regions, so a team's strength is its own Elo rating plus a league offset. International games move the offsets, and only games between major regions can move a major region. (A relegation series once inflated a whole region by 200 points; see [Bugs I found](docs/DECISIONS.md#bugs-i-found-and-fixed).) - **Game model.** Logistic regression on the Elo parts, each region's international record and exponentially weighted form. International games are weighted 5× because Worlds is all international. Temperature scaling is fit on earlier out-of-sample international predictions. Gradient boosting was tested and didn't beat it. - **Series.** Games in a series aren't independent: sweeps happen 65% of the time in Bo3s, vs 55% if games were independent coin flips. A beta-binomial model with κ fitted on 11k series reproduces real score distributions while

# RustyHusky

[![CI](https://github.com/ricande/RustyHusky/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/ricande/RustyHusky/actions/workflows/ci.yml)
[![Release](https://img.shields.io/github/v/release/ricande/RustyHusky)](https://github.com/ricande/RustyHusky/releases)
[![License: GPL-3.0-or-later](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-GPL--3.0--or--later-blue)](LICENSE)
[![Rust 1.87+](https://img.shields.io/badge/Rust-1.87%2B-orange?logo=rust)](Cargo.toml)
[![CI platforms: Linux, Windows, macOS](https://img.shields.io/badge/CI-Linux%20%7C%20Windows%20%7C%20macOS-blue)](.github/workflows/ci.yml)

[![Video: 1080 × 1920 at 60 fps](https://img.shields.io/badge/video-1080%20%C3%97%201920%20%40%2060%20fps-red)](#video-recording)
[![Portrait 9:16](https://img.shields.io/badge/portrait-9%3A16-purple)](#video-recording)
[![Use this template](https://img.shields.io/badge/GitHub-Use%20this%20template-2ea44f?logo=github)](https://github.com/new?template_name=RustyHusky&template_owner=ricande)

**Build. Play. Record. Share.**

RustyHusky is a Rust starter framework for creating portrait games and
recording gameplay videos for social media platforms such as YouTube Shorts,
TikTok, and Instagram Reels. Build a game, play it, record it, and share it.

- **Portrait 9:16 gameplay** – a logical 540 × 960 view, scaled to any window
  without cropping or stretching, with correct mouse coordinates.
- **Automatic gameplay recording with audio** – every round is recorded
  while you play, including the game's sound effects.
- **1080 × 1920 MP4 video at 60 fps** – H.264 video with AAC stereo sound,
  independent of the window size.
- **Save or discard the recording after a level** – nothing is written to
  your video folder until you choose Save video.
- **A reusable foundation for quickly building new games** – menus,
  settings, pause, results, scaling and recording are done; you replace one
  game module.
- **English by default, with i18n support** – all texts go through one
  translation catalog; Swedish is included.

![Main menu, a round with the REC marker, the pause menu and the results with Save video / Discard video](docs/images/screens.png)

*Main menu, the placeholder game while recording, the pause menu (never part
of the video) and the results with Save video / Discard video.*

RustyHusky creates video files that you publish yourself. It does not upload
anything to social media platforms.

Built with [Macroquad](https://macroquad.rs). It also has a main menu (Play,
Settings, Quit), settings for language, volume and recording that are saved
between runs, a fixed simulation time step, and a placeholder game that shows
"Your game here", to be replaced by yours.

The framework grew out of [RustOut](https://github.com/ricande/RustOut), a
Breakout-style game; its general parts were kept and the Breakout parts
removed. The framework draws everything in code and synthesizes its sounds;
a game's images and sounds in `assets/` are built into the program, so it
needs no files at run time.

## Requirements

- Rust (stable, 1.87 or later) via [rustup](https://rustup.rs)
- Linux: development packages for X11, ALSA and OpenGL, e.g. on Debian/Ubuntu:
  `sudo apt install libx11-dev libxi-dev libgl1-mesa-dev libasound2-dev`
- Windows and macOS need nothing extra to build.
- To record videos: [FFmpeg](https://ffmpeg.org) with the libx264 encoder, in
  `PATH` (Debian/Ubuntu: `sudo apt install ffmpeg`; macOS: `brew install
  ffmpeg`; Windows: an FFmpeg build such as the one from gyan.dev, with its
  `bin` folder in `PATH`). It is only needed at run time, not to build.
  Without it everything works except recording, and the settings and results
  screens say why.

## Running

```bash
cargo run --release
```

Tests (flow, settings, translations, scaling, recording pipeline) run without
a window; the video tests are skipped when FFmpeg is missing:

```bash
cargo test
```

## Playing

| Screen   | Keys / mouse |
| -------- | ------------ |
| Menus    |

Build against miniquad 0.4.11 with the texture-cache fix

Text could turn into black rectangles when macroquad's font atlas grew
right after a render-target pass (not-fl3/macroquad#1006): miniquad's
delete_texture left the deleted texture in its binding cache. Vendor
miniquad 0.4.11 exactly as published plus one patch (proposed upstream as
not-fl3/miniquad#691) and use it through [patch.crates-io]; a script, also
run in CI, checks that the copy is the crate plus the patch.

Remove the earlier vi

Add recording modes: prioritize gameplay or prioritize recording

The settings get "Recording mode", replacing recording on/off (old files
migrate: true -> Prioritize gameplay, false -> Off). It applies from the
next round.

- Prioritize gameplay: real time as before; the main thread no longer
  waits for the encoder at all and stops the recording if it falls behind.
- Prioritize recording (pacing::Lockstep): every video frame is two
  physics steps, drawn once and queued once; the game does not

Keep the game at full speed when the encoder falls behind

A slow encoder that still made progress slowed the game to its pace (and,
with longer frames meaning more frames to encode, worse), and the 3 s
stall watchdog never fired. New policy:

- The queue holds pictures with a repeat count, so repeated frames cost
  no memory; it is bounded to 24 pictures (about 0.4 s, at most ~200 MB).
- push_frame waits at most 2 ms per frame. If the queue is still full the
  encoder cannot keep up: it is kill

Never let a hung ffmpeg freeze the game

A ffmpeg that kept running but stopped reading frames made push_frame
wait forever on the full frame queue. Now:

- push_frame retries try_send while the encoder makes progress (no frames
  are dropped, so sound stays in sync) and kills the encoder after 3 s
  without progress; the round continues and the results show the error.
- All other ffmpeg waits go through video::Process, which drains stdout
  and stderr on reader threads and kills on a time limit

Raise the minimum Rust version to 1.87

The dependency fontdue (via Macroquad) uses integer_sign_cast, stable
since Rust 1.87, so the documented 1.82 never worked. Found by the new
MSRV job in CI; verified locally with Rust 1.87.
