alecoschwartz/gekko.desc: Gekko: a phone party game. Find who's out of the loop.
alecoschwartz/gekko.readme:
# Gecko

A party game for phones. Everyone gets the secret word except one player, the Gecko. Answer questions, vote out the Gecko, and see if the Gecko can guess the word.

**Play:** https://alecoschwartz.github.io/gekko/

One person taps **Start a new room** and gets a 4-letter code like `FROG`. Everyone else opens the same page, types their name and the code, and joins. The host's phone runs the game, so keep it open while you play.

Phones pass messages through a free public MQTT relay (broker.emqx.io) over a secure web connection. There's no server or database of our own, and the site is plain static files.

OmarElhosseni/narrative-game-engine.readme:
# Narrative Game Engine

Long-form, single-player roleplaying campaigns run by an AI Game Master. The AI builds a deep world before play, keeps every fact in a Campaign Bible on disk, rolls every die and computes every number in code, and runs the campaign for hundreds of sessions without losing the thread.

Three engines share one foundation (the shared Game Master rules in [`gm/`](gm/TURN.md) and the campaign tools in [`shared/`](shared/CAMPAIGN.md)):

| Engine | For | Code |
| --- | --- | --- |
| [Core](engines/core/ENGINE.md) (V2.1) | Any genre, with the engine's own diceless stats, checks and Stress | Campaign tools, NGE Map |
| [D&D Edition](engines/dnd/ENGINE.md) | Dungeons & Dragons 2024 rules (SRD 5.2), plus the [Sci-Fi Module](modules/scifi/MODULE.md) | Dice and balance tools |
| [VRMMO Edition](engines/vrmmo/ENGINE.md) | Virtual-reality MMO and progression fantasy, in the vein of Overgeared and Legendary Moonlight Sculptor | Game system, tactical combat, living server |

[World briefs](briefs/README.md) give you ready-made settings to start from. New to it? Read **[PLAYING.md](PLAYING.md)**, the player's guide: what a campaign is like, what a turn looks like, and how to steer the game.

## Play with a coding agent

You need Python 3.9 or later (`python3` on macOS and Linux, `py` on Windows, wherever these docs say `python`) and any coding agent that can read files and run commands. Clone the repo, open a terminal in it, start your agent and say **"Begin setup"**. The agent reads [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md), helps you choose an engine and a brief, creates your campaign folder and runs the engine's setup.

| Agent | Start it with | It reads |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Claude Code | `claude` | `CLAUDE.md`, which imports `AGENTS.md` |
| Codex CLI | `codex` | `AGENTS.md` |
| Gemini CLI | `gemini` | `GEMINI.md`, which imports `AGENTS.md` |
| Cursor, Copilot and others | open the folder | `AGENTS.md` (Copilot via `.github/copilot-instructions.md`) |

To come back later, start a new session and say **"Resume [campaign name]"**.

Your campaigns live in `campaigns/`, which git ignores. Everything you play stays on your machine; only improvements to the system get pushed.

### How the GM keeps track

Long campaigns fail when the GM forgets what happened. Here the GM keeps nothing important in the conversation:

- **The Bible** (`campaigns/<name>/bible/`) holds the world, the people and the story in prose, one Markdown file per tab.
- **The state files** (`state/`) hold the numbers and the clock: your character, money and accounts, the calendar, dated events, clocks, news you haven't heard yet, and the bills and wages that recur. Only the tools write them, and each turn's starting version is backed up.
- **The turn cycle** ([`gm/TURN.md`](gm/TURN.md)): before every reply the GM runs `scripts/turn.py begin`, which prints the current Scene Card, what is due, and every earlier mention of the names in your message; after it, `turn.py end` writes a line to the Chronicle and prints the status block from the files, so the numbers you see are the numbers the game holds. Out-of-character questions skip all of this. In Claude Code a prompt hook reminds the agent of this on every message.
- **Time moves only through `advance()`**, which pays the rent, resolves the election, delivers the letter and stops for anything that needs a decision from you.

## Play in a chat app

`python scripts/bundle.py` writes single-file engines to `dist/` with the code put back in, plus the `.py` files to attach. Paste the engine (and a brief, if you like) into a new chat with code execution and documents turned on, attach the `.py` files, and say "Begin setup". This works, but a chat app has no turn script and keeps state only until the chat ends, so the repo is the better way to play.

## Improve the system

Ask your agent to change an engine, a tool or a brief; it switches to Improve mode (see [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md)). Before pushing, run:

```
python scripts/verify

Oksem42/charmed-holdem.desc: Texas Hold'em roguelike: collect charms, level up hands, beat 8 tables.
Oksem42/charmed-holdem.readme:
# Charmed Hold'em

Play Texas Hold'em, collect lucky charms, and build a combo that breaks the casino.

**Play it:** https://oksem42.github.io/charmed-holdem/

## How to play
- Each hand costs a 10-chip ante. Bet, check or fold on each street, just like Hold'em.
- Each table gives you 6 hands to win the chip target. Miss it and the run ends.
- Between tables, buy, sell and reorder charms, reroll the shop, and level up hands.
- Beat all 8 tables to win.
- All in (`A`, press twice) pushes every chip. Opponents only call with strong hands, and losing one ends your run.
- A big stack raises the table target to half your chips minus 50, if that beats the base target.
- Keys: `B` bet, `C` check or call, `F` fold, `A` all in, `Enter` continue.

## Charm types
- **Payout**: flat bonus chips (Pair Pal, Underdog, Pocket Rockets...)
- **Multiplier**: multiplies the whole payout (Flush Fund, High Roller...)
- **Play style**: changes how you play (Bluff Master, Peek)
- **Grows**: gets stronger over a run (Hot Streak)
- **Combo**: works with other charms (Echo, which makes the charm to its left trigger twice)

The whole game is a single `index.html` with no build step.

commits.msg:
Add a voluntary All-in button and stack-scaled table targets

- All in (A, press twice to confirm) pushes every chip, calling and
  raising if you're facing a bet.
- Opponents call a shove only with strong hands, tighter for bigger
  shoves; each opponent has their own tendency.
- Table target is now the base or half your chips minus 50, whichever is
  higher, so one lucky double-up can't clear several tables.
- Simulated: shoving every hand averages 0.8 tables cleared vs 1.74 for
  normal play.

Add all-in and explain showdowns

- When you can't cover a call or a bet, the button becomes All in. Chips
  you can't match go back to the opponent, both hands flip face up and
  the board runs out automatically.
- Showdown messages show each player's best five cards, explain kicker
  decisions, and on a split name the hole cards that didn't play.
- Split pots now highlight the shared five cards.

- New charms: Echo (combo, doubles the charm to its left), Hot Streak

darren-rawlings/DotsAndBoxes.readme:
# Dots and Boxes

Starting point for a new Renegade Games title: a Godot 4.7 C# project for Android phones with
everything Counter Fire needed already wired up.

- **Shared library** [renegade-core](https://github.com/darren-rawlings/renegade-core) at
  `addons/renegade_core` (git submodule): ads, synthesised sound, developer tools, and the
  [release playbook](https://github.com/darren-rawlings/renegade-core/blob/main/docs/RELEASE_PLAYBOOK.md).
- **AdMob** via the Poing Studios plugin (`addons/admob`), Google's test ads until real IDs exist,
  child-directed by default; a stand-in ad on desktop.
- **Android export** preset with Gradle build and adaptive launcher icons.
- **Tests** for the engine-free rules code (`src/Core`) and **GitHub CI**.

## Start a new game

```
gh repo create darren-rawlings/<repo> --public --template darren-rawlings/renegade-game-template --clone
cd <repo>
git submodule update --init
powershell -File tools/New-Game.ps1 -Title "Mancala" -CodeName Mancala -PackageId mancala
```

Then design in `docs/DESIGN.md`, replace the table in `src/Game/Main.cs` with the game, and draw
the icon in `assets/icon/*.svg` (render with `tools/Render-Icons.ps1`).

## Run

- Desktop: open in Godot, or F5 in VS Code ("Play DotsAndBoxes").
- Developer flags after `--`: `--log`, `--demo`, `--quit-after-demo`, `--games-since-ad=4`.
  On a phone, push them as lines of `files/dev_args.txt` (see renegade-core's playbook).
- Android build (first create the output folder: `mkdir build/android`):
  `Godot.exe --headless --path . --install-android-build-template --export-debug "Android" build/android/DotsAndBoxes.apk`

## Layout

| Folder | What goes there |
|---|---|
| `src/Core` | Rules: plain C#, no Godot types, unit tested |
| `src/Game` | Scene, input, visuals, sound, HUD |
| `tests/` | xUnit tests for `src/Core` |
| `assets/icon` | Icon SVG sources and rendered PNGs |
| `tools/` | `New-Game.ps1`, `Render-Icons.ps1` |
| `docs/` | `DESIGN.md` for this game |

## 게임 요소

- **던전:** 층마다 새로 만드는 48×48 방+복도(1~3층 벽돌 던전, 4~5층 동굴), 화로 불빛, 소품, 보물 상자, 자동 지도. 층이 깊을수록 몬스터가 강하고 많다.
- **몬스터:** 스켈레톤 졸개·전사, 2층부터 궁수(화살은 피할 수 있음), 3~4층 마법사(물러나며 범위 폭발 화염구), 2~4층 금빛 정예 전사(최고 단계 장비 확정), 3층 중간 보스 해골 왕(졸개 소환), 5층 보스 미노타우르스(붉게 달아오르면 돌진 — 옆으로 피할 것).
- **성장:** 경험치·레벨(체력 +10, 공격력 +5%/레벨), 스킬 4개(가르기·돌진 베기·전투의 함성·도끼 던지기, 레벨업 포인트로 각각 5단계까지 성장), 무기 4단계(단검~그레이트소드)·갑옷 4단계(천옷~판금) — 장비에는 마법 옵션이 붙는다(일반·마법·희귀; 무기: 데미지·공격 속도·흡혈·치명타, 갑옷: 체력·피해 감소·재생·가시). 옵션까지 따져 더 좋은 장비(▲)는 밟으면 자동 장착되고 외형도 바뀐다.
- **금화·상점:** 몬스터·상자가 금화를 떨어뜨리고, 계단을 내려갈 때마다 상인에게서 물약을 사거나 무기·갑옷을 한 단계 강화할 수 있다.
- **진행:** 층에 들어갈 때 자동 저장(이어하기), 사망하면 그 층을 새로 만들어 들어올 때 상태로 재도전, 클리어하면 결과(시간·처치·사망) 표시. 클리어 후 **다음 회차**로 레벨·장비를 유지한 채 더 강한 던전에 다시 도전할 수 있다.

## 개발

Node.js 20.19+ (Vite 8 요구), Python 3 + Pillow(그림 변환할 때만).

```bash
npm install
npm run dev      # 개발 서버
npm test         # Vitest — 게임 규칙, 생성기, 시트 계약, 봇 1~5층 플레이(밸런스 회귀)
npm run build    # 타입 검사 + 배포 빌드(dist/)
python tools/sprites.py   # FLARE 원본을 받아 시트·질감·효과음 재생성(결과는 커밋되어 있음)
```

`main`에 push하면 GitHub Actions가 테스트·빌드 후 GitHub Pages로 배포한다.

## 구조

| 경로 | 역할 |
|---|---|
| `src/sim/` | 게임 규칙(three.js 없음, 시드 PRNG로 재현). `world.ts` 진입점(맵 읽기·한 틱·명령·기본 AI), `rules.ts` 수치·타입, `core.ts` 공용 전투(피해·드롭·레벨·걷기), `abilities.ts` 스킬·보스 패턴·투사체, `dungeon.ts` 층 생성, `path.ts` A*, `bot.ts` 테스트용 봇 |
| `src/render/` | three.js 렌더(정사영 30° 카메라, 도트 빌보드 스프라이트, 바닥·벽, 소품·화로 빛, 앞쪽 벽 낮추기, 자동 지도, 이름표) |
| `src/audio/` | 상태 변화 → 효과음 이벤트(순수 함수)와 Web Audio 재생 |
| `src/main.ts` | 게임 루프(60Hz 고정 틱), 층 진행·상점·저장·회차 |
| `src/hud.ts` | 화면 위 HTML(체력·경험치·스킬·물약·장비·금화, 보스 체력바, 배너, 상점 화면) |
| `src/shop.ts`, `src/save.ts` | 상점 가격·구매(순수 함수), 저장·이어하기(검증 포함) |
| `src/input.ts` | 마우스·터치 → sim 명령 |
| `tools/sprites.py` | FLARE 그림·소리 변환 |
| `docs/superpowers/` | 단계별 설계서(specs)와 구현 계획(plans) |

darren-rawlings/TowerOfHanoi.readme:
# Tower of Hanoi

Starting point for a new Renegade Games title: a Godot 4.7 C# project for Android phones with
everything Counter Fire needed already wired up.

- **Shared library** [renegade-core](https://github.com/darren-rawlings/renegade-core) at
  `addons/renegade_core` (git submodule): ads, synthesised sound, developer tools, and the
  [release playbook](https://github.com/darren-rawlings/renegade-core/blob/main/docs/RELEASE_PLAYBOOK.md).
- **AdMob** via the Poing Studios plugin (`addons/admob`), Google's test ads until real IDs exist,
  child-directed by default; a stand-in ad on desktop.
- **Android export** preset with Gradle build and adaptive launcher icons.
- **Tests** for the engine-free rules code (`src/Core`) and **GitHub CI**.

## Start a new game

```
gh repo create darren-rawlings/<repo> --public --template darren-rawlings/renegade-game-template --clone
cd <repo>
git submodule update --init
powershell -File tools/New-Game.ps1 -Title "Mancala" -CodeName Mancala -PackageId mancala
```

Then design in `docs/DESIGN.md`, replace the table in `src/Game/Main.cs` with the game, and draw
the icon in `assets/icon/*.svg` (render with `tools/Render-Icons.ps1`).

## Run

- Desktop: open in Godot, or F5 in VS Code ("Play TowerOfHanoi").
- Developer flags after `--`: `--log`, `--demo`, `--quit-after-demo`, `--games-since-ad=4`.
  On a phone, push them as lines of `files/dev_args.txt` (see renegade-core's playbook).
- Android build (first create the output folder: `mkdir build/android`):
  `Godot.exe --headless --path . --install-android-build-template --export-debug "Android" build/android/TowerOfHanoi.apk`

## Layout

| Folder | What goes there |
|---|---|
| `src/Core` | Rules: plain C#, no Godot types, unit tested |
| `src/Game` | Scene, input, visuals, sound, HUD |
| `tests/` | xUnit tests for `src/Core` |
| `assets/icon` | Icon SVG sources and rendered PNGs |
| `tools/` | `New-Game.ps1`, `Render-Icons.ps1` |
| `docs/` | `DESIGN.md` for this game |

LeonWWImmo/game-pick.readme:
# Game Pick

**Was zocken wir als Nächstes?** Diese Seite gibt die Antwort: für mich und meine Freunde.

Statt endloser Diskussion im Chat bewertet jeder die Kandidaten selbst, sortiert sein persönliches Ranking und schickt es anonym ab. Am Ende steht ein gemeinsames Ergebnis.

## So funktioniert's

1. **Geheime Zahl wählen**: irgendeine Zahl, egal wie gross. Sie ist deine Stimme: wer später die gleiche Zahl eingibt, ändert seine Abstimmung statt eine zweite zu erstellen.
2. **Games anschauen**: jedes Game mit Titelbild, Trailer und kurzer Erklärung. Ein Vibe-Meter zeigt auf einen Blick, wie viel **Grind**, **Story** und **Chill** drinsteckt.
3. **Daumen hoch / runter**: schnelles Bauchgefühl pro Game.
4. **Ranking ziehen**: die eigene Liste per Drag & Drop sortieren. Platz 1 = will ich am meisten.
5. **Abschicken**: anonym, nur mit der Zahl.
6. **Game-Ideen**: unten kann jeder neue Games für die nächste Runde vorschlagen. Die Liste ist für alle sichtbar; der Admin kann Vorschläge löschen.

## Anonym

Es gibt kein Login und keinen Namen, nur die selbst gewählte Zahl. Die Resultate landen in einem privaten Google Sheet, das nur der Admin sieht, inklusive automatischer Zusammenfassung (Favorit, Top 3, Teilnehmer) und Auswertung pro Game (👍, 👎, 😐 neutral, Ø Rang).

## Aktuelle Kandidaten

SAND: Raiders of Sophie · Enshrouded · Conan Exiles · Soulmask · 7 Days to Die · Astroneer · Windrose · V Rising · Core Keeper · Minecraft Modded · ARK: Survival Ascended (neuer Run) · Palworld Hardcore

## Technik

Reines HTML, CSS und JavaScript ohne Build-Step, gehostet auf GitHub Pages. Spieldaten in `data.js`, Empfänger für Stimmen und Ideen in `apps-script.gs` (Google Apps Script). Das Admin-Passwort liegt nicht im Code, sondern in den Skript-Eigenschaften des Apps Scripts. Bilder von Steam, Trailer von YouTube. Fan-Projekt ohne kommerzielle Absicht.

darren-rawlings/renegade-core.desc: Shared code and release playbook for Renegade Games' Godot C# games
darren-rawlings/renegade-core.readme:
# renegade-core

Shared code and know-how for Renegade Games' Godot C# games. Each game links this repository
in as a git submodule at `addons/renegade_core`, so a fix made here reaches every game.

| Folder | What's in it | Needs Godot? |
|---|---|---|
| `pure/` | `AdSchedule` (every-Nth-game ads), `Synth/ImpactSynth` (synthesised impact sounds) | No: unit tested |
| `godot/Ads` | `IAdService`, `AdMobAds` (real ads, consent, child-directed), `PlaceholderAds` (desktop stand-in), `AdServices.Create` | Yes |
| `godot/Audio` | `SoundPool` (round-robin positional players), `ImpactBank<T>` (cached synthesised variations) | Yes |
| `godot/Dev` | `DevLog` (`--log`, readable in `adb logcat`), `DevArgs` (flags from the command line or `user://dev_args.txt`) | Yes |
| `docs/` | [Release playbook](docs/RELEASE_PLAYBOOK.md), [starting a new game](docs/NEW_GAME.md), [website](docs/WEBSITE.md) | |

`AdMobAds` uses the [Poing Studios AdMob plugin](https://github.com/poingstudios/godot-admob-plugin),
which each game includes in its own `addons/admob`.

## Using it in a game

```
git submodule add https://github.com/darren-rawlings/renegade-core addons/renegade_core
```

In the game's `.csproj`, keep the library's tests and build output out of the game assembly:

```xml
<DefaultItemExcludes>$(DefaultItemExcludes);addons/renegade_core/tests/**;addons/renegade_core/**/bin/**;addons/renegade_core/**/obj/**</DefaultItemExcludes>
```

The game's CI checkout needs `submodules: true`. New games get all of this from
[renegade-game-template](https://github.com/darren-rawlings/renegade-game-template).

## Updating a game to the latest core

```
cd addons/renegade_core && git pull && cd ../..
git add addons/renegade_core && git commit -m "Update renegade-core"
```

## Tests

```
dotnet test tests/Renegade.Core.Tests
```

darren-rawlings/CodeBreaker.readme:
# Code Breaker

Starting point for a new Renegade Games title: a Godot 4.7 C# project for Android phones with
everything Counter Fire needed already wired up.

- **Shared library** [renegade-core](https://github.com/darren-rawlings/renegade-core) at
  `addons/renegade_core` (git submodule): ads, synthesised sound, developer tools, and the
  [release playbook](https://github.com/darren-rawlings/renegade-core/blob/main/docs/RELEASE_PLAYBOOK.md).
- **AdMob** via the Poing Studios plugin (`addons/admob`), Google's test ads until real IDs exist,
  child-directed by default; a stand-in ad on desktop.
- **Android export** preset with Gradle build and adaptive launcher icons.
- **Tests** for the engine-free rules code (`src/Core`) and **GitHub CI**.

## Start a new game

```
gh repo create darren-rawlings/<repo> --public --template darren-rawlings/renegade-game-template --clone
cd <repo>
git submodule update --init
powershell -File tools/New-Game.ps1 -Title "Mancala" -CodeName Mancala -PackageId mancala
```

Then design in `docs/DESIGN.md`, replace the table in `src/Game/Main.cs` with the game, and draw
the icon in `assets/icon/*.svg` (render with `tools/Render-Icons.ps1`).

## Run

- Desktop: open in Godot, or F5 in VS Code ("Play CodeBreaker").
- Developer flags after `--`: `--log`, `--demo`, `--quit-after-demo`, `--games-since-ad=4`.
  On a phone, push them as lines of `files/dev_args.txt` (see renegade-core's playbook).
- Android build (first create the output folder: `mkdir build/android`):
  `Godot.exe --headless --path . --install-android-build-template --export-debug "Android" build/android/CodeBreaker.apk`

## Layout

| Folder | What goes there |
|---|---|
| `src/Core` | Rules: plain C#, no Godot types, unit tested |
| `src/Game` | Scene, input, visuals, sound, HUD |
| `tests/` | xUnit tests for `src/Core` |
| `assets/icon` | Icon SVG sources and rendered PNGs |
| `tools/` | `New-Game.ps1`, `Render-Icons.ps1` |
| `docs/` | `DESIGN.md` for this game |

esotericode/microjump.readme:
# microjump

A custom C++23/Vulkan 1.3 engine, proven through an original 3D movement playground.
[AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md) is the authoritative charter and roadmap.

M2 adds a playable movement slice. A capsule character runs, skids, jumps with
variable height, coyote time and buffering, and steers in the air. It moves through a
graybox test yard (slopes, stairs, steps, platforms, walls) with an engine-owned
collide-and-slide controller. A third-person camera orbits with obstruction handling.
Input can be recorded and replayed deterministically, and every movement and camera value
is tunable live. Dynamic shadows (M3), the full JSON playground with wall jumps (M4) and
display settings (M5) come later. Details and evidence: [M2 notes](docs/m2-movement.md).

![M2 movement yard, mid-jump](docs/captures/m2-jump.png)

## Linux

Ubuntu 26.04; GCC 15 or Clang 21, CMake 3.28+, Ninja and a Vulkan 1.3 driver:

```sh
sudo apt-get install -y g++ cmake ninja-build clang libclang-rt-21-dev llvm-21 clang-format clang-tidy glslc libvulkan-dev vulkan-validationlayers vulkan-tools mesa-utils pkg-config libwayland-dev libxkbcommon-dev libx11-dev libxext-dev libxrandr-dev libxrender-dev libxcursor-dev libxi-dev libxfixes-dev libxss-dev libxtst-dev libxkbcommon-x11-dev libdecor-0-dev xvfb xauth xdotool
cmake --preset linux-debug -DMJ_SMOKE_TESTS=ON
cmake --build --preset linux-debug --parallel 4
ctest --preset linux-debug
./build/linux-debug/game/microjump
```

Use `linux-release` or `linux-clang-debug` for the other configurations. CMake fetches
only [approved, pinned dependencies](third_party/README.md) and builds shaders with
`glslc`. Debug enables ASan, UBSan and mandatory Vulkan synchronization validation.

Without sudo, `tools/bootstrap-local.sh` extracts Ubuntu development packages into
ignored `.local-tools/`; prefix commands with `tools/local-env.sh`:

```sh
tools/bootstrap-local.sh
tools/local-env.sh cmake --preset linux-debug -DMJ_SMOKE_TESTS=ON
tools/local-env.sh cmake --build --preset linux-debug --parallel 4
tools/local-env.sh ctest --preset linux-debug
tools/local-env.sh ./build/linux-debug/game/microjump
```

The wrapper provides local tool/library paths and a documented Fontconfig-only LSan
suppression for the system Wayland GTK decoration plugin. All other leak checks stay
active. Sanitized builds link SDL's X11 backend directly so Xlib cache roots remain
visible to LSan. See [M0 evidence](docs/m0-evidence.md) and [M1 evidence](docs/m1-evidence.md).

## Controls and capture

| Keyboard / mouse | Gamepad | Action |
| --- | --- | --- |
| W / A / S / D | Left stick | Move (camera-relative) |
| Space | A (south) | Jump; hold for height |
| Ctrl | — | Walk |
| Mouse | Right stick | Orbit the camera (mouse is captured while focused) |
| R / Home | Back | Respawn at the last checkpoint |
| F1 | — | Toggle the diagnostics/movement overlay |
| F2 | Start | Movement and camera tuning window (frees the mouse) |
| F3 | — | Free-flight camera (WASD/QE, Shift fast, Home reset) |
| Escape / close | — | Exit |

The overlay shows FPS/frame time, pixel resolution, effective VSync and cap state, plus
movement state, speed, position, ground angle and checkpoint. VSync is FIFO with no
application FPS cap for now; display-setting controls and persistence are M5. The
simulation runs at a fixed 120 Hz with interpolated rendering, so render rate never
changes movement.

```sh
./build/linux-debug/game/microjump --frames 60
./build/linux-debug/game/microjump --capture-frame 12 --capture-out captures/scene.png
# Record every simulation tick's input on exit, then replay it (exits when it ends).
./build/linux-debug/game/microjump --record captures/run.mjr
./build/linux-debug/game/microjump --replay captures/run.mjr
# Correctness fixtures: camera movement and two live resizes before capture.
./build/linux-debug/game/microjump --camera-test --capture-frame 36 --capture-out captures/camera.png
./build/linux-debug/game/microjump --resize-test --capture-frame 16 --c

# BloomCraft

Bosses, relics, pets, quests and skills as one Fabric mod, for singleplayer worlds and small worlds with friends
(Open to LAN). It's the mod version of the Additional Bosses, BloomPets and QuestBook server plugins.

Minecraft 26.3, Fabric Loader 0.19.5+, Fabric API. Java 25.

1. In the CurseForge app, make (or open) a **Fabric 26.3** profile and add **Fabric API** to it.

`/version` isn't a thing in singleplayer, so the build number is shown in the mod list and in the log when the game
starts (`BloomCraft 1.0.0-b12+abc1234 loading`).

Being built in stages:

1. **Bosses** (in progress): bosses, relics, souls, totems, Nemesis.
2. Pets.
3. Quest Book and the inventory/skills HUD.
4. Skills (an mcMMO-style system of its own).

AlfieRadcliffe/DoodleGolf.readme:
# Doodle Golf ⛳✏️

An online party game: mini golf on notebook pages, where every player sabotages the course with hand-drawn traps.
Inspired by Ultimate Chicken Horse. By **Alfie Radcliffe**. All the art will be drawn by hand on paper and scanned in.

> Status: **playable pass-and-play prototype**: 2–6 players on one device, a character creator, 6 clubs,
> 10 pages, 10 traps and bombs. Online multiplayer is next.

## How a game goes

1. **Set up:** choose 2–6 players and the points target (15, 25 or 40).
2. **Make your golfer:** each player uses the arrows to pick a hair/hat, face, shirt and trousers
   (tinted in their pen colour), plus a **club**. Every club has its own ability.
3. **Pages and rounds.** You play the same page for several rounds, and **traps stay on the page**, so it gets
   harder every round. Each round:
   1. **Trap phase.** Everyone is dealt 3 items, picks one and places it. Some rotate (<kbd>R</kbd> or right-click).
      Can't fit it anywhere? Hit **skip**.
   2. **Putt phase.** Everyone starts from the tee. Take turns, one stroke at a time, **4 strokes max** each.
      Drag back from anywhere and let go, like a slingshot. Your golfer swings the club for you.
   3. **Scoring.**
      - Sink the ball → **+3**, plus **+1** for each stroke you had left.
      - **Fewest shots** → **+2** for whoever sank it in the fewest strokes (ties share it).
      - **If everyone sinks it, the sink points don't count.** The page was too easy, so make your traps meaner.
        (Beating someone's stroke count still earns **+1**.)
      - Your trap touches someone who then misses → **+1** for you.
4. **When a page gets impossible** (nobody sinks it 2 rounds in a row), or after 6 rounds, it's torn out and you
   move to a fresh page.
5. First to the points target wins.

### Bombs

Dealt once there are at least two things on the page. Drop one and everything placed inside the blast circle is
destroyed (the page's own walls survive), leaving a scorch mark. Great for clearing a path, or for wrecking
someone else's trap.

### Clubs

| Club | Ability |
|---|---|
| Trusty putter | No tricks. Steady and reliable |
| Ruler | The aim line shows where your ball will roll (a bit weaker) |
| Pencil driver | +25% power, but your aim wobbles a little |
| Highlighter | Glides straight through ink blots and coffee rings |
| Rubber mallet | Extra bouncy off walls and springs |
| Paperclip magnet | The hole pulls your ball in when it's close |

### Traps

Basic walls are dealt most often; the nastiest gadgets are rare.

| Trap | Rarity | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| Pencil wall | common | A pencil lying across the page. Blocks the way |
| Ruler | common | A long straight wall |
| Ink blot | common | Sticky: the ball slows right down |
| Eraser | uncommon | A chunky block the ball bounces off |
| Spring | uncommon | Bouncy bumper that fires the ball off fast |
| Highlighter streak | uncommon | A speed strip that shoves the ball along it |
| Coffee ring | rare | Curves the ball round in a circle |
| Pencil sharpener | rare | Pulls the ball towards it like a tiny black hole |
| Scissors | rare | Snip! Touch them and you're back at the tee |
| Hole punch | rare | Two linked holes: in one, out the other |

### Pages

Warm-up, Snake, Windmill, Funnel, The Box, Two Rooms, Pinball, Spiral, Zig-zag and Double Trouble.
Windmill and Double Trouble have spinning rulers pinned to the page, like crazy-golf windmills.

## Milestones

- [x] Pick the game idea and sketch the rules
- [x] **1. Single player:** a ball on a canvas you can drag to putt, with friction and wall bounces
- [x] **2. Courses:** walls and a hole loaded from a level file; sinking the ball
- [x] **3. Traps:** place traps and make them affect the ball
- [x] **Golfers:** character creator, clubs with abilities, swing animation
- [ ] **4. Lobby:** a Node.js server; create a room, share a code, see who's joined
- [ ] **5. Multiplayer:** turns and shots synced between everyone's browsers

NellasTerton/skytec-metacritic.readme:
# Metacritic Games

Сервис раз в час забирает новые игры с Metacritic, сохраняет карточки с оценками по
платформам, пишет LLM-резюме отзывов критиков и игроков и показывает всё это на сайте.

Тестовое задание Skytec Games (AI Automation Engineer). Бюджет нулевой: только бесплатные
тарифы, без карты.

## Архитектура

```
GitHub Actions (cron + workflow_dispatch)          Vercel (FastAPI)
  python -m app.worker run                          app/main.py: сайт и API
    ├─ backend.metacritic.com (app/metacritic)          │
    └─ Neon Postgres  <─────────────────────────────────┘
```

- `app/metacritic/` — клиент внутреннего API Metacritic (официального API нет). Как он
  устроен и где подвохи: [docs/metacritic-research.md](docs/metacritic-research.md).
- `app/models.py`, `migrations/` — схема БД, Alembic.
- `app/media.py` — трейлер с YouTube (поиск через yt-dlp, без API-ключа) и скриншоты из Steam
  Store API: у Metacritic видео есть не у всех игр, а скриншотов нет вовсе.
- `app/main.py` — сайт (Vercel находит `app` автоматически): список с поиском при вводе,
  фильтром по платформе и сортировкой, карточка игры с похожими играми, `/monitor` —
  мониторинг воркера в реальном времени и кнопка «Запустить сейчас».
- `app/worker/` — воркер; запускается в GitHub Actions ([.github/workflows/worker.yml](.github/workflows/worker.yml)).
- Почему так и какие у бесплатных тарифов лимиты: [docs/infrastructure.md](docs/infrastructure.md).

## Локальный запуск

```bash
python -m venv .venv
.venv/Scripts/pip install -r requirements-dev.txt   # Linux/macOS: .venv/bin/pip
cp .env.example .env                                 # вписать строки подключения Neon
alembic upgrade head
python -m app.worker new-releases                    # без БД: список New Releases
python -m app.worker game elden-ring                 # без БД: карточка игры в JSON
python -m app.worker run                             # прогон с записью в БД
python -m app.worker summarize --limit 20            # резюме для игр в БД, у которых их нет
python -m app.worker media --limit 40                # трейлеры и скриншоты для игр без них
uvicorn app.main:app --reload                        # сайт на http://127.0.0.1:8000
```

## Тесты

```bash
pytest                    # офлайн, на фикстурах из tests/fixtures/metacritic
python -m scripts.capture_fixtures   # обновить фикстуры
```

Тесты БД запускаются, только если задан `DATABASE_URL` в окружении (не из .env).

## Деплой

- **Neon:** создать проект, `DATABASE_URL` (pooled) и `DATABASE_URL_UNPOOLED` (direct).
- **GitHub Actions:** те же две строки и `GROQ_API_KEY` в Settings → Secrets → Actions.
  Без ключа LLM воркер работает, но резюме отзывов не пишет.
- **Vercel:** `DATABASE_URL`, `CRON_SECRET` и `GITHUB_DISPATCH_TOKEN` в переменных окружения проекта. В Deployment Protection
  отключить Vercel Authentication, иначе сайт будет закрыт логином.
- **Ежечасный запуск:** задача на cron-job.org раз в час делает `GET https://<сайт>/api/cron`
  с заголовком `Authorization: Bearer <CRON_SECRET>` (подробно в docs/infrastructure.md).

# Swarm battle

A playable prototype: four players, planets producing glowing units, swarms flying between planets,
capture and annihilation. Blue is yours: tap or click one of your planets to select it (Shift adds; tap it again to let go),
then another planet to send half of the selected units there (the selection then clears); keys 1–0 set the share. You see only what your planets can see: the rest is fogged, remembered as last seen.

Built with Godot 4.7.2 (web export, single-threaded). Play: https://dveyarangi.github.io/swarm-battle/

dtghgthf/BrowserGame.readme:
# Leuchtturmwärter

**Ein Koop-Browserspiel für 2–4 Leute – ohne Sprache, mit Teamwork.**
Bringt euer Schiff gemeinsam durch Sturm, Nebel und Kraken-Angriffe zum Leuchtturm.

### ▶ Jetzt spielen: **https://game.echterhofflabs.me**

![Scheinwerfer im Nebel](screenshots/chromium-07-scheinwerfer-nebel.png)

| | | |
|---|---|---|
| ![](screenshots/chromium-13-felsen-scheinwerfer.png) | ![](screenshots/chromium-14-krake-kanone.png) | ![](screenshots/chromium-15-ankunft.png) |
| ![](screenshots/chromium-16-seekarte.png) | ![](screenshots/chromium-04-licht-mitteldeck.png) | ![](screenshots/chromium-11-lobby.png) |

## Worum geht's?

Das Schiff ist ein Querschnitt mit drei Decks. Jede Person übernimmt Aufgaben an den Stationen:

- **Steuerrad** – Felsen ausweichen; die Seekarte zeigt den Kurs (gelb) und Felsen im Weg (rot)
- **Scheinwerfer** – im Mastkorb den Nebel absuchen, damit Felsen und der Krake früh entdeckt werden
- **Kanone** – Felsen zerschießen und den Kraken verjagen
- **Pumpe & Werkbank** – Wasser abpumpen, Planken holen, Lecks flicken

Je näher der Leuchtturm, desto stärker der Sturm. Reden ist nicht nötig: Pings markieren Stellen für alle, die Figuren rufen automatisch („Felsen!“, „Krake!“, „Ruder!“).

## Steuerung

| | Tastatur | Touch (iPad) |
|---|---|---|
| Laufen / Leiter | A/D, W/S | Stick |
| Springen | Leertaste | ⤒ |
| Station, Luke, Reparieren | E | E |
| Tragen, Kanone feuern | F | F |
| Ping | Rechtsklick / Q | ❗ |
| Menü / Ton aus | Esc / M | ☰ |

Online: „Neues Schiff“ erzeugt einen Raumcode aus 4 Buchstaben, die anderen treten damit bei. „Allein üben“ geht ohne Server.

## Technik

- **TypeScript**, npm-Workspaces: `shared/` (deterministische Simulation, kein DOM), `client/`, `server/`
- **PixiJS v8** (WebGL2): Low-Res-Pixel-Rendering (~480×270) mit eigener Licht-Pipeline – Sichtbarkeits-Polygone, Normal Maps, Nebel-Shader
- **Rapier2D** für die Physik; das Schiff rollt, die Schwerkraft wird stattdessen gedreht
- **Colyseus**: autoritativer Server, Client-Side-Prediction mit Reconciliation, kompakte Binär-Snapshots
- Platzhalter-Grafiken und -Sounds werden per Skript erzeugt (`npm run assets`)

## Lokal starten

Voraussetzung: Node.js 22+

```bash
npm install
npm run dev     # Spiel-Server (Port 2567) + Client auf http://localhost:5173
```

Weitere Befehle: `npm test`, `npm run typecheck`, `npm run build`, `npm run verify` (Browser-Tests mit Playwright).
Für den Online-Betrieb: Client als statische Seite (`VITE_SERVER_URL=wss://…`), Server per `server/Dockerfile` / `fly.toml`.

Designentscheidungen stehen in [`DECISIONS.md`](DECISIONS.md), der Entwicklungsplan in [`PLAN.md`](PLAN.md), die Asset-Konventionen in [`client/public/assets/README.md`](client/public/assets/README.md).

maxvbuda/fight.readme:
# Neon Brawl

A 3D fighting game that runs in the browser, built with [three.js](https://threejs.org). There are no build steps and no asset files.

**Play:** https://maxvbuda.github.io/fight/

## Modes

- **Fight the CPU**: Easy, Normal, or Hard.
- **2 players, one keyboard**: local versus.
- **Online**: one player hosts and gets a 5-letter room code, and the other player enters it to join. Connections are peer-to-peer over WebRTC ([PeerJS](https://peerjs.com)). The host runs the simulation, and the guest sends inputs and renders the host's state.

## Apple Watch

Open the link on an Apple Watch (for example, by sending it to yourself in Messages and tapping it). Small screens and browsers without WebGL load `watch.html`, a lightweight edition that draws the same 3D fighters on a 2D canvas. You can fight the CPU, or join an online room that a friend hosts from the full game. Type the room code on the watch menu and tap Join. You play as VOLT. Online play on the watch needs a browser that supports WebRTC.

Controls:

- **◀ ▶**: move. Holding away from your opponent blocks.
- **P / K**: punch and kick.
- **SUPER**: a gold button that appears when your meter is full. Tap it to unleash the super.
- **Tap the arena**: jump.

To force the full version on a small screen, add `?full` to the URL.

## Controls

| Action | Player 1 / solo / online | Player 2 (local) | Gamepad |
|---|---|---|---|
| Move | A / D | ← / → | Left stick |
| Sidestep | W / S | ↑ / ↓ | Left stick |
| Jump | Space | Right Shift / Num 0 | A |
| Punch | J or F | , / Num 1 | X |
| Kick | K or G | . / Num 2 | Y |
| Block (hold) | L or H | / / Num 3 | RB |
| Super (full meter) | U or R | ; / Num 4 | B |

After you land a hit, press punch or kick again to chain a combo. Damage dealt and damage taken both fill the super meter. Matches are best of three rounds, and each round lasts 99 seconds.

## Run locally

```sh
python3 -m http.server
# open http://localhost:8000
```

# 电光年华（Electric Years）

校园题材的独立 RPG，第一张地图是电子科技大学清水河校区。引擎为 Godot 4.7.2 .NET（C#），只做 PC，三渲二画风。

- 开发文档：[docs/design/README.md](docs/design/README.md)
- Godot C# API 参考：[docs/godot-api/README.md](docs/godot-api/README.md)
- 清理前的网页版地图：标签 `baseline-map`

这是个人创作的实验作品，不是电子科技大学的官方作品，与学校没有关联。场景中的校园以真实地形为参考做了艺术化处理；校徽等受保护的标志不原样使用。

## 许可

- **代码与脚本**：MIT，见 [LICENSE](LICENSE)。
- **原创美术、音频、文案与设计文档**（含 `docs/design/`）：保留所有权利，未经许可不得复用。
- **地图数据**：来自 OpenStreetMap，© OpenStreetMap contributors，按 ODbL 1.0 授权。`data/` 下的快照与补充数据，以及由它们生成的数据集，也按 ODbL 提供；每个公开版本另附对应的地图数据包。
- **第三方素材**（字体、音频、插件等）：按各自的许可，清单见各资源目录的登记文件。

darren-rawlings/UltimateTicTacToe.readme:
# Ultimate Tic-Tac-Toe

Starting point for a new Renegade Games title: a Godot 4.7 C# project for Android phones with
everything Counter Fire needed already wired up.

- **Shared library** [renegade-core](https://github.com/darren-rawlings/renegade-core) at
  `addons/renegade_core` (git submodule): ads, synthesised sound, developer tools, and the
  [release playbook](https://github.com/darren-rawlings/renegade-core/blob/main/docs/RELEASE_PLAYBOOK.md).
- **AdMob** via the Poing Studios plugin (`addons/admob`), Google's test ads until real IDs exist,
  child-directed by default; a stand-in ad on desktop.
- **Android export** preset with Gradle build and adaptive launcher icons.
- **Tests** for the engine-free rules code (`src/Core`) and **GitHub CI**.

## Start a new game

```
gh repo create darren-rawlings/<repo> --public --template darren-rawlings/renegade-game-template --clone
cd <repo>
git submodule update --init
powershell -File tools/New-Game.ps1 -Title "Mancala" -CodeName Mancala -PackageId mancala
```

Then design in `docs/DESIGN.md`, replace the table in `src/Game/Main.cs` with the game, and draw
the icon in `assets/icon/*.svg` (render with `tools/Render-Icons.ps1`).

## Run

- Desktop: open in Godot, or F5 in VS Code ("Play UltimateTicTacToe").
- Developer flags after `--`: `--log`, `--demo`, `--quit-after-demo`, `--games-since-ad=4`.
  On a phone, push them as lines of `files/dev_args.txt` (see renegade-core's playbook).
- Android build (first create the output folder: `mkdir build/android`):
  `Godot.exe --headless --path . --install-android-build-template --export-debug "Android" build/android/UltimateTicTacToe.apk`

## Layout

| Folder | What goes there |
|---|---|
| `src/Core` | Rules: plain C#, no Godot types, unit tested |
| `src/Game` | Scene, input, visuals, sound, HUD |
| `tests/` | xUnit tests for `src/Core` |
| `assets/icon` | Icon SVG sources and rendered PNGs |
| `tools/` | `New-Game.ps1`, `Render-Icons.ps1` |
| `docs/` | `DESIGN.md` for this game |

# Game Hub

One library for every game installed on your Windows PC.

## Download

**[Download GameHubSetup.exe](https://github.com/Sentral-Hub/game-hub-releases/releases/latest/download/GameHubSetup.exe)** and double-click it. Nothing else is needed: Python comes built in.

It installs just for your Windows account (no administrator rights), adds Game Hub to your Start menu, and appears in Windows Settings → Apps for uninstalling.

Windows may show "Windows protected your PC" the first time, because the installer isn't signed. Click **More info**, then **Run anyway**.

### Running without installing

If you already have Python 3.12 or newer, you can also download `game_hub.py` and `Start Game Hub.bat` into one folder and double-click **Start Game Hub.bat**.

Game Hub updates itself. When a new version is ready, it shows **Update ready** in the sidebar.

# jogo-estacoes (nome de trabalho)

Jogo de sobrevivência e gerenciamento em que cada estação é uma ameaça diferente. Alvo: venda na Steam.

## Engine
- **Godot 4.7.2-stable**, build padrão (GDScript, sem .NET). Versão fixada: só atualizar em fronteira de fase, após checar compatibilidade da integração com a Steam.

## Estrutura
| Pasta | Conteúdo |
|---|---|
| `data/` | Números de balanceamento e textos (nada de número hardcoded no código) |
| `scenes/` | Cenas `.tscn` |
| `scripts/` | GDScript, 1 sistema por arquivo |
| `assets/` | Arte, áudio e fontes — origem e licença registradas em CREDITOS.md |

## Fluxo
- `main` protegida; trabalho em branches `feat/...`, commits pequenos.
- Sem segredos no repositório (chaves Steamworks, tokens).
- Design, decisões e estado do projeto ficam fora do repo (ESTADO, DECISOES, BACKLOG, GDD).

natemiller39/Snake-D.readme:
# SNAKE'D

A trick-taking card game with frogs, dragonflies and snakes. Predict how many tricks you'll win with the last card you hold face up, and use the snakes to steal the lead.

This repository holds the digital playtest version: you against 1–5 computer players, played on a table on top of an Aztec step pyramid.

## Play it

Open `index.html` in a browser. There is nothing to install or build.

To host it, turn on **GitHub Pages** for this repository (Settings → Pages → deploy from the `main` branch, root folder). The game will be live at `https://natemiller39.github.io/Snake-D/`.

## Rules

See [docs/RULES.md](docs/RULES.md). The in-game **Rules** button has the same summary.

## What's in here

| Path | What it is |
|---|---|
| `index.html` | The game: table, animations, your hand, setup and score screens |
| `engine.js` | Rules engine and computer players (no browser code, runs in Node too) |
| `img/` | Card art: 55 cards (red volcano, blue lily pad, green jungle, pink hibiscus, black snakes) and the card back |
| `tools/simulate.js` | Plays thousands of computer-only games and prints stats (`node tools/simulate.js`) |
| `docs/RULES.md` | The full rules |

## Notes

- Card art © the SNAKE'D designer. All rights reserved.

# Separation Golf

Separation Golf is a daily baseball puzzle. Connect any two big leaguers by jumping teammate to teammate. Fewest jumps wins: eagle the shortest route, or bogey your way there. Daily hole, Daily 9, Endless and Custom modes, with every MLB roster since 1871.

Play: https://dompescamedia.github.io/separation-golf/

## How it's built

- `index.html` is the whole game (HTML, CSS and JavaScript in one file). It runs in the browser with no server.
- `data.json` holds every player and team-season roster. `cards/*.json` hold the stats for the baseball cards.
- `scripts/build.py` and `scripts/build_stats.py` rebuild those files from the [Lahman Baseball Database](https://sabr.org/lahman-database/) (via the `pylahman` Python package).
- The site is served by GitHub Pages straight from the `main` branch.
- Player headshots load from MLB's image server by MLB ID. `.github/workflows/mlbam-ids.yml` refreshes `mlbam.json` (Baseball-Reference ID to MLB ID, from the Chadwick Bureau register), and `tools/add_mlbam.py` writes those IDs into `data.json`. Run it again after rebuilding `data.json`.

hlovestad/Dungeon-Degenerates.readme:
# Dungeon Degenerates

A funny, short (15-25 min) party roguelike for four friends, played in a phone browser.
Pixel-art heroes physically walk the dungeon, fight in staged turn-based battles,
gamble at the Goblin Casino and get probed by aliens.

**Play:** https://hlovestad.github.io/Dungeon-Degenerates/ (hold your phone sideways)

## Status: v0.1 prototype

- Single device: one phone controls all four heroes (hotseat). Online lobby comes later.
- All art is generated **placeholder** pixel art. Real art from ChatGPT drops in by filename.
- Content: node map (8 rows), fights, elites, alien fights, boss (The Dungeon Landlord),
  Goblin Market, Goblin Casino, campfire, treasure/mimics, and events
  (Boulder of Pride, Dani Needs to Talk, The Devil's Offer, Goblin Toll).

## New in v0.3: it's a party game now

- Every friend has their own purse. Most **Crowns** at the end wins the night (buy them at the casino Crown Counter, boss MVP, bonus crowns).
- The room picker rotates each room and keeps that room's loot.
- Kill bounties: the gold from a kill goes to whoever landed it. Damage MVP gets a bonus.
- A **showdown minigame after every room** (Quick Draw, Mash Off, High Card, Pick a Chest, Hot Potato, Split or Steal, Goblin Derby, Stop the Clock).
- **Wheel of Misfortune** rooms: Mario Party Chance Time.
- **Dirty cards** to screw your friends: Tax, Pickpocket, Swap, Skip, Double Down, Reverse.
- Casino on most rows, everyone bets their own gold, ALL IN button.
- End screen: Mario Party style bonus crowns, then the Biggest Degenerate.
- Full minigame list and ideas: [docs/MINIGAMES.md](docs/MINIGAMES.md)

## New in v0.2

- Every battle button says what it does.
- Battles are dumber now: joke intros, hero one-liners, enemy last words, and random fight rules (Greased Floor, Hype Man, Haakon's Mom Is Watching, Cursed Cheese, Nap Time).
- Josh hides in a bush during dog fights until half the dogs are down.
- Minigames: a power meter on every ability (hit the gold for a stronger move), a dodge prompt on the Landlord's rent attack, The Idiot's Trial (trivia room) and Whack-a-Goblin (Mike's cousins cost you gold).

## Racial hooks that are already in the game

| Hero | In combat | Outside combat |
| --- | --- | --- |
| **Haakon** | +30% physical damage, takes 15% less, opening blow +25%. Can't Defend, only **Flex** (taunts every enemy). | Boulder of Pride: lifts it alone, refuses to walk away. |
| **Mike** | Goblins sometimes refuse to hit him. Non-goblins hit him 12% harder. | 30% off at the Goblin Market, free casino spin, talks his way past the Goblin Toll. |
| **Josh** | Exposes one enemy weak spot each fight. **Probed** in every alien fight (accuracy tanks). | Third eye reveals the whole map. |
| **Griffin** | Chances of 10% or less are doubled (Long Shot, crits). **Dani** sometimes heals or blasts, sometimes **Pussywhipped** (loses turn). | Casino long shots doubled. Date night event. |

## Run it locally

Any static server works. From the project folder (Windows PowerShell):

```powershell
python -m http.server 8000
```

Then open http://localhost:8000. Opening `index.html` directly from disk won't work (browsers block module scripts on `file://`).

## Adding real art

See [docs/ART_PIPELINE.md](docs/ART_PIPELINE.md). Short version:

```powershell
python tools/process_art.py "C:\path\to\chatgpt_batch"
```

## Project layout

```
index.html            entry point (loads Phaser + src/main.js)
lib/phaser.min.js     Phaser 3.90 (vendored, no build step)
src/config.js         resolution, colours, sprite heights, battle positions
src/data/             races, classes, enemies, items  <- tune numbers here
src/systems/          run state, map generator, combat rules (no Phaser)
src/scenes/           Title, Party, Map, Battle, Shop, Casino, Event, End
src/art/              placeholder sprite/background generators + texture registry
assets/manifest.json  list of real art files (overrides placeholders)
tools/process_art.py  cleans ChatGPT art

Kwoolford/wardogs-radio.desc: Play GTA-style radio or Spotify through your WARDOGS proximity mic using SteelSeries Sonar
Kwoolford/wardogs-radio.readme:
# WARDOGS Radio

Play GTA-style radio stations (or your Spotify) **through your in-game mic** in [WARDOGS](https://store.steampowered.com/search/?term=wardogs), so everyone in proximity chat gets a soundtrack while you fly. Your voice stays separate for Discord.

A small always-on-top Windows GUI built on **SteelSeries Sonar**'s Streamer mode. No virtual-cable installs needed if you already use Sonar.

![midnight purple GUI with station list, on-air toggles and volume sliders](docs/screenshot.png)

## Features

- **Station list.** GTA V stations (Non-Stop-Pop FM, Los Santos Rock Radio, West Coast Classics, Radio Mirror Park, Channel X) pulled from YouTube full-station uploads, plus live internet radio. Edit `stations.json` to add your own.
- **"Join mid-broadcast".** Starts long station uploads at a random point, like tuning in to a radio in GTA.
- **Car-radio sound.** An optional band-pass and compressor filter.
- **Music ON AIR** toggle and volume (what others hear), and **Hear radio in my headset** toggle and volume (what you hear). These are independent, so you can broadcast the radio while listening to something else.
- **Spotify ON AIR** for song requests. Spotify gets its own lane, with separate "on-air" and "in my headset" sliders. Keep Spotify's own volume at **100%** and set the levels in the GUI: Sonar can only turn a source down, so a quiet Spotify means a quiet broadcast.
- **My voice in game.** Turn it off and the game gets music only, while you talk on Discord.
- **K toggles proximity mic.** Tap K to go live and tap again to stop. This only applies while the WARDOGS window is focused. You get beeps and a LIVE indicator.
- **Global hotkeys (Ctrl+Alt+…).** R music on-air, H headset, V voice, N next station, X play/stop, S Spotify.
- **Auto-launch.** An optional watcher opens the GUI when WARDOGS starts. The GUI closes itself (and cleans up) when the game exits.

## How it works

```
Radio (ffplay) ──┐
Spotify (opt.) ──┼─► Sonar "Media" ──┬─► Stream mix ──► "Sonar - Stream" mic ──► WARDOGS voice chat
Your voice ──────┼───────────────────┘
                 │
Game, Discord ───┴─► Personal mix ──► your headphones (+ Media, if "hear radio" is on)
```

Sonar's Streamer mode builds a second mix and exposes it as a recording device. The script talks to Sonar's local HTTP API to:

- put only **Mic + Media** in that stream mix (game sound and Discord never leak into it),
- route the radio player and Spotify to the Media channel,
- route WARDOGS's mic input to the Stream device. WARDOGS's voice chat uses the Windows default mic regardless of its own menu setting, so the script overrides it per-app.

## Requirements

- Windows 10/11, Windows PowerShell 5.1 (built in)
- [SteelSeries GG](https://steelseries.com/gg) with **Sonar** enabled
- [FFmpeg](https://ffmpeg.org/) (for `ffplay`): `winget install Gyan.FFmpeg`
- [yt-dlp](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp) (for YouTube stations): `winget install yt-dlp.yt-dlp`

## Setup

1. Clone or download this repo anywhere.
2. Run **`Launch WardogsRadio.cmd`**.
3. Click **Set up Sonar**. This switches Sonar to Streamer mode and configures the mixes. Your current headset and mic are detected automatically, so do this while Sonar is in Classic mode the first time.
4. Pick a station, press **Play**, and tick **Music ON AIR**.
5. In WARDOGS, use proximity chat (hold K, or tap K with the toggle enabled).

**Optional auto-launch:** put a shortcut to `WardogsRadioWatcher.ps1` in your Startup folder (`Win+R` → `shell:startup`) with this target:

```
powershell.exe -NoProfile -WindowStyle Hidden -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File "C:\path\to\WardogsRadioWatcher.ps1"
```

**Going back to normal:** click **Sonar back to Classic**. While Sonar is in Classic mode the Stream mic doesn't exist, so the game's mic routing returns to normal.

## Notes and caveats

- **Etiquette:** proximity chat reaches everyone nearby, enemies included. Keep the on-air volume reasonable. **Ctrl+Alt+R** is your kill switch.

anthonypatryn/tech-no-bowl.desc: Digital recreation of the game Tech No Bowl
anthonypatryn/tech-no-bowl.readme:
# TECHNO BOWL

8-bit tabletop football from the More Fun! League, in the browser. Every player is a cube on a 3D field, every play
is a stack of five cards, and the dice decide the hits. Built from the official print-and-play files and played by
the rulebook.

**Play:** https://tech-no-bowl.vercel.app

## What's in it
- **Every rule mode:** Techno (7-vs-7), All Techno (the 25 special abilities), Pro and All Pro (8-vs-8, field goals),
  and Inferno (fire tokens, On Fire, En Fuego, Fire Bomb, Bring the Heat, dirty hits, dogpiles).
- **32 teams** with their real uniforms, helmets, ability players and alternate lineups.
- **The computer coach** at three levels: Rookie, Starter, All-Pro.
- **Online:** host a room, send the 5-letter code (or the invite link), play a friend. Others can watch.
- **Season** with standings and an 8-team playoff to the Techno Bowl. **Tutorial**, searchable **rules**, a
  **playbook** of preset formations, odds on every action, undo, a coach's suggestion, quick play, fast-forward.
- **TV presentation:** opening show, score bug, chyrons, cinematic cameras for big throws, hits, sacks, touchdowns
  and specials, instant replays, crowd and whistles, NFL TV themes, and a jukebox of 24 ESPN Primetime tracks.
- Works on desktop, iPad and phones; installable to the home screen; colour-blind mode; rebindable keys.

## Pages
| Link | What |
|---|---|
| `/` | Home |
| `?view=teams` | Play the computer |
| `?view=tutorial` | Guided first game |
| `?view=season` | Season and playoffs |
| `?view=online` | Play a friend |
| `?view=rules` | How to play |
| `?view=settings` | Settings (sound, music, text size, keys, motion, colour-blind mode) |
| `?view=art` | Art Review Board (verdicts need the PIN) |
| `?view=review` | Moment review: every cinematic, one at a time |
| `?view=moments` | Moment Lab: fire any cinematic |
| `?view=sounds` | Sound editor |
| `?view=bugs` | Bug list (PIN) |

## Run it locally
```
npm install
npm run dev          # http://localhost:5192
```
| Script | What |
|---|---|
| `npm run dev` / `build` / `preview` | Vite |
| `npm run lint` | oxlint |
| `npm test` | The rules tests (the rulebook's worked examples, every skill, field goals, Inferno) |
| `npm run sim -- 300` | 300 computer-vs-computer games with invariant checks (`node tools/simulate.mjs N seed mode rules`) |
| `npm run art` | Rebuild `public/art/` from the print-and-play files (Python: PyMuPDF, OpenCV, Pillow) |
| `python tools/cut_music.py <file>` | Cut the ESPN compilation into `public/music/` |

The print-and-play source files (PDF / JPG) live in the project root and are not committed (purchased art). The web
textures made from them under `public/art/` are.

## Deploy
Push to `main`; Vercel builds and deploys. Server-side pieces are small Vercel functions in `api/` (bug reports, art
verdicts, sound editor saves, the online relay). Environment variables: see `CLAUDE.md`.

## Docs
- `docs/ARCHITECTURE.md`: how the engine, screen, 3D board, sound and online play fit together
- `docs/CONTENT.md`: art, sound and music pipelines, and the review and bug workflows
- `docs/PLAN.md`: the build plan and what each batch delivered
- `docs/rules-and-rosters.md`: the rules and all 32 rosters, transcribed

GameAnalytics

Аналитика выходящих видеоигр по данным Metacritic: новинки каждый час, сводки отзывов критиков и игроков, суть игры, похожие игры и разбор летсплеев с YouTube.

--- ## Возможности - **Новинки каждый час.** Блок New Releases с главной Metacritic и весь каталог за последние три дня. Ничего не теряется: каждое окно дат сверяется с итогом API. - **Сводки отзывов.** Модель Gemini отдельно сводит рецензии критиков и отзывы игроков: - что понравилось, что нет; - дословные цитаты; - технические проблемы; - пропорции мнений по всем оценкам. Модель читает только новые отзывы и не чаще раза в сутки. - **Суть игры.** Жанр, игровой цикл, механики, сеттинг и теги из закрытого словаря. Строится для каждой игры с описанием, даже пока отзывов нет. - **Похожие игры по сути, а не по жанру.** Векторы игрового процесса и мира плюс теги. Для каждой рекомендации видно, чем игры похожи; игры одной серии вынесены в отдельный блок. - **Deep analyze.** По кнопке модель находит популярное прохождение на YouTube, смотрит около 20 минут его отрезков по ссылке и выделяет факты, которых нет в описании магазина. Каждый факт — ссылка на нужную секунду видео. - **DevPanel.** Работа пайплайна в реальном времени: какой узел активен, сколько запросов, где ошибки. - **Работа на бесплатных ключах Google.** Темп запросов, дневной бюджет токенов и пул глубоких анализов рассчитаны так, чтобы работа сервиса всегда шла первой. --- ## Содержание - [Архитектура](#архитектура) - [Как это работает](#как-это-работает) - [Поиск новых игр](#поиск-новых-игр) - [Приём игры](#приём-игры) - [Частота обновления](#частота-обновления) - [Сводки отзывов](#сводки-отзывов) - [Суть игры](#суть-игры) - [Похожие игры](#похожие-игры) - [Deep analyze](#deep-analyze) - [Квоты](#квоты) - [Модель данных](#модель-данных) - [API](#api) - [Интерфейс](#интерфейс) - [Стек технологий](#стек-технологий) - [Внешние сервисы и их лимиты](#внешние-сервисы-и-их-лимиты) - [Надёжность](#надёжность) - [Тестирование](#тестирование) - [Обоснование решений](#обоснование-решений) - [Ограничения](#ограничения) - [Запуск](#запуск) - [Настройки](#настройки) - [Структура репозитория](#структура-репозитория) --- ## Архитектура ```mermaid flowchart LR cron["cron воркера

natanielmartinsoliveira/guilda-ai.readme:
# Guilda AI

A self-hosted AI development team for one developer working for several companies. Cards come in (Jira, Businessmap, GitHub Issues, the panel or VS Code), an isolated agent (Claude Code, Codex, Gemini or OpenRouter models) implements them, the project's tests, security checks and an AI review run, and a draft PR/MR opens on GitHub, Bitbucket or GitLab. It never merges.

Each developer runs **their own instance**. Everything that belongs to a company — hosts, card sources, projects, AI policy, prompts, PR and evidence formats, even its own way of working — lives in a **company pack**: a private git repository the company's developers share. The core has no company in it.

> Documentação em português: [docs/pt-BR/guide.md](docs/pt-BR/guide.md).

## How it works

```
 card source            Guilda AI (your machine)                      code host
 ───────────            ─────────────────────────                     ─────────
 Jira / Businessmap ─┐   API (NestJS) ── PostgreSQL (state, outbox)
 GitHub Issues ──────┼─▶   │                  │
 panel / VS Code ────┘     ▼                  ▼
                         RabbitMQ ──▶ worker ──▶ agent in a sandbox (bubblewrap)
                                        │        or in the company's Coder workspace
                                        ├─▶ project tests (container) + security checks
                                        ├─▶ AI review (another model, read-only)
                                        └─▶ commit ──▶ push ──▶ draft PR/MR ──▶ GitHub / Bitbucket / GitLab
                                        ▲
 you: panel (/app), Telegram, VS Code (MCP) — answer questions, retry, request changes
```

- **Decisions, not guesses.** When the AI has a question, or a task fails, the task waits for you in the panel, on Telegram or in VS Code; your answer resumes it.
- **Many AI credentials, one policy per company.** Providers the company's contract allows, roles (planner, coder, fixer, reviewer, frontend), and automatic fallback when a credential runs out.
- **Company methods.** A company can replace the core flow with its own phases, gates and scripts ([docs/methods.md](docs/methods.md)), checked by `npm run method:check`.
- **Code that may not leave the company** runs in the company's [Coder](https://coder.com) workspace; only metadata comes back ([docs/coder.md](docs/coder.md)).

## Quick start

Requirements: Linux or WSL2 with working user namespaces and [bubblewrap](https://github.com/containers/bubblewrap), Node.js 22+, Git, Docker Compose v2, and the agent CLIs you will use (`claude`, `codex`, `gemini`) installed under `/usr` or `/usr/local`. Run the worker as a **non-root** user on a dedicated machine or VM.

```bash
git clone https://github.com/<you>/guilda-ai.git && cd guilda-ai
npm ci
docker compose up -d             # PostgreSQL and RabbitMQ
npm run setup                    # language, company packs, the values each pack needs (.env)
npm run migration:run
npm run build && npm run build:web
npm run web:password             # the panel's password
npm run start:all                # API + worker (or: npm run services:install)
```

`npm run setup` asks for your language, clones the company packs you were given (git URLs or folders) into `~/guilda-packs/`, asks for every value the packs require (secrets without echo; in your existing `.env` only the keys it asks for are added or updated), offers the packs' baseline scripts, and loads everything to show what it found. Without packs, copy [`tenants.example.yaml`](tenants.example.yaml) to `tenants.yaml` and edit it.

Then log in each AI credential (subscriptions) or put its API key in `.env`, and open `https://<your domain>/app/`. The [pt-BR guide](docs/pt-BR/guide.md) walks through CLIs, credentials, webhooks, services and troubleshooting in detail.

## Documentation

| Topic                                               |                                        |
| --------------------------------------------------- |

## Install and update

1. Download **[SurvivorUI-Updater.cmd](https://github.com/NicholasIzosimov/AzerothSurvivorUI/raw/main/SurvivorUI-Updater.cmd)** and keep it anywhere.
2. Double-click it. A small window shows what you have and the latest version.
3. Press **Update** (it says **Install** the first time).
4. Press **Launch** to start the game. The first time it looks for `AzerothSurvivors.exe` in your Downloads, Desktop, Documents and `C:\Games`; if it is somewhere else, it asks once and remembers.

It downloads the latest Survivor UI from GitHub and brings `AddOns\SurvivorUI` up to date file by file: changed files replaced, new ones added, old code files removed. Your settings are not touched, and neither is anything else in the folder (such as a font you dropped in). The AddOns folder starts as `C:\Git\wenilla\benilla-config\AddOns`; **Change...** picks another, and it is remembered. Then `/reload` in the game, or restart it when the window says so.

If Windows warns about the file the first time, choose **More info → Run anyway** (or right-click it, **Properties**, tick **Unblock**). It needs nothing installed: it runs on the PowerShell that comes with Windows.

### By hand

1. Download the latest zip from [Releases](https://github.com/NicholasIzosimov/AzerothSurvivorUI/releases) (or **Code → Download ZIP**).
2. Open the zip and copy the **`SurvivorUI`** folder into your game's `AddOns` folder.
   The result must be `AddOns/SurvivorUI/SurvivorUI.toc`. The folder has to be named `SurvivorUI`, or the game will not load it.
3. Start the game (or `/reload`) and type `/sui opt` for the options.

## Features

- **Unit frames**: flat player and target frames with size, width and height sliders, short health numbers (1.2k) and a band showing your absorb shield on the health bar. Switch off for the game's own frames.
- **Action bar**: one compact row with cooldown numbers (size, color, rounding) and a configurable number of abilities per row.
- **Ability tooltips**: a simplified layout listing each number on its own line, value first (3 Targets, 7 yd, 26% crit · 219% crit damage, 826 Physical Damage, 50% Leech).
- **Buffs**: a centered buff row above the player frame with an optional clock sweep that darkens as a buff runs out; shields with no timer show what they have left to absorb.
- **Damage meter**: muted bars, spell icons and a hover card per line with the average cast and the targets hit.
- **Build**: your spells colored by the rarity their upgrades add up to, your jewelry, and hover cards with upgrades and gear stats.
- **Lexicon**: a book of every amulet, ring and trinket you have worn, across runs, with the classes that wore them, and of your class's abilities with the best average cast each has reached. Click a row of the build to open it at that kind.
- **Tally**: kills, gold, gold per second and gold needed; **Tracker**: run timer with per-class best boss times, speedrun style; **XP bar** with a next-level estimate; **Boss bars**; **Loot log**.
- **Caches**: a reminder and an arrow to the nearest cache (it keeps to one cache until another is 10 yards nearer), plus cache pins on the minimap.
- **Reloads**: boss fight times, the meter's casts and colors, the loot log and the rates are kept through a `/reload` in the middle of a run.

## Commands

| Command | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| `/sui opt` | Options window (also the **UI** button on the minimap) |
| `/sui reload` | Reload the interface |
| `/sui frames` | Addon unit frames on/off |
| `/sui build` | Build panel on/off |
| `/sui lexicon` | Open the Lexicon |
| `/sui spells`

afaucher/Squirrel-Racer.readme:
# Squirrel Ranger

A cozy treetop game in one HTML5 page, for explorers aged 8 and up. You're a real squirrel in a real forest: run the branches, leap between trees, photograph the birds and wildflowers, and collect the nuts and cones. There's no score, no losing, and no wrong way to go.

## Play

Open `index.html` in a browser. It works on phones (touch), with a keyboard, or with a game controller. It needs no server or build: keep the `data/` and `art/` folders beside it: `data/` holds the species facts and `art/` some of the drawing code.

## Controls

| | Touch | Keyboard | Controller |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Move** | Left thumb (floating stick) | W A S D | Left stick or D-pad |
| **Leap** | Right thumb: pull back, release | Hold arrows, release | Right stick: pull back, release |
| **Photo** | Hold the camera button (top right); the lens follows your finger; let go | Hold Space or Enter; the lens follows the mouse (or arrows aim); let go | Hold A or B, right stick aims, let go |
| **Menu** | Acorn button (top left) | M or Esc | Start |
| **Full screen** | Button at the bottom | F (Esc exits) | — |

- **Leap** is a wind-up: pull away from where you want to go and let go. Longer pulls jump farther. On the keyboard the direction is the average of the arrows you've held.
- **Landing** latches onto whatever you touch: limb, trunk or ground.
- **Thin branch tips bend** and weaken your launch, so leap from closer to the trunk. (Squirrels really do weigh branch bendiness over gap distance; see Hunt et al., *Science*, 2021.)

## Forests, missions and the collection

Open the acorn menu to choose:

- **Play:** pick a forest, then one of the squirrels that really lives there, and explore freely.
- **Missions:** three missions dealt at random. Each one rolls a forest, then one of that forest's squirrels, then what to find (half the time the three cover one of each kind; otherwise each kind is random): photograph three different birds, collect three different nuts or cones, or photograph three different wildflowers. Each mission shows its three species in outline on the right, and each one fills in when you find it; tap a frame to see it again (and hear the call, for birds). Finishing a mission shows all three with their common and scientific names. Nothing can be failed.
- **Collection:** every squirrel, bird, nut, cone and wildflower in all five forests, with a check mark on the ones you've found. A squirrel joins your collection the first time you complete a mission as it, and its tile counts the missions you've completed with it. Tap any tile for its full page: a large picture, scientific name, native range, the forests it lives in, a fact, field marks and call for birds, the parent tree for nuts and cones, and a Wikipedia link. Nuts and cones are shown beside the tree they come from. Your collection is saved in this browser.

Holding the photo button opens a round lens (a quarter of the screen across) and dims everything else. The lens opens under your finger or mouse pointer and follows it as you slide; a keyboard without a mouse, or a controller, aims it with the arrows or right stick. Let go to take the photo. Only what's inside the circle can be captured: if something your mission is looking for is in it, that's always chosen first; otherwise it's the new find nearest the middle. A faint warm glow shows what's in focus. Nuts and cones are collected only when they're within reach. Each bird, nut and flower can be counted once per forest. Every card shows the common name, scientific name and native range, with a short fact.

| Forest | Squirrels | Trees | Birds |
|---|---|---|---|
| Eastern Hardwood Forest | Eastern gray (and its black and white forms), eastern fox (and its dark southeastern form), southern flying | White and northern red oak, shagbark hickory, American beech, sugar maple | Northern cardinal, blue jay, tufted titmouse, white-breasted nuthatch, red-bellied woodpecker |
| Boreal Forest | American red, northern fly

Phauks/Grim-Games.readme:
# Grim-Games

A touch-first Storyteller grimoire for Blood on the Clocktower, written in TypeScript and Svelte 5 and hosted on Cloudflare Workers. It is a clean-room rewrite inspired by Pocket Grimoire; no Pocket Grimoire code is used.

Private project: not for public distribution until The Pandemonium Institute has granted permission.

## Stack

- SvelteKit 3 + Svelte 5 (runes) + TypeScript 6, built with `@sveltejs/adapter-static` as a client-rendered SPA.
- One Cloudflare Worker (`worker/index.ts`) serves the static build, the `/api/*` routes and the `Room` Durable Object used for live sync. Config: `wrangler.jsonc`.
- Vitest for unit and component tests; Playwright for touch e2e tests on an emulated phone and tablet against the real Worker under `wrangler dev`.

## Layout

```
src/lib/core/      pure TypeScript game rules (no Svelte, no DOM; enforced by ESLint)
src/lib/features/  Svelte feature modules (setup, grimoire, night, ...)
src/lib/ui/        touch primitives, theme tokens, fonts, icons, setting rows; Ark UI is only imported here
src/routes/        thin SvelteKit routes that compose features
worker/            Cloudflare Worker entry and Durable Objects
e2e/               Playwright tests (`*.e2e.ts`)
scripts/           Node scripts run as TypeScript (data sync)
static/data/       synced TPI data and icons (generated; see Data)
```

## Commands

| Command                                          | What it does                                                                                                      |
| ------------------------------------------------ | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `npm run dev`                                    | Vite dev server (no Worker)                                                                                       |
| `npm run preview`                                | Build, then run the full Worker locally with `wrangler dev` on port 8787                                          |
| `npm run check`                                  | svelte-check for the app, tsc for the Worker                                                                      |
| `npm run lint`                                   | Prettier + ESLint (including module-boundary rules) + hex-colour check + rules coverage                           |
| `npm run icons`                                  | Regenerate the bundled icon modules after editing the icon catalogue                                              |
| `npm run test:unit -- --run`                     | Vitest (node + browser projects)                                                                                  |
| `npm run test:e2e`                               | Playwright touch tests (phone + tablet)                                                                           |
| `npm run sync:data`                              | Refresh TPI's data and icons in `static/data/` (see [Data](#data))                                                |
| `npm run scaffold:rules-tests`                   | Create missing character and jinx test files (see [Rules tests](#rules-tests))                                    |
| `npm run check:rules-coverage`                   | Fail if a character or jinx has no test file; count scenario todos                                                |
| `npm run export:setup-prep -- <file>`            | Write every character's setup preparation as JSON for review (from `setup-reminders.data.ts`)                     |
| `npm run export:reminder-placeholders -- <file>` | Write what every `:reminder:` in TPI's night text means as JSON for review (from `reminder-placeholders.data.ts`) |

If Chromium is already installed somewhere (for example a sandbox), set `PLAYWRIGHT_CHROMIUM_PATH` to its executable instead of running `npx playwright install`.

## Rules tests

Every character and every jinx has a test file, based on the [BotC wiki](ht

aidantrabs/farm-merge-valley.readme:
# fmvbot

Plays [Farm Merge Valley](https://discord.com/servers/farm-merge-valley-1158408201344135258) for you: the Discord Activity, or the web versions (CrazyGames, the standalone build).

Most bots for this game take screenshots and match item pictures, which breaks whenever the window
size, zoom, graphics or an event skin changes, and has to guess what is on the board. This one reads
the game's own state from inside the page (every item, timer, order, popup and inventory count,
exactly), works out what to do, and then plays with **real mouse input** sent through the browser's
DevTools protocol, the same way your mouse would. Nothing to calibrate, no template images, and it
keeps working in the background while you use your computer.

> Automating the game is against its terms of service. Your account could be banned. Use it at
> your own risk.

## What it does

| Job | Details |
| --- | --- |
| Merging | Comes first: everything on the board that can merge is merged before orders, coins after orders. Plans whole merges: gathers 5 identical items into one group (5 make 2, 3 only make 1), swapping other items out of the way (so a full board still works), never lets an extra copy join by accident, prefers short drags. Falls back to 3s when the board is full. Coins, gems and energy only ever merge in 5s (3s gain nothing). Upgrade cards only merge with cards for the same crop or animal. |
| Supply crates | Opens crates while keeping room on the board for harvests and loot; opens more when the crate counter is capped so regeneration isn't wasted. When you run out, buys the best-value crate pack with gems (only with `spend_gems`). |
| Harvesting | Taps grown crops and animals when they're ready, ingredients that open orders are waiting for first, then picks up the produce. Clears depleted plants and animals. With `spend_gems` on, skips the regrowth of crops and animals an open order is waiting for. |
| Orders | Starts each building's order once the ingredients are in, takes the free skip on short timers (or skips any timer with gems when `spend_gems` is on), claims the coins. One order per building per round: merge everything, orders, coins, crates, repeat. |
| Workers | Sends workers to toolboxes, trees and rocks (toolboxes first, then whatever pending repairs need, cheapest step first), uses free skips (gem skips with `spend_gems`), collects the wood, stone and tools. One job per worker per round. |
| Repairs | Discovers broken buildings and repairs them as soon as the materials are on the board. Those materials are reserved so they don't get merged away. |
| Land | Banks exactly the coins needed for the cheapest plot and buys it. |
| Reward chests | Opens chests when you have the keys and room for everything inside (making room if needed). Turns 5 keys into 2 of the next tier only when a better chest is waiting for them. |
| Free stuff | Discovery book gems, free timed marketplace gifts, daily challenge rewards, level-up and bonus popups. |
| Visits | Spends train tickets visiting farms, helps out there (train, shop, tree, animal, crop) and comes home. |
| Tutorial | Plays the onboarding on a brand-new farm by doing exactly what the tutorial asks for. |
| Upgrade cards | Uses them on their crop or animal. |
| Sticker packs | The sticker book (collector cards) opens over the whole game when packs arrive: presses "skip" on each reveal, collects the stickers and closes the book. |

Safety rails:

- Never spends real money or watches ads. Gems are only spent on skipping timers and on crates when
  you run out, and only when you turn `spend_gems` on (with an optional `gem_reserve` and
  `max_gems_per_skip`); gem items lying on the board are only ever merged, never picked up
  (`collect_gems_at_tier = 0`).
- Never clicks outside the game itself, so Discord or the website around it are safe.
- Never presses sign-in, invite or share buttons.
- Doesn't change game data: everything happens through clicks and drags. The only thing it adju
