Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

feat: buy crates with gems when they run out

Opening crates is part of every round, so running out shouldn't stop the farm. With spend_gems on,
the bot opens the marketplace, scrolls to the crate packs and buys the one with the most crates per
gem that gem_reserve and max_gems_per_skip allow, through the purchase confirmation. Gem packs
priced in real money are never treated as gem purchases.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

feat: play in rounds of merging, orders, coins and crates

Merging everything on the board now comes first, then orders and the rest, then coin merges, then
opening crates, and round again. With instant gem skips orders and worker jobs never run out, so
each building gets one order and each worker one job per round; a round ends whenever the loop gets
down to the crates. Coins merge on their own turn (merge_coins) so they don't crowd out the items
orders need.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <n

fix: only merge upgrade cards with cards for the same crop or animal

Every level 1 upgrade card shares the id upgrade_card_1, but the game only merges cards with the
same target (mergeable.targetSpecification, e.g. upgrade_card_1bacon). Grouping them by id planned
merges that never landed and kept blocking the merge task. Merges are now grouped by that key.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

feat: merge on a full board by swapping items instead of waiting for free cells

Dropping an item onto a different item swaps the two (checked on the live game, with and without
free cells), so merges never needed empty space. The planner assumed the other item gets pushed to
an empty cell and gave up on a full board, which is how the board filled up. Drops now go by the
tile under the pointer, so loot bubbles over finished trees don't block them, and a failed drag
sets just those two cells asid

feat: spend gems on skipping order, worker and regrowth timers when allowed

With plenty of gems in the inventory, waiting on timers is what slows the farm down. With
spend_gems on (off by default; gem_reserve and max_gems_per_skip cap it), order fast-forwards,
worker jobs and the regrowth of crops and animals an open order is waiting for are skipped with
gems, through the game's confirmation popup, and only counted once the gems are really gone.
Buttons priced in real money or that play ads are

feat: only merge gem items on the board, never pick them up

Gems lying on the board are worth more merged, so collecting them (by tier, to make room or to
clear space for a chest) is now off by default; collect_gems_at_tier = 0 means never.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

feat: clear sticker packs so the new collector cards stop stalling the bot

The sticker book is added straight onto the stage above every layer, not as a popup, so the bot
couldn't see it while it swallowed every tap, and its full-screen background was read as a HUD
button that made every board tap fail. The agent now reports such views as overlays (and leaves
them out of the HUD), and a stickers job presses "Press to skip" on each reveal, then Collect, then
closes the book, with everything else

fix: stop popup handling from reopening the fast forward event and stalling on toasts

Quest progress toasts sit in the popup layer but can't be pressed or closed, so the bot treated
them as stuck popups and paused popup handling for minutes. Tapping "outside" a popup at the left
edge landed on the event launcher and reopened the Fast Forward popup after every order, and its
close button was resolved to the panel holding the X, so each one took ~10s to get rid of.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.

fix: move the camera to off-screen targets instead of treating them as covered

The game hides every object the camera can't see. In the small Discord view most of the farm is
off screen, so picks failed as "covered", the cell was blocked and workers, orders and merges gave
up within seconds while the board filled up.

hooni9807/beamrpg.readme:
# BeamRPG · 대환장 파티

> 희범의 집부터 챔피언의 경기장까지. 7부부터 1부까지 마을을 여행하고, 선수촌의 탁구 마왕에게 도전하는 브라우저 성장 RPG.

**[게임 바로 하기](https://hooni9807.github.io/beamrpg/)**

## 짧은 프롤로그

첫 접속에는 **초대장 도착 → 아재범의 도전 → 탁구 마왕 → 희범의 출발**로 이어지는 네 장면이 나옵니다. 실제 게임 지도 위에 카메라 연출과 짧은 대사를 더했습니다. 다음 버튼으로 읽는 속도에 맞춰 넘기거나 언제든 건너뛸 수 있습니다.

완료하거나 건너뛰면 같은 브라우저에서 자동으로 반복되지 않습니다. 기존 이용자도 업데이트 후 한 번 볼 수 있으며, 레벨·라켓·위치·보스 기록은 바뀌지 않습니다. **안내 → 스토리 다시 보기**에서 다시 볼 수 있습니다.

## 게임 흐름

1. 시작 캐릭터는 **희범**입니다. 바깥 **리그 로드**에서 열린 마을 입구까지 걸어 들어갑니다.
2. 집에서 쉬고, 라켓을 준비하고, 공원과 마을 시설을 둘러보세요. 카메라가 희범을 따라 넓은 지도를 비춥니다.
3. 마을 외곽을 걷다 확률적으로 몬스터를 만나 **기술을 선택하는 턴제 전투**를 펼칩니다. **체육관 보스**는 기존 탁구 스윙 경기로 대결하며, 이기면 다음 마을이 열립니다.
4. 레벨업 때 무작위로 나온 3개 강화 중 하나를 선택합니다.
5. 레벨 2 / 4 / 7 / 10 / 13에 일반 몬스터 전투에서 직접 고르는 새 기술을 배웁니다.

## 일반 몬스터 전투와 HP

포켓몬 본편의 기술 선택·PP·선공·상성 구조를 참고한 희범 1인 턴제 전투입니다. **상대 HP를 먼저 0으로 만들면 승리**합니다. 마을마다 통통볼·스핀젤리·커트고슴이 지역에 맞는 이름과 레벨로 등장합니다.

- **기술:** 네 기술 중 하나를 고르면 상대도 기술을 골라 행동합니다. 우선도가 높은 기술이 먼저, 우선도가 같으면 스피드가 높은 쪽이 먼저 행동하며 동률은 무작위입니다. 먼저 쓰러진 쪽은 반격하지 않습니다.
- **데미지:** 레벨·위력·공격/방어 또는 특수공격/특수방어에 명중률·급소·데미지 변동을 적용합니다. 회전 커트는 상대 스피드를 낮출 수 있고, 철벽 준비는 방어·특수방어를 올립니다. 능력 변화는 해당 전투에만 적용합니다.
- **DP 타입 상성:** 포켓몬스터 DP의 노말·불꽃·물·전기·풀·얼음·격투·독·땅·비행·에스퍼·벌레·바위·고스트·드래곤·악·강철 17타입의 단일 타입 상성을 사용합니다. 희범은 새 여정 시작 시 무작위 타입을 받고 저장되며, 일반 몬스터만 조우마다 무작위 타입을 받습니다. 보스와 코치는 마을별 고정 타입이라 다시 싸워도 바뀌지 않습니다. 기술마다 타입이 있어 상대에게 2배, ½배, 무효 또는 일반 피해가 적용되고, 희범 자신의 타입과 같은 기술은 1.5배 피해를 줍니다. 전투 화면의 기술 버튼에서 현재 상대에게 적용될 결과를 바로 확인할 수 있습니다.
- **PP:** 기술마다 사용 횟수가 있습니다. 모두 소진하면 반동 피해를 받는 최후의 발악을 사용합니다. 라켓을 바꾸어도 이미 사용한 필살기 PP는 회복되지 않습니다.
- **가방:** 시작 회복약 3개. 회복약은 HP 40을 회복하고 한 턴을 사용합니다. 치유 센터에서 25 G에 추가 구입할 수 있습니다.
- **도망:** 성공하면 보상 없이 마을로 돌아갑니다. 실패하면 상대가 공격합니다. 스피드와 시도 횟수에 따라 성공률이 높아집니다.

희범은 **HP 64**로 시작하고 레벨마다 최대 HP가 8씩 증가합니다. 남은 HP와 PP는 전투가 끝나도 유지됩니다. **희범의 집·각 지역 숙소·치유 센터에서 무료로 완전히 회복**할 수 있습니다. 패배하면 현재 마을 치유 센터로 돌아와 치료받으며 경험치와 골드는 잃지 않습니다. 보스와 코치의 탁구 경기는 HP·PP를 소모하지 않습니다.

일반 전투는 기술 선택 한 턴이 끝날 때마다 자동 저장됩니다. 새로고침하거나 브라우저를 다시 열면 상대 HP·희범 HP·PP·턴을 이어받습니다. 승리 보상은 결과 화면에서 마을로 돌아갈 때 한 번만 지급됩니다.

## 리그 로드

| 지역 | 테마 | 권장 레벨 | 보스 | 일반 승리 XP |
| --- | --- | ---: | --- | ---: |
| 7부 마을 | 초록 들판 | 1 | 아재범 | 70 |
| 6부 마을 | 가을 정원 | 3 | 꿀잠범 | 90 |
| 5부 마을 | 붉은 사막 | 5 | 리신범 | 110 |
| 4부 마을 | 달빛 마을 | 7 | 퍼시벌 | 140 |
| 3부 마을 | 해안 항구 | 9 | 휴고범 | 170 |
| 2부 마을 | 물빛 운하 | 11 | 만취범 | 195 |
| 1부 마을 | 왕관 정원 | 13 | 백야범 | 220 |
| 선수촌 | 챔피언 성채 | 15 | 탁구 마왕 | 260 |

8개 지역마다 테마, 숙소·공원·체육관, 일반 몬스터 3종과 보스가 있습니다. 권장 레벨은 안내이며 입장 조건은 직전 마을 보스 격파입니다. 보스 승리 경험치는 해당 마을 일반 보상의 2배이며, 이미 이긴 보스에게도 다시 도전할 수 있습니다.

## 마을과 생활 시설

건물은 입구에 닿으면 내부 지도로 이어집니다. 출구에 닿으면 마을로 돌아오고, 마을 귀환 지점에서는 바깥 리그 로드로 나갑니다. 지도나 목적지 목록을 선택하면 건물과 물을 피해 걸어갑니다.

| 시설 | 이용 내용 |
| --- | --- |
| 희범의 집 / 지역별 숙소 | 무료 HP·PP 완전 회복 + 공격형 휴식 버프 |
| 지역별 공원 | 별도 공원 지도를 산책 + 민첩형 휴식 버프 |
| 라켓 공방 | 라켓 구입·장착, 라켓별 특성과 필살기 확인 |
| 랠리 카페 | 샌드위치 40 G: 다음 3번 승리 경험치 +20% |
| 트레이닝 센터 | 코치와 연습 경기, 마을별 첫 훈련 승리에 해당 마을의 일반 승리 XP 지급 |
| 치유 센터 | 무료 HP·PP 완전 회복 + 방어형 휴식 버프, 회복약 25 G 구입 |
| 리그 기념관 | 8개 지역의 보스 격파와 트로피 기록 확인 |
| 체육관 / 경기장 | 해당 마을 보스에게 도전 |

휴식하면 다음 **3번 전투**에 적용되는 버프를 얻습니다. 버프는 중첩되지 않으며, 다른 휴식 장소를 이용하면 새 버프로 교체됩니다. 일반 턴제 전투와 보스·훈련 탁구 경기 모두에 반영됩니다.

| 장소 | 버프 | 일반 턴제 전투 | 보스·훈련 탁구 경기 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 희범의 집 / 숙소 | 정비된 루틴 · 공격형 | 공격·특수공격 +15% | 타구 속도·회전 +15% |
| 공원 | 산책의 리듬 · 민첩형 | 스피드 +25%, 급소 +10%p | PERFECT 판정 폭 +20%, 게이지 획득 +20% |
| 치유 센터 | 회복 보호막 · 방어형 | 방어·특수방어 +25% | 회전 실수 확률 −20%, PERFECT 판정 폭 +10% |

집과 치유 센터는 HP·PP도 완전히 회복하며, 공원은 HP·PP 회복 없이 버프만 제공합니다. 카페 식사는 효과가 남아 있는 동안 다시 구매할 수 없습니다. 훈련 재경기는 연습용이며 추가 경험치·골드를 지급하지 않습니다.

새로 시작하면 **120 G**를 받습니다. 일반 승리 보상은 7부의 45 G부터 지역마다 10 G씩, 보스 승리는 120 G부터 지역마다 20 G씩 증가합니다.

| 라켓 | 가격 |
| --- | ---: |
| 일반 라켓 (특수 효과 없음) | 기본 지급 |
| 쉐이크핸드 | 120 G |
| 중국식 펜홀더 | 150 G |
| 일본식 펜홀더 | 200 G |
| 수비수 라켓 | 180 G |

구입한 라켓은 공방에서 자유롭게 바꿀 수 있습니다. 라켓마다 타구 특성과 레벨 2 필살기가 다릅니다.

## 성장

레벨업 때 아래 능력치 가운데 3개가 무작위로 제시됩니다. 하나를 고르면 해당 능력치가 성장합니다.

| 능력치 | 일반 턴제 전투 (1포인트당) | 보스·훈련 탁구 경기 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 파워 | 공격 +5% | 타구 속도 +5% |
| 회전 | 특수공격 +5% | 타구 회전 +5% |
| 컨트롤 | 방어 +5% | PERFECT

Ketschbopp/EatingAnim.readme:
# EatingAnim — Lightweight Pawn Animations (RimWorld 1.7)

Quick, render-only animations for pawns. Requires [Harmony](https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2009463077).

| Category | What you see |
|---|---|
| Eating | **At a table:** pawn leans in, spoon/fork carries a morsel of the *actual food* to the mouth, then chews. **Without a table:** hunched posture, the *actual food item* is lifted to the mouth. **Animals:** head-down grazing bob. |
| Cooking | Frying pan (meals) or pot (everything else). The bill's *real ingredients* are tossed in and cook down while the *real product* (e.g. a lavish meal) forms as work progresses. Stirring, pan tosses, steam. |
| Butchering | Cleaver chops; chunks of the carcass's *own meat* fly on impact. |
| Manufacturing / crafting | Hammering (sparks at smithies/smelters), sewing, chisel + mallet for sculptures, a chemistry lab routine for drugs/medicine (flask poured from the test-tube rack into a fizzing, colour-changing beaker, then swirled) — the *real product* takes shape on the bench. |
| Work | Construction (hammer + dust), deconstruction (saw), mining (pickaxe + dust), sowing (trowel), harvesting (sickle), cleaning (broom), research (quill on paper). Tending and surgery are left vanilla. Modded jobs are picked up through the skill their work toil uses. |
| Games | Board games: pieces moved across the board. Poker: card fan + dealing. Dexterity games: wind-up and throw (horseshoe in hand for horseshoes). |
| Reading | Pages flip over the *real book / newspaper / document* being read — including modded ones that use the Reading joy kind. |
| Apparel / equipment | The *real garment* comes down over the pawn while they wiggle into it (and back up when removing). Equipping does a hop and a twirl of the *real weapon*. |

All animations work for every facing (north, east, south, west): lean, nods, tool angles, mirroring and draw layering are resolved per direction.

## Settings
Every category can be turned off, plus: master switch, animals on/off, props on/off, hide props when zoomed out, intensity and speed sliders.

## Other options
- **Disable shield belts** (off by default): worn shield belts block nothing, show no bubble, no longer prevent the wearer from shooting, and aren't favoured when pawns choose apparel. Shields built into creatures (e.g. mechanoids) are unaffected.

## Performance
- **No tick work.** Nothing is added to the simulation, so TPS is unaffected. (The only non-render hook records the tick a weapon was equipped.)
- **Render path only, on-screen pawns only.** Patches are postfixes on vanilla pawn drawing; off-screen pawns are never touched.
- **Stateless and allocation-free.** The animation is derived each frame from the pawn's current job via array lookups built once at startup (job → mode, recipe → animation, skill → animation). No per-pawn storage, no LINQ, no strings, no reflection at runtime.
- Body/head offsets are thread-safe and run inside vanilla's parallel pre-draw.
- Props are a few textured quads per animating pawn, skipped when zoomed out to cached rendering.

## Building
```
cd Source/EatingAnim
dotnet build -c Release
```
Builds against `Krafs.Rimworld.Ref` (1.7) and `Lib.Harmony` reference assemblies into `1.7/Assemblies/`. Requires the .NET 10 SDK.

Tool textures are generated by `Tools/gen_textures.py` (Pillow).

coolking70/DungeonRaid.readme:
# Dungeon Raid 网页版

**▶ 在线游玩：<https://coolking70.github.io/DungeonRaid/>**

经典连线消除 Roguelike《Dungeon Raid》（Android 1.2.11 版）的 TypeScript 重写版，可以直接在浏览器里玩，手机和电脑都支持。目标是**规则忠实**：伤害公式、敌人能力、随机数算法以及调用顺序，都依据对原版程序的逆向分析还原。同一个种子，每次都会打出完全相同的对局。

## 功能

- **连线**：拖动连接 3 个以上相邻的同类格子，剑可以和骷髅连在一起。拖线时实时预览本次伤害和会击杀的敌人。
- **敌人**：普通敌人加 32 种特殊敌人。冰冻、点燃、偷金、巫妖与命匣、倒计时等能力全部生效；敌人数值实时显示，点按或长按可查看详情。
- **成长**：升级二选一、商店购买装备、强化装备、42 个技能、领取奖杯来升级或解锁职业。
- **模式与职业**：Classic、Dungeon Sprint（100 回合冲刺）、Pretzel Hero（交叉连线）三种模式；4 种难度；10 个职业，可配置种族、优点、缺点和替换技能。
- **界面**：原版风格的局内 HUD、折叠菜单、动画和音效。结算期间点按屏幕可立即跳过动画。
- **局外**：主菜单、教程、高分榜（6 页）、成就、统计、设置。
- **其他**：中英双语切换；自动存档，刷新页面后可以继续；长期档案（职业等级、高分、成就）保存在浏览器本地。

路线图与进度见 [docs/PLAN.md](docs/PLAN.md)。

## 本地开发

需要 Node.js 22 或更高版本。

```bash
npm ci
npm run dev          # 开发服务器，地址 http://localhost:5310，加 ?debug 进入调试台
npm run check        # 类型检查、全部测试和数据校验
npx vite build       # 构建发布版本，输出到 dist/
```

本地开发模式下，棋盘图集会从 `reverse/` 目录读取原版贴图，用来对照；发布构建使用 `art/` 里的重绘图集。

## 项目结构

| 路径 | 内容 |
| --- | --- |
| `src/core/` | 纯规则引擎，没有 DOM 依赖。入口是 `step(state, action) → { state, events }` |
| `src/audio/` | 音效播放器：优先播放 `audio/original/` 中的原版音效，加载失败时回退到程序合成 |
| `ui/` | 网页界面：320×480 逻辑画布、屏幕栈、动画时间线 |
| `test/` | Vitest 测试，包括规格行为用例、整局确定性模拟、存读档往返 |
| `docs/spec/` | 从原版程序还原的规则与界面规格，每条结论都附带证据 |
| `docs/tasks/` | 各阶段的任务卡和执行报告 |
| `data/` | 规则与界面数据表（枚举、装备、职业、特殊敌人、布局、音效、i18n 文本） |
| `art/` | 重绘图集：棋盘、界面、装备图标 |
| `audio/original/` | 原版音效 |
| `fonts/` | Fusion Pixel 12px 像素字体的子集（SIL OFL 1.1，许可证文本随附） |

DabDavis/eqoa-client-v1.readme:
# eqoa-client

Native PC client for EverQuest Online Adventures (EQOA). Renders zone terrain, character models, animations, spell effects, and flora from the PS2 game disc using Raylib. Connects to [Sandstorm](https://eqoa.live) via the DRDP UDP protocol.

Built as a 1:1 port of the PS2 client's VI engine — movement, collision, animation, and rendering match original PS2 behavior.

![EQOA Client](https://img.shields.io/badge/platform-linux%20%7C%20windows-blue)

## Download

Single binary — no installer, no dependencies. From [Releases](https://github.com/DabDavis/eqoa-client-v1/releases):

- **Stable** — the [latest release](https://github.com/DabDavis/eqoa-client-v1/releases/latest): `eqoa-client` (Linux amd64) or `eqoa-client.exe` (Windows amd64)
- **Dev** — the [latest dev build](https://github.com/DabDavis/eqoa-client-v1/releases/tag/client-dev), rebuilt on every push to `master`; ahead of stable and less tested

Auto-updates on every launch, staying on the channel it was downloaded from. Requires an EQOA Frontiers ISO disc image (SLUS-20744) — all game assets are read directly from the ISO at runtime.

## Features

- **PS2-accurate rendering** — centerTransform pipeline, day/night TOD table, player lantern, EQOA bitmap font
- **Zone rendering** — Multi-layer terrain with overlay blending, procedural radial flora (1.2M instances)
- **Character models** — Skeletal animation, equipment rendering (armor, hair, helm, robe, face), bone-attached weapons
- **Animation system** — Dual-pair priority state machine with 250ms cross-fade, Gram-Schmidt re-orthonormalization, per-weapon attack pools
- **Spell effects** — Particle emitters, 17-event-type driver, timed sequences from SPELLFX.ESF
- **Sound system** — Animation-triggered SFX, 3D positional audio, zone BGM streaming from ISO
- **Collision** — Wall-sliding (CalcFit), ground snapping (SampleHeight), Möller-Trumbore ray-triangle
- **Networking** — Full DRDP protocol client: reliable messaging, state channels, XOR delta, fragment reassembly
- **UI** — PS2-accurate 9-slice textured frames from UI.ESF, equipment management, merchant/dialogue/hotkey menus
- **Display settings** — Resolution selection, fullscreen, FPS cap, VSync, FPS counter
- **Auto-updater** — Checks for new builds on launch, self-updates with SHA-256 verification
- **Headless mode** — REPL client for protocol testing without rendering

## Quick Start

```bash
# Download and run
chmod +x eqoa-client
./eqoa-client
```

On first launch, use the built-in file browser to select your EQOA Frontiers ISO. The path is saved to config — you only need to do this once.

### Build from Source

```bash
go build -o client ./cmd/client/
./client
```

Headless mode (no GPU required):

```bash
go build -o headless ./cmd/headless/
./headless
```

## Package Structure

```
cmd/
  client/           Raylib 3D client (main game loop, input, rendering, HUD)
  headless/         Headless REPL client (protocol testing)

internal/
  game/             Game engine: state, movement, spells, particles, effect volumes
  terrain/          Zone loading, multi-pass rendering, collision, radial flora
  models/           Character models, skeletal animation, equipment, bone transforms
  network/          DRDP protocol client (reliable, state channels, XOR delta)
  protocol/         Opcode definitions, message types
  audio/            Sound effects, BGM streaming, VAG decoding
  frustum/          View frustum culling
  sky/              Skybox rendering with time-of-day
  ui/               PS2-accurate VIUI texture system (36 sheets, 252 elements)
  gfx/              OpenGL/ES abstraction layer
```

## Terrain Rendering

```
ISO → TUNARIA.ESF → loadZone() → ZoneTerrain (tiles + textures)
  → buildMeshes() → GPU meshes (one per texture + layer)
  → Draw() → multi-pass: base terrain → overlays → flora
```

ramenoruth-dev/sleep-deceives.readme:
# SLEEP DECEIVES

First-person psychological survival horror (three.js + Web Audio + Node/WebSocket). Solo and 1-4 player co-op.

## Run
```
npm install
npm start            # http://localhost:8080  (this computer only)
npm run lan          # same, but friends on your network can join (http://<your-LAN-IP>:8080)
```
Open the page in Chrome/Edge. Solo Mode needs nothing else. **Play With Friends -> Create Lobby** gives a 4-letter
code and an invite link (`/?join=CODE`); friends open the link or type the code under Join Lobby.

Playing over the internet: run `node server.js --lan` on a machine your friends can reach (cloud VM, or port-forward /
tunnel the port). The client uses `ws://` or `wss://` automatically; put it behind HTTPS (e.g. a reverse proxy) for `wss`.

Controls: WASD move, Shift sprint, Ctrl/C crouch, F flashlight, E interact/hide, Q throw stone (distraction), 1-4 quick
chat (co-op), P pause (solo freezes the game; online it does NOT), Tab spectate next teammate. Chair: SPACE / click / pad A.

## Architecture (authoritative)
`src/shared/*` is plain JS used by BOTH the Node server and the browser:
- `grid.js` collision / line of sight / BFS   - `brain.js` the Crimson Mother AI (multi-target)
- `match.js` the match rules: lives, captures, chair arbitration, fuses, gate, hiding, rescue, end of match
Online, `server.js` runs a `Match` per lobby at 20 Hz and broadcasts snapshots; clients render and send inputs.
Solo runs the very same `Match` in-process (`LocalNet` in `src/net.js`), so both modes obey the same rules.

Server-side validation: movement speed + wall checks (teleport/speed hacks are snapped back), distance checks for
fuses/gate/lockers, exclusive lockers, per-player chat rate limit, message size/rate limits, same-origin WebSocket check,
chair results must be plausible (min time, mistake allowance) or count as a failure, chairs time out after 100 s,
third capture is always fatal (no unlimited lives).
Honest limit: the chair timing mini-game itself runs on the client; the server checks plausibility, not every keypress.

Other files: `src/main.js` game orchestration/HUD/cinematic, `src/lobbyui.js` lobby screens, `src/remote.js` teammate
avatars, `src/demon.js` model + render of server state, `src/world.js`, `src/player.js`, `src/audio.js` (procedural),
`src/sets.js`, `src/portal.js`, `src/skillcheck.js`, `src/settings.js` (localStorage saves).

## Co-op rules
- Lobby: create/join by code, ready-up, host picks difficulty and starts when everyone is ready; connection indicator;
  lobby-phase auto-reconnect (60 s) via token.
- The intro cinematic plays for everyone if any player has not seen it; only players who have seen it may skip.
- The demon wakes when every client has finished the intro. She hunts the nearest/loudest/visible player, freezes if ANY
  player looks at her, and hears every teammate's noise.
- Capture: Red Rift for everyone nearby (sound, light failure, distortion). 1st capture -> chair; fail -> marked + final
  chair; fail again or any later capture -> spectator.
- Rescue: while a teammate is in a chair, hold E in the ritual room (the demon's den) for 4 s to break the ward: +1
  mistake allowed for them. Choose between helping and finishing objectives.
- Fuses/gate are shared team progress. Win if anyone escapes; the match ends when nobody is active or captured.

## Tests
```
npm run test:match                       # rules of the authoritative match (no network)
node server.js 8090 & npm run test:net   # real WebSocket lobby + validation tests
```
`RB_DEBUG=1 node server.js` enables `debug_capture` / `debug_tp` test hooks (never enable in production).

## Status
Done and tested: everything above incl. a browser run hosting a lobby with a bot teammate: start, capture over WS, chair,
respawn, teammate-capture rift/HUD, ward rescue, server shutdown -> "Connection lost" screen.
Not built: voice chat (use quick-chat), public matchmaking, mid-match reconnect (a dropped player is removed from that

mamamaki12/open-world.readme:
# open-world

自分だけのワールドで、稼いで、建てて、売って、また建てる「住宅づくり×経済」クリエイティブゲーム（Webブラウザ）。

- 設計書：[docs/game-design.md](docs/game-design.md)
- 技術構成：[docs/tech-stack.md](docs/tech-stack.md)
- 家づくりプロトタイプの遊び方：[docs/prototype.md](docs/prototype.md)
- お金の仕組み（建築費・売買・カジノ・競馬など）：[docs/economy.md](docs/economy.md)

## 動かし方

Node.js 20 以上が必要です。

```bash
npm install
npm run dev      # http://localhost:5173 で起動
npm test         # ルール（配置判定・屋根の形・お金の計算）のテスト
npm run build    # dist/ に公開用ファイルを作る
```

## 公開（本番）

`main` に変更が入ると、GitHub Actions がテストとビルドをして GitHub Pages に公開します（`.github/workflows/deploy.yml`）。プルリクエストでは型チェック・テスト・ビルドだけを行います（`.github/workflows/ci.yml`）。

公開するときは最初の一回だけ、リポジトリの **Settings → Pages → Build and deployment → Source** を **GitHub Actions** にしてください。公開先は `https://mamamaki12.github.io/open-world/` です。Pages を有効にするまでは、デプロイのジョブはスキップされます（非公開リポジトリで Pages を使うには GitHub Pro が必要です）。

- セーブは遊ぶ人のブラウザ内（localStorage）だけに残り、サーバーには送られません。
- 3D表示（WebGL）が使えないブラウザでは案内を出し、予期しないエラーで止まったときは「再読み込み」か「自動セーブを消して始め直す」を選べます。

aaronchongsl-del/switch-game.readme:
# Switch

A 90-second browser speed game that switches between maths, memory, logic, wordplay, spatial and code puzzles. Vanilla JS, no build step.

## Run locally
Open `index.html`, or `python3 -m http.server` and visit http://localhost:8000.

## Layout
- `index.html`, `css/` (`styles.css`, `juice.css`, `themes.css`), `js/` (`game.js`, `juice.js`, `questions.js`, `leaderboard.js`, `config.js`)
- `supabase/migrations/`: leaderboard table and the two RPC functions
- `tests/test-questions.js`: re-solves every generated question independently (`node tests/test-questions.js js/game.js`)
- `docs/`: effects spec and question-bank notes

## Online leaderboard
1. Apply `supabase/migrations/*_leaderboard.sql` to a Supabase project.
2. Put the project URL and publishable key in `js/config.js`. Without them the game uses a local, per-browser board.

The table has RLS on and no policies; the browser can only call `submit_score` and `leaderboard`. Scores get plausibility checks (score vs. correct answers, day window, 15 s rate limit). This stops casual tampering, not a determined cheater; replay verification is a later phase.

## Notes
Daily-run seeds depend on the generators, so changing a generator changes that day's run.

sork01/valhalla-android.readme:
# Valhalla Rumble – Android client

Android WebView shell for the [Valhallasc](https://github.com/sork01/Valhallasc-AI) browser game (public server: https://gunning.se/Valhallasc/), with gamepad support tuned for the AYN Odin 3. Controller input is read from Android events and injected as the keyboard/pointer events the game already handles, so no game or server changes are needed.

Status: builds; not yet verified on a physical Odin 3.

## Build / install
    cd android
    export JAVA_HOME=/path/to/jdk17 ANDROID_HOME=/path/to/android-sdk   # platform 34 + build-tools 34.0.0
    ./gradlew assembleDebug            # -> app/build/outputs/apk/debug/app-debug.apk
    adb install -r app/build/outputs/apk/debug/app-debug.apk
Use `-PserverUrl=http://host:port/` to target a local server. Debug builds allow `chrome://inspect` debugging of the WebView.

## Touch
No overlay: touch uses the game's own HUD (tap to move/target, skill bar, panel buttons). Android Back = Esc.

## Controller (standard Android gamepad)
| Input | Action |
|---|---|
| Left stick | Move |
| A | Attack (hold = repeat) |
| B / X / Y | Menu·close / Talk (F) / Ride (H) |
| LB + A/B/X/Y | Skill slots 1–4 |
| RB + A/B/X/Y | Skill slots 5–8 |
| LT | Shift (assassin step) |
| Right stick + RT | Mouse cursor + click (click-to-target, menus, inventory, drag-to-walk when held) |
| D-pad ↑ ← → ↓ | HP potion, Food, Mana potion, Quests |
| Select / Start / L3 / R3 | Map / Character / Skills / Bags |

thejaredchapman/ai-ready-reps.readme:
# AI Ready Reps

A plain-English guide, quiz, and arcade game that teach sales teams to use AI safely.

**Live site:** https://aireadyreps.com

This is a personal portfolio project by [Jared Chapman](https://www.linkedin.com/in/thejaredchapman), built on his own time. The motto is "Reach one, teach one."

> **Talk to your Legal and IT teams before trying any AI tool for work.** This project is general information, not legal advice, and it is not affiliated with any AI vendor.

## What is in it

- AI basics for people who have never used AI at work
- The three kinds of AI help: augmentation, analysis, and automation
- A library of 287 sales use cases rated green (safe), amber (guardrails), or red (not safe)
- A prompt library with 25 copy-ready prompts
- A playbook with worked examples, customer scripts, and a rep FAQ
- Go-to-market guidance for 10 roles, plus a time-saved calculator
- A quiz (10 questions drawn from 17) and an 8-bit sorting game
- A comparison of 8 AI tools, with a page per vendor that lists the vendor's own statements, check dates, and numbered sources
- A safety section covering laws, what to do after a mistake, and AI agents

## For companies

[`ai-ready-reps-company-guide.md`](./ai-ready-reps-company-guide.md) is a Markdown template that companies can adapt into an internal AI acceptable-use and enablement guide. It has fill-in sections for approved tools and contacts, the full use case catalog, the prompt library, vendor notes with sources, and a rollout plan. Have Legal, IT, and Security review any adapted version.

## About the vendor facts

Vendor statements were last checked on **October 14, 2026**. The Vendors tab labels each one:

- **Checked at source:** the vendor's own page was opened and read.
- **Excerpt only:** the vendor's page blocked automated access, so the statement was read from a search excerpt of that page. Confirm it on the page.

Vendor terms change often. Confirm anything that matters in your contract.

## Project structure

| File | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `index.html` | The whole site: HTML, CSS, and JavaScript in one file, with no build step |
| `ai-ready-reps-company-guide.md` | Downloadable company template |
| `LICENSE` | MIT license |

## Run it locally

Open `index.html` in a browser, or serve the folder:

```sh
python3 -m http.server 8000
```

## Deploy

The site is a static page hosted on Vercel and connected to this repository. Every push to `main` deploys to production at https://aireadyreps.com automatically, and other branches get preview deployments.

To deploy by hand from this folder:

```sh
vercel --prod
```

## Contributing and corrections

Found something unclear, outdated, or missing? Open an issue, or message Jared on [LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/in/thejaredchapman). Corrections to vendor facts should include a link to the vendor's page.

## License

[MIT](./LICENSE). If you adapt this work, please keep the attribution.

## Credits

Drafted with the help of an AI assistant (Claude, made by Anthropic), which is one of the vendors covered in the comparison. Content was reviewed by the author.

underlines/reforger-clausewitz.readme:
# Clausewitz - AI High Command for Arma Reforger

Two AI headquarters wage a whole war against each other: they buy and command infantry, motorized, mechanized and armored units, build FOBs, run supply convoys, react to what their soldiers actually see (real fog of war) and brief their side with SITREPs. You fight inside that war on either side, as a rifleman or as a squad leader who gets missions from HQ and can radio requests back.

The commanders run on a built-in rule engine out of the box. Optionally, an **LLM** (any OpenAI-compatible API, e.g. OpenRouter) can take over each HQ through a small Node.js **sidecar** server. It also gives you a web dashboard with a live map of the war.

- **Workshop:** [Clausewitz - AI High Command](https://reforger.armaplatform.com/workshop/C1A05E7B3D9F4A28) (in game: Workshop, search "Clausewitz")
- **Source and sidecar:** this repository
- **License:** MIT (see `LICENSE`)

## Features
- Own game mode with a setup menu: factions for both sides (any playable faction incl. RHS, WCS and other packs), war mode, battle size, fixed or random start positions, objectives.
- Any map: ready scenarios for Arland, Everon and Kolguyev, plus an automatic scenario on other maps (HQs and objectives found at game start).
- Control points, tickets, supplies and income, bases with respawn, FOBs, convoys, vehicle depots, arsenals; war ends on tickets, hold-all or time limit.
- Human players join HQ squads from the deploy/groups menu, receive missions as squad leaders, read SITREPs (journal, `/sitrep`), and use `/request`, `/report`, `/hq <free text>` and the HQ menu at request terminals.
- English and German texts; with the LLM, every player gets SITREPs and HQ replies in their own language.
- HQ radial menu (hold **U**, or `/hqr`): report contacts (what, count, distance, direction or "ahead"), cancel your last report, call for backup, requests (vehicle by type, resupply, squad, reinforce, mission, status), SITREP, full HQ menu.
- Natural-language radio: `/hq 2 enemy infantry 100m north` becomes a contact report, `/hq need help` a backup call (needs the LLM sidecar).
- Weather and time in the setup menu: day speed 0x-96x, start date and hour, six weather slots (or random) blended over the war; HQ gets weather and daylight updates.
- HQ commander traits per side (aggressive, defensive, methodical, cautious, opportunistic, crazy, or random): they shape the rule commander, the LLM's decisions, SITREP tone and radio style.
- Loadouts (beta): save your kit at any arsenal; server loadout library on the dashboard with item names, types and prices. Works alongside loadout-editor mods such as WCS_LoadoutEditor.
- Pack factions field their own soldiers: missing roles are filled from the faction's own roster, borrowed kin vehicles carry the side's own infantry; arsenal items without a price get a default by type (`Configs/CLW/ArsenalPrices.conf`).
- No dependencies: base game only. RHS / WCS / GRS content is picked up automatically when loaded alongside.

## Playing / hosting without the LLM
Nothing else is needed. Subscribe to the mod, start one of the Clausewitz scenarios (Arland, Everon, Kolguyev). The first player gets the setup menu. With no sidecar running, both HQs use the rule commander.

Dedicated server (`config.json`):
```json
"game": {
  "scenarioId": "{C1A05E7B3D9F5A01}Missions/CLW_Arland.conf",
  "mods": [ { "modId": "C1A05E7B3D9F4A28", "name": "Clausewitz - AI High Command" } ]
}
```
Other scenarios: `{C1A05E7B3D9F5A02}Missions/CLW_Eden.conf` (Everon), `{C1A05E7B3D9F5A03}Missions/CLW_Cain.conf` (Kolguyev).

Server settings live in `<server profile>/Clausewitz/overrides.json` (an example is written on first start): unattended setup preset, catalog fixes, debug chat, sidecar URL and token. Reference: [`dev/notes/overrides.md`](dev/notes/overrides.md).

## The LLM sidecar (optional)
The sidecar is the Node.js server in [`dev/tools/`](dev/tools). The game server sends it each faction's situation every few seco

zhixiang28/spacegame.readme:
# SPACElogic Maker Space Arcade

Open `index.html` on the TV (serve it over https, e.g. GitHub Pages) and pick a game.

## Circuit Racers (phones as steering wheels)
1. Pick **Circuit Racers** on the TV. A QR code appears in the lobby.
2. Each player scans it with their phone camera, taps **Enable steering**, and holds the phone sideways like a wheel.
3. Tilt to steer. Left pedal = brake, right pedal = gas (auto-gas is on by default), **NITRO** button for a boost.
4. Player 1 can press **START RACE** on their phone, or use the TV (hand cursor / mouse / Enter).

- Up to 4 phones, split-screen on the TV. Empty seats are filled by CPU racers (6 cars total).
- Pick up gears to refill nitro. Toolboxes slow you down.
- No phone? Keyboard: arrows/WASD to drive, space for nitro.
- Phone to TV link is peer-to-peer (WebRTC via the free PeerJS relay). Both need internet access.
  To use your own relay add `?signal=host:port` (or `host:port:s` for https) to the TV URL.
- Phone settings (gear icon): auto-gas, invert steering, touch wheel fallback, re-centre.

## Filament Slice (hand tracking)
Up to 3 people can play side by side (each with their own score and lives). Swipe both hands (or the mouse) fast through flying filament spools (+10) and circuit boards (+15). Keep a combo going for up to x5.
Avoid the red-hot nozzles: each one you slice costs a power cell (3 lives). A shift lasts 75 s.

Files: `index.html` (TV: menu, Maker Run, Circuit Racers), `controller.html` (phone).

## Full screen and install
- The TV page goes full screen when you press **Start the station** (press **F** to toggle).
- In Chrome or Edge, use **Install as an app** on the start screen (or the install icon in the address bar) to get a desktop icon that opens full screen with no browser bars. Needs https.

## Wi-Fi QR in the racers lobby
Press **W** in the Circuit Racers lobby to enter the Wi-Fi name and password. A second QR code then appears so phones can join your network first.
It is saved only in that browser (localStorage), not in the repo, so the password is never published.

breeze92823/Shake-soda-escape-backend.readme:
# Shake Soda Escape — server

Colyseus server for the `Shake-soda-escape` client: progress saving, multiplayer presence
(poses, Bloxity avatars, held sodas, auras) and the two lobby leaderboards. Same stack and Bloxity
Legion deploy flow as `Clean-leaves-for-loot-backend`.

```
npm install
npm start        # tsx watch, ws://localhost:2567 (playground + /monitor in dev), GET /health
npm test         # mocha integration tests with an in-memory fake Mongo collection
npm run build    # -> build/, run with `node build/index.js` (see Dockerfile)
```

Config (all optional locally, see `.env.example`): `MONGODB_URI` (without it nothing persists),
`CLIENT_ORIGIN`, `PORT`.

## Protocol

Room: `world` (`joinOrCreate("world", { userId, username, avatar })`), up to 50 players per room;
extra players get a new room. `userId` is the Bloxity id; ids starting `guest-` are never saved.

| Client → server | Purpose |
| --- | --- |
| `pose` | `x y z yaw speed01 grounded pose` (~15 Hz) |
| `setAvatar` | Bloxity avatar JSON |
| `setEquipped` / `setAura` | equipped soda id / aura id (`""` = no aura) |
| `saveProgress` | the persisted `state.js` keys, debounced (sanitized, upserted in Mongo) |
| `identify` | `{ userId, username }` after a sign-in / sign-out; answered with `progress` / `noProgress` |

| Server → client | Purpose |
| --- | --- |
| `progress` | the saved document + `serverTime` (hydrates `state`) |
| `noProgress` | new account, guest, or no Mongo — keep the local state (and push it); carries `serverTime` |
| `serverError` | the saved document could not be read; the client must not overwrite it |
| `leaderboard` | `{ soda, rebirths }`, rows `{ id, name, value }`, top 8 (#1 row also carries `avatar`) |

Persisted keys (`src/sanitize.ts`): `soda wins level xp xpNext rebirths equipped owned passes record
sodaBoostUntil auras aura worlds dailyDay dailyClaimedAt`. Room state (`WorldState.players`) syncs pose,
equipped soda, aura, avatar, name and the leaderboard stats (`soda rebirths`).

The game is client-authoritative: the server only enforces shape and bounds on saves. The id lists
and caps in `src/constants.ts` (`SODA_IDS`, `AURA_IDS`, `PASS_IDS`, `WORLD_IDS`, `SPAWN`, `WORLD_BOUNDS`) must be
kept in step with the client's `src/config.js` by hand.

## Deploy

`.github/workflows/deploy.yml`: pull requests run build + tests; pushes to `dev` deploy the dev
channel and `main` the prod channel on Bloxity Legion (image pushed to GHCR).

GitHub settings (Settings → Secrets and variables → Actions):

| Name | Kind | Value |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `LEGION_GAME_ID` | repo **variable** (a secret also works) | the lowercase game id from the Bloxity "My Games" dashboard = the client's `GAME_SLUG`, `shake-soda-escape` |
| `LEGION_DEPLOY_TOKEN` | repo **secret** | the deploy token from the same dashboard |

`GITHUB_TOKEN` (used to push the image to GHCR) is provided automatically; the workflow requests
`packages: write` itself. `MONGODB_URI`, `CLIENT_ORIGIN` and `PORT` are injected by Legion at runtime,
not set in GitHub.

madelinben/board-game-score.readme:
# Board Game Score

Track scores for any board game and keep a running leaderboard.

Scoring modes: **highest wins**, **lowest wins**, **round by round** table, **teams**, **co-op** (win/lose together). Data stays in the browser (localStorage).

Two ways this repo ships, from the same `src/`:

| Target | How |
|---|---|
| **GitHub Pages** (`madelinben.github.io/board-game-score/`) | `pnpm build:demo` builds `demo/` into `docs/` (Pages source: `main` / `/docs`) |
| **get-out-there** (Cloudflare) | imported as workspace package `@get-out-there/board-games` (`BoardGamesApp`) |

```bash
pnpm install
pnpm dev          # demo at http://localhost:3102/board-game-score/
pnpm test         # scoring logic unit tests
pnpm build:demo   # static site -> docs/
```

Package rules: no router/auth/app imports; Tailwind default palette only (no custom tokens); host must `@source` this folder. Peer deps: react, react-dom, lucide-react.

levikore/roeto-dice-game.readme: # Roeto Dice Game Two-player dice game. **All rules run in an authenticated backend API**; the React app only shows what the server returns and sends actions (roll, hold, new game). **Rules:** roll two dice as often as you like and add them to the round score. A double six loses the round score and passes the turn. Hold banks the round score and passes the turn. First to the winning score (default 100, you can change it) wins. You can start a new game at any time. ## Demo ## Quick start Needs Node 22.18+ (runs TypeScript and SQLite built in) and npm. ```bash npm install npm run setup # creates .env with a random JWT secret, seeds the demo users npm run dev # API on :3000, app on http://localhost:5173 ``` Demo users: `alice` and `bob`, password `demo1234` (set in `.env`). Both players log in on the same page (Player 1 and Player 2 panels); pick **Bot** instead of Player 2 to play the AI. ## How it is built ``` React app ──/api──▶ Express API ──▶ pure game engine (rules) (no rules) (auth, validation, transactions) ──▶ SQLite ``` - **`server/src/game/engine.ts`** holds every rule as a pure function, tested to 100% branch coverage plus 1000 random games. It cannot import Express, the database or `fs` (lint rule). - **Auth:** username + password (bcrypt), 24 h JWT. The player is always taken from the token, never from the request body. - **State:** games, scores, wins and an event log are in SQLite (`node:sqlite`, no extra install). Each game has a `version`; stale or double-sent requests are rejected. - **Client:** shows the `game` object the server returns, including `allowedActions` and `lockRemainingMs`. It computes no scores or turns. - Requirements, data model and the reasons behind each choice: [docs/design.md](docs/design.md). API reference with a curl walkthrough: [docs/api.md](docs/api.md). ## Assumptions 1. A win is checked only on Hold, not after each roll. 2. Hold with a round score of 0 is rejected. 3. Either player may start a new game at any time; an unfinished game is marked abandoned (no winner) and the new one keeps the players, order and winning score. 4. Winning score: whole number 10–1000. 5. Two users on one page = one login per player; the server checks that the token belongs to the player whose turn it is. 6. Only a double six ends a turn; a single six does nothing. ## Extras built Win counts and leaderboard · data kept in SQLite · double-six pause (server-enforced, shown with a message and animation) · AI opponent that plays inside the same request, so it uses the same rules as a human · move history panel. Not built: sound, live updates across browsers, deployment. ## Tests ```bash npm test # 153 server + 49 client tests npm run test:coverage -w @dice/server # engine: 100% branches npm run e2e # Playwright smoke test (uses installed Chrome) npm run lint && npm run typecheck npm run play-game -w @dice/server -- 7 30 # prints one seeded game, move by move ``` | Requirement | Proven by | |---|---| | Rules (roll, double six, hold, win, custom score) | engine unit + property tests, API tests, e2e | | New game any time | API tests | | Auth, only logged-in users play, only the current player acts | auth, security and games API tests | | No game logic in the client | grep audit of the client for rule code (none found); client tests use server-made fixtures | | Wins, persistence, double-six pause, bot | API tests, simulation of 1000 bot games, client tests | ## Known limits Logins are stateless tokens, so a stolen token works until it expires (24 h) and there is no server-side logout. The API is plain HTTP for local use. Rate limiting covers login and r

EnneBoh/Games.readme:
# Playbox — games hub

A static, build-free container for small browser games. Vanilla HTML/CSS/ES modules, hash routing, installable PWA.

**Run:** `npx serve .` (any static host works: GitHub Pages, Cloudflare Pages, nginx — all paths are relative).

**Add a game**
1. `cp -r games/_template games/<id>` and build it (see `games/_template/README.md`).
2. Add an entry to `games/games.json` (`id` = folder name, `status: "ready"`).
3. Bump `version` when you ship changes (busts the cache for that game).
4. Deploy. Nothing else in the hub changes.

chan-wung/dooms-game.readme:
# doom-js

브라우저에서 돌아가는 **DOOM 엔진 재구현** (바닐라 JS, 의존성 없음). 셰어웨어 `DOOM1.WAD`를 읽어 E1M1~E1M9를 실제로 플레이할 수 있다.

> 이 저장소에는 게임 데이터(WAD)가 **들어 있지 않다.** 엔진 코드만 있고, 데이터는 직접 준비해야 한다. ([라이선스](#라이선스) 참고)

## 실행

```bash
npm install
# 셰어웨어 DOOM1.WAD (v1.9) 를 public/wad/DOOM1.WAD 에 넣는다
npm run dev          # http://localhost:5173
```

WAD 를 넣지 않았다면 페이지에서 파일을 끌어다 놓거나 선택하면 된다. 한 번 고른 WAD 는 **이 브라우저(IndexedDB)에만** 저장되어 다음부터는 다시 고르지 않아도 된다 (서버로 전송되지 않는다).

```bash
npm run build        # dist/ 생성 (WAD 는 자동으로 제외됨)
npm test             # 게임 로직/전투/저장/규칙/렌더 테스트 (public/wad/DOOM1.WAD 필요)
```

## 조작

| 입력 | 동작 |
|---|---|
| `WASD` | 이동 (`Shift` 달리기) |
| `←` `→` / 마우스 | 회전 (화면 클릭으로 마우스 시점) |
| `Ctrl` / `F` / 마우스 왼쪽 | 발사 |
| `E` / `Space` | 사용 (문, 스위치) |
| `1`~`5` / 휠 | 무기 교체 (주먹·전기톱, 권총, 샷건, 체인건, 로켓) |
| `Tab` | 오토맵 |
| `Esc` | 메뉴 (일시정지, 저장/불러오기, 옵션: 소리·마우스·화면 크기·밝기·맵 선택·치트). 하위 메뉴에는 `< BACK` 버튼이 있다 |
| `F6` / `F9` | 퀵세이브 / 퀵로드 (마지막으로 쓴 슬롯) |
| `R` | 재시작 (맵을 시작했을 때의 상태로). 죽은 뒤에는 `E`(USE)로도 |
| `F1` `F2` `F3` `F4` | 도움말 / 저장 / 불러오기 / 소리 |
| `F7` `F8` `F10` `F11` | 게임 끝내기 / 메시지 켜기·끄기 / 종료 / 밝기 |
| `-` `=` | 화면 크기 줄이기·늘리기 (3~11) |
| `Enter` / `Space` | 결과·엔딩 화면 넘기기 |
| 치트 (원작 코드) | `IDDQD` 무적, `IDKFA` 무기·탄약·열쇠, `IDFA` 무기·탄약, `IDCLIP` 노클립, `IDDT` 오토맵 전체 보기, `IDBEHOLD`+`V S I R A L` 파워업, `IDCHOPPERS` 전기톱, `IDMYPOS` 위치, `IDCLEV`+에피소드·맵 두 자리 |

키보드가 없는 터치 기기에서는 **옵션 → CHEATS** 메뉴로 같은 치트를 쓸 수 있다.

터치 기기에서는 왼쪽 스틱(이동), 오른쪽 스틱·화면 드래그(회전), FIRE / USE / 무기 번호 / MAP / MENU 버튼이 나온다 (데스크톱에서 확인하려면 주소 뒤에 `?touch=1`). 처음 시작할 때 조작 안내가 한 번 나오고, 오토맵에서는 두 손가락으로 확대·축소, 한 손가락으로 이동한다. 앱을 전환하면(전화 등) 자동으로 일시정지되고 AUTO 슬롯에 저장되어, 브라우저가 페이지를 정리해도 타이틀의 `CONTINUE` 로 이어서 할 수 있다. 게임 중 새 게임을 시작할 때는 확인 창이 뜬다.

## 구현 범위

| 영역 | 내용 |
|---|---|
| 데이터 | WAD 디렉터리, 레벨 lump(THINGS·LINEDEFS·SIDEDEFS·VERTEXES·SEGS·SSECTORS·NODES·SECTORS·BLOCKMAP), PLAYPAL/COLORMAP, 패치, 텍스처·flat 합성, 스프라이트 |
| 렌더링 | BSP 앞→뒤 순회, 열 단위 가림 처리, 텍스처 벽·바닥·천장·하늘, COLORMAP 조명, 스프라이트(8방향·반전), 양면선 투명 텍스처, 픽셀 깊이 버퍼 |
| 게임 | 35Hz 고정 틱, 관성·마찰 이동, BLOCKMAP 충돌과 슬라이딩, 계단·낙하, 문·리프트·바닥·계단·도넛·조명·텔레포트(텔레프래그·안개, 몬스터도 이용)·출구·데미지 바닥·비밀 구역, 애니메이션 텍스처(슬라임·SLADRIP) |
| 전투 | 무기 6종, 자동 조준, 히트스캔, 로켓·폭발, 몬스터 AI(좀비맨·샷건맨·임프·데몬·스펙터·바론), 투사체, 통, 드롭, 난이도 5단계(악몽 난이도의 몬스터 부활 포함) |
| 저장 | 맵 도중 저장/불러오기(위치·몬스터·문/리프트·아이템·오토맵까지), 슬롯 6개(AUTO + 수동 5), 퀵세이브, 맵 이어받기 |
| UI | 원작 상태바·얼굴·무기 스프라이트, 타이틀·메뉴·옵션(화면 크기·밝기·메시지·도움말·확인 창·치트), 화면 녹는 전환, 원작 점수 화면과 에피소드 엔딩, 원작 오토맵 규칙(본 선만), 피격·아이템·방사능복 화면 색조, 터치 조작 |
| 오디오 | WAD 효과음(거리·좌우 정위), MUS 음악을 Web Audio 로 합성해 재생 |

셰어웨어 WAD 에 없는 것(플라즈마·BFG, 카코데몬·로스트소울 등, 정식판 전용 애니메이션 텍스처)과 크러셔·영구 리프트(셰어웨어 맵에서 쓰지 않음)는 만들지 않았다. 타이틀 데모 자동 재생과 멀티플레이도 하지 않기로 했다.

## 구조

```
src/
├─ wad/      WAD·레벨 파서, WAD 저장소(IndexedDB)
├─ gfx/      팔레트, 패치, 텍스처, 스프라이트
├─ render/   BSP 렌더러, 화면 출력
├─ game/     플레이어, 물리, 충돌, 특수 효과, 아이템, 몬스터 AI, 전투, 무기, 세이브(savegame.js)
├─ ui/       상태바, 메뉴, 오토맵, 터치, 점수 화면·엔딩(intermission.js)
├─ audio/    효과음, MUS 음악 합성
├─ app/      입력, 저장소(localStorage), 맵 진행 순서
└─ main.js   앱 상태와 메인 루프
legacy/      초기 레이캐스터 데모 (참고용)
tests/       시뮬레이션 기반 테스트 (npm test)
```

## 배포

정적 사이트라 Vercel 등에 그대로 올릴 수 있다 (`npm run build` → `dist/`). 빌드 때 `dist/wad`는 지워지고 `.vercelignore`가 `public/wad`를 업로드에서 제외하므로, **배포본에는 WAD 가 포함되지 않고** 방문자가 자기 WAD 를 올려 쓴다.

## 라이선스

- 엔진 코드는 직접 작성했다. 원작 DOOM 소스(GPL)는 구조를 참고했을 뿐 복사하지 않았다.
- `DOOM1.WAD`(셰어웨어)는 id Software 의 저작물이며 별개의 라이선스를 따른다. 이 저장소에 포함하지 않는다. 정식판(`DOOM.WAD`, `DOOM2.WAD`)은 재배포할 수 없다.

MaKyS0/races.readme:
# Apex GP Simulator

3D-симулятор гонок класса Formula 1 с упором на физику, а не на аркаду. Один код для ПК (браузер), Android и iOS
(Capacitor). Всё — собственная физика болида (без физических движков), Three.js для рендера; текстуры и трассы генерируются процедурно,
звук двигателей — реальные записи F1 (подключаются отдельным шагом, см. «Звук двигателей») либо синтез. Команды и пилоты вымышленные.

> **Статус честно.** Игра собирается, работает в браузере, проходит 105 автотестов. Debug- и подписанный (тестовым
> ключом) release-APK действительно собраны на Linux. **IPA не собирался** (нужен Mac + Apple Developer). **Ни на одном
> реальном телефоне игра не запускалась** — цифры FPS/нагрева/батареи для устройств не измерены. Подробности —
> [docs/STATUS.md](docs/STATUS.md).

## Быстрый старт

```bash
npm ci
npm run dev        # http://localhost:5173  (vite --host, доступно по сети для проверки с телефона)
npm test           # 105 тестов: физика, трассы, столкновения, ИИ, гонка, ввод/кнопки, сцепление на выходе из поворота
npm run build      # статика в dist/
```

Требуется Node ≥ 20. Для Android/iOS — см. [docs/BUILD.md](docs/BUILD.md).

## Что внутри

**Физика (120 Гц, фиксированный шаг, интерполяция при рендере)**
- Двигатель + КПП: кривая момента, ограничитель оборотов, 8 передач, сцепление, пробуксовка колёс, ERS (MGU-K) и топливо.
- Аэродинамика: прижим ∝ v², сопротивление, слипстрим, «грязный воздух», DRS, влияние клиренса и повреждений.
- Шины: составы Soft/Medium/Hard/Inter/Wet, температура (поверхность/ядро), износ, комбинированное проскальзывание
  (формула Пачейки), аквапланинг, проколы, зависимость от покрытия (асфальт, поребрик, трава, гравий, пит-лейн).
- Тормоза: прогрессивное давление, баланс, нагрев/фейд дисков, ABS (только если включён ассист), рекуперация.
- Подвеска: тангаж/крен/вертикаль (3 степени свободы), стабилизаторы, перенос нагрузки, отклик на поребрики и неровности.
- Столкновения: импульсы в точке контакта, OBB машина↔машина, стены, модель повреждений по узлам (передние/задние
  крылья, днище, подвеска, колёса, силовая установка), отрыв деталей, снятие с гонки.
- Флаги: жёлтые, Safety Car, VSC, штрафы за лимиты трассы, столкновения, превышение скорости в пит-лейне.

**Контент**
- 6 трасс с собственной геометрией, профилем высот, поребриками, зонами выбега, стенами, пит-лейном, сеткой и DRS:
  Monaco, Monza, Spa-Francorchamps, Silverstone, Suzuka, Bahrain (вдохновлены реальными, но это не копии).
- Режимы: Time Trial (с призраком), Practice, Qualifying, Grand Prix, Championship (календарь + очки).
- Погода: сухо / лёгкий дождь / ливень / динамическая; лужи, аквапланинг, молнии, брызги.
- 10 вымышленных команд, 20 пилотов, 4 уровня сложности.

**ИИ-соперники** используют тот же `Vehicle`, что и игрок, и управляют только педалями и рулём: racing line
(минимальная кривизна), профиль скоростей по трению, следование (IDM-подобное с учётом торможения лидера), слой
предсказания столкновений (TTC), атаки и защита, ошибки под давлением, пит-стопы с выбором шин, обход вылетевших машин.

**Интерфейс и управление**
- HUD: скорость, обороты, передача, круги/позиция, тайминг, дельта, шины (температура/износ), тормоза, топливо, ERS,
  DRS, флаги и сообщения, миникарта, погода, повторы.
- Клавиатура, геймпад, сенсор, переназначение клавиш, чувствительность/линейность/мёртвая зона, ассисты (ABS, TC, помощь рулём,
  карта давления тормозов, авто-КПП, линия) — физику они не заменяют.
- **Сенсорное управление — только цифровые кнопки:** GAS справа внизу, BRAKE левее, руль ◀ ▶ слева, плюс PIT/ERS/DRS/камера/передачи/пауза.
  Держишь — газ/тормоз, отпустил — снято. Одновременное нажатие (мультитач), сброс при потере фокуса. Размер, прозрачность и
  положение каждой кнопки настраиваются (Settings → Touch → Edit layout). Подробности и результаты проверок:
  [docs/CHANGELOG-physics-controls.md](docs/CHANGELOG-physics-controls.md).

| Действие | Клавиша по умолчанию |
|---|---|
| Газ / тормоз | W, ↑ / S, ↓ |
| Руль | A, D

MiyazakiSora1234/quiz-knights.readme:
# QUIZ KNIGHTS（クイズ騎士団）

早押しクイズと連携する、職業ありのバトルゲーム。遠隔参加の早押し付き。

## 構成
- `app/` … フロント（Svelte 5 + Vite）
  - `src/lib/engine.js` ゲームの全ルール（画面に依存しない）。`app/test/` に自動テスト一式
    - `engine/jobs/interactions` 個別ルール、`explore` 全職業×全行動×全対象の分岐を総当たり、`fuzz` 数万手のランダム戦闘で毎手の整合性を検査、`server` 早押し・部屋・引き継ぎ
  - `src/lib/net.js` WebSocket 接続（自動再接続・サーバーとの時計ずれ補正）
  - `src/lib/host.svelte.js` 進行役の状態（部屋・名簿・早押し受付）
  - `src/pages/` 部屋一覧 `List` / 進行役 `Host`（準備・バトル）/ 参加者 `Play`
  - `src/theme.css` 共通デザイン（金=主操作、緑=正解・回復、赤=誤答・敵、青=味方）
- `src/worker.js` … サーバー（Cloudflare Workers + Durable Objects）
  - 部屋ごとに1つの Durable Object が早押しの時計を一括管理し、同時押しは「押下時刻＋ディレイ」で判定
- `dist/` … ビルド結果（Git 管理外）。Workers Assets で配信

## 開発
```
npm install
npm test              # 自動テスト（ルール・全分岐・ランダム戦闘・サーバー。約180件）
npm run build         # app/ → dist/
npm run worker        # http://localhost:8787 （ビルド済みの dist を配信）
npm run dev           # Vite 開発サーバー（:5173、/api と /ws は :8787 にプロキシ）
```
`npm run dev` を使うときは、別のターミナルで `npm run worker` も起動してください。

## 公開（Cloudflare 無料プラン）
```
npx wrangler login
npm run deploy        # ビルドしてデプロイ
```
`main` への push で自動デプロイしたい場合は、GitHub の Secrets に
`CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN` と `CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID` を登録してください（`.github/workflows/deploy.yml`）。
動作確認用に別名で公開するなら `npx wrangler deploy --name quiz-knights-dev`。

## 早押し判定
- 各端末が時計ずれを補正した押下時刻を送信し、サーバーが `押下時刻 + ディレイ` の最小の人を勝者にします。
- 通信遅延の許容は `TOLERANCE_MS`（`src/worker.js`、既定150ms）。
- バーサーカーは +700ms（`app/src/lib/engine.js` の `BERSERKER_DELAY_MS`）。

## 部屋
- 1〜16番の固定枠。進行役が30分不在だと自動で閉じます。
- 進行役を別の画面で開くと、後から開いた画面が引き継ぎ、前の画面は停止します。

VuloB1/MegaManLegendsRecomp.readme:
# MegaManLegends Recompiled [![GitHub downloads (all assets, all releases)](https://img.shields.io/github/downloads/VuloB1/MegaManLegendsRecomp/total)](https://github.com/VuloB1/MegaManLegendsRecomp/releases) [![GitHub downloads (latest release)](https://img.shields.io/github/downloads/VuloB1/MegaManLegendsRecomp/latest/total)](https://github.com/VuloB1/MegaManLegendsRecomp/releases/latest) [![GitHub release](https://img.shields.io/github/v/release/VuloB1/MegaManLegendsRecomp)](https://github.com/VuloB1/MegaManLegendsRecomp/releases/latest) Static recompilation of **MegaManLegends** built on [psxrecomp](https://github.com/mstan/psxrecomp) and [recomp-ui](https://github.com/RetroPortingToolKit/recomp-ui). Mega Man Legends static recompilation | | | |---|---| | Players | 2 | | Region | USA | | Publisher | Capcom | | Year | 1997 | Scaffolded with the New Project Layout. See `psxrecomp/docs/GAME_PROJECT_SETUP.md` for the full flow. ## Modern enhancements Every enhancement is a mod package (`mods/preloaded/packages/`) and can be toggled in the launcher's Mods page. | Mod | What it does | |---|---| | Widescreen (`mml.enhancement.widescreen`) | Native 16:9 (21:9 option, untested). The 3D scene is drawn into the extra width: terrain visibility cone widened, parallax sky tiles extended. | | Modern Controls (`mml.enhancement.controls`) | Left stick walks in any direction (analog heading), right stick turns the camera and looks up/down. Holding R2 no longer freezes walking while the stick is tilted. | | Frame Rate (`mml.enhancement.frame-rate`) | 60 / 120 Hz / display-rate presentation. "Repeat frames" (default) avoids ghosting; "Blend" smooths but ghosts moving models. | | Skip FMVs (`mml.enhancement.skip-fmvs`) | Skips the video cutscenes. | | PGXP Precision (`psx.enhancement.pgxp`) | Sub-pixel vertex precision. `game.toml` also turns on exact projection, a depth buffer and seam closing to fix cracks between model polygons and wrong draw order. | Plugin sources: `src/mods/`. Reverse-engineering notes for the controls (pad structs, player object, move wrapper): `CONTROLS_NOTES.md`. Known limits: a thin white line can appear along some terrain edges at some camera angles; HD texture packs are not shipped. ## Building Needs a C compiler toolchain (the project was built with the [retcomm toolchain](https://github.com/RetroPortingToolKit/RetroPorting-Toolchains/releases/latest), clang) on `PATH`, CMake and Ninja, and your own disc image. ```bash cmake -S . -B build-release -G Ninja -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release cmake --build build-release ``` For debugging, configure a second build with `-DPSX_DEBUG_TOOLS=ON`, run it with `--no-launcher --headless --debug-port 4370 --memcard-dir `, and drive it with `tools/dbg.py`. ## Retro Launcher You can run this title **standalone** (download the release zip, point it at your disc, play), or manage installs, updates, and disc/BIOS wiring with **[Retro Launcher](https://github.com/RetroPortingToolKit/Retro-Launcher)** — the Retro Compilation Manager hub for self-compiling recomps. [Downloads](https://github.com/RetroPortingToolKit/Retro-Launcher/releases) · [Full README & features](https://github.com/RetroPortingToolKit/Retro-Launcher#readme)

Retro checks for updates, installs the prebuilt release zips, and automates BIOS/ROM/save plumbing so you are not stuck repeating each game’s first run by hand.

dodai092/oche.desc: Oche: local darts scoring with visit totals, x01 games, profiles and statistics
dodai092/oche.readme:
# Oche

A playable local darts scorer with an original charcoal-and-lime interface. Built with Next.js App Router, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, a themed shadcn/ui Button, Lucide and Zustand. Rules live in a deterministic engine independent of the UI.

## Test on iPhone

Open https://dodai092.github.io/oche/ in Safari. Visit Settings and wait for Ready offline before disconnecting. Safari Share > Add to Home Screen adds the app with its own icon and standalone layout. The first download needs a connection. Match data stays in that browser; JSON export/import can transfer a scorebook.

Repository: https://github.com/dodai092/oche

GitHub Actions publishes pushes to main. CI enables `GITHUB_PAGES=true` and `NEXT_PUBLIC_BASE_PATH=/oche`, producing static HTML for every screen in out/. Ordinary local builds still support `npm start`. See [deployment notes](docs/DEPLOYMENT.md).

## Start

Verified environment: macOS, Node 26.7.0, npm 11.19.0, Git 2.54.0. Exact dependency versions are pinned in package.json and package-lock.json.

```sh
cd /Users/antunzebec/Work/Private/oche
npm ci
npm run dev
```

Open [http://127.0.0.1:3000](http://127.0.0.1:3000). Dependencies are already installed. For the next launch, only `npm run dev` is needed from this folder. Stop the server with Ctrl+C.

Production:

```sh
npm run build
npm start
```

The production build uses Next.js's supported webpack compiler. Turbopack's production PostCSS subprocess hit a local port restriction in this managed environment, including after escalation. The webpack build succeeded. The development server uses the default Next compiler.

## Play

Choose a starting score, checkout rule, first-to legs and sets, and one to four players. Select saved players from each profile picker or enter guest names. Unsaved guests have unique match identities.

Visit total is the default. Use the touch keypad or choose Use keyboard to type and press Enter. Common-score presets fill the entry for submission. The app remembers your input mode and keyboard choice. Use the expandable darts and checkout controls to report a shorter visit or darts thrown at a finish. Double-out checkouts require confirmation. Undo score removes the entire submitted visit. Totals are saved without inventing individual segment hits.

During mobile play, scores and controls fill the screen. Open More match details for statistics, checkout routes and recent visits. Turn feedback reports the last score or bust immediately. After completion, Rematch with these players starts a fresh match with the same lineup and rules while keeping the previous result in history.

Switch to Dart-by-dart for individual throws. Select Single, Double or Triple, then tap a numbered segment. Multiplier selection stays active within the visit and resets when the visit ends. Dedicated bull buttons always score 25 or 50. Miss scores zero. The third dart changes turns automatically. Bust restores the entire visit score.

End turn closes a partial visit using only the darts entered. On an empty visit it records three misses and passes play. Undo dart reopens the previous dart, even after a bust or winning checkout. Undo turn removes the current partial visit, or the most recent completed visit when no darts have been entered.

Scores and settings save after each change. Completing a match adds it to history. Undoing the winning dart removes that result until the match finishes again. Starting a new match over an unfinished one requires an explicit replacement click.

Choose Cricket under Game in setup for Standard or Cut-throat scoring, 2 to 4 local players and first to N legs. Cricket is entered dart by dart on 15 to 20 and the bull, with undo dart, undo turn and end turn. Cricket matches share history, backup and rematch with x01. There is no DartBot, No-score variant, solo practice, sets, Cricket statistics or speech for Cricket yet.

cosq-in/bhaag-cockroach-bhaag.desc: Delhi Runner 3D: mobile-first endless runner (satire) with Three.js
cosq-in/bhaag-cockroach-bhaag.readme:
# Bhaag Cockroach Bhaag

*"Resign kar yaar."* A mobile-first 3D endless runner (satire) set on a Jantar Mantar street. You are a cockroach running from a lathi-wielding constable: ride ramps onto bus roofs, grab chai and witness tokens, bank power-ups, and try not to get detained. Fan satire, not affiliated with any movement, party or person.

## Run it
```
npm start        # http://127.0.0.1:8000  (allowlist-only, loopback-only server)
npm test         # unit tests for all game logic and the server allowlist
```
Open it on a phone through a tunnel (for example `ngrok http 127.0.0.1:8000`).

## Controls
Swipe left/right to change lane, up to jump, down to slide, tap to use a banked power-up. Keyboard: arrows or WASD, Space, M to mute.

## Customising
- `assets/posters/manifest.json` - meme posters by role: `banner`, `road`, `standee`, `building`.
- `assets/sfx/manifest.json` - custom sound clips per game event (see `assets/sfx/README.md`).
- `src/stages.js` - stages, hazards, slogans (the slogans are tone placeholders).
- Dev flags: `?autostart`, `?skip=N`, `?over`, `?tut=chai`, `?resettut`.

## Analytics (PostHog, optional)
Anonymous play events (run started/ended, chai, witness, power-ups, WiFi revive) are sent to PostHog when `POSTHOG_PROJECT_TOKEN` and `POSTHOG_HOST` are set. Copy `.env.example` to `.env` and fill them in; `npm start` loads it (needs Node 22.9+). Without them nothing is sent. Autocapture, session replay and Do-Not-Track-ignoring are disabled. Only the public project token is used; never put a personal API key (`phx_...`) in this repo.

## Safety notes
`serve.mjs` serves only the game files, so `.git`, docs and tests are never exposed. Do not replace it with a general static server when sharing publicly.

## Credits
See `assets/CREDITS.md`. Three.js is MIT (`vendor/THREE-LICENSE`). Kenney models are CC0. The humanoid cockroach is by Gandpop. The meme posters and sound clips were supplied by the project owner; their provenance and licences are unverified, so check them before any public release.

baconspaceman/yammel.desc: Yammel: a free, open-source desktop editor for Archipelago player YAMLs. Every option of every game, a problem checker, live check count, difficulty gauge, randomize, presets, a helper chat and more.
baconspaceman/yammel.readme:
Yammel

Make Archipelago player files without ever hand-editing text.
Every option of every game, checked the way Archipelago will check it.

Yammel is a free, open-source desktop app for making the player files (YAMLs) that [Archipelago](https://archipelago.gg), the multiworld randomizer, uses to build a game. Pick a game, flip switches, set numbers, and watch the YAML write itself. It tells you what would go wrong in plain words **before** Archipelago stops with an error, and it can even make a test seed to prove the file works. **Nothing is required.** There is no account, no login and no API key. The editor works fully offline. A few extras (a live check count, seed making, custom worlds) use your own copy of Archipelago, and the AI helpers are off until you switch them on. ## Contents - [Download](#download) - [Quick start](#quick-start) - [What it can do](#what-it-can-do) - [What needs what](#what-needs-what) - [Documentation](#documentation) - [Run it from source](#run-it-from-source) - [Command line and agent tools](#command-line-and-agent-tools) - [Privacy and safety](#privacy-and-safety) - [Contributing](#contributing) - [Credits and disclaimer](#credits-and-disclaimer) - [Licence](#licence) ## Download Get the latest version from the **[Releases page](https://github.com/baconspaceman/yammel/releases/latest)**. | File | What it is | | --- | --- | | `Yammel-Setup-.exe` | A normal installer. It installs for your own account and does not need administrator rights. | | `Yammel-Portable-.exe` | One file you can run from anywhere, for example a USB stick. Nothing is installed. | | `SHA256SUMS.txt` | Checksums, so you can confirm a download is the one that was built. | > **Windows may say "unknown publisher" (SmartScreen).** The downloads are not code-signed, because a signing > certificate costs money every year. Choose **More info**, then **Run anyway**. The whole source code is in this > repository and the releases are built by [GitHub Actions](.github/workflows/release.yml) from a tagged commit, so you > can check what you are running, or build it yourself ([instructions](docs/development/building-and-running.md)). Windows is the supported platform. The code is cross-platform Electron, and it may run elsewhere from source, but that is not tested. ## Quick start 1. Start the app and click a game on the start screen (or **Open a YAML file** if you already have one). 2. Change the options you care about. The YAML on the right updates as you go. Anything you leave alone keeps the game's own default. 3. Look at the line under the name fields: it says **No problems found** or tells you, in plain words, what to fix, usually with a one-click fix. 4. Press **Save**. The old file is backed up first. New here? Read **[Getting started](docs/guide/getting-started.

# Cozy 2D MMORPG (เกม MMORPG 2D บนเว็บ)

เกม 2D MMORPG สไตล์ Classic (แรงบันดาลใจจาก Ragnarok Online / ECO) เล่นบนเบราว์เซอร์ มีมัลติเพลเยอร์ซิงค์สดผ่าน WebSocket

## วิธีรัน
```bash
npm install
npm start        # เปิด http://localhost:3000 (เปลี่ยนพอร์ตด้วย PORT=xxxx)
```

## การควบคุม
- `WASD` เดิน (ใช้ได้ทุกภาษาแป้นพิมพ์) · `Enter` เปิดช่องแชทเพื่อพิมพ์ / `Enter` อีกครั้งเพื่อส่งและกลับไปเดิน · `Esc` ยกเลิกพิมพ์ · คลิกขวา ล็อคเป้าหมาย · คลิกซ้าย โจมตี · `1-9` สกิล
- ปุ่ม ⚙ Option มุมขวาบนรวมเมนูทั้งหมด · ปุ่มลัด: `C` สเตตัส · `I` กระเป๋า · `P` ปาร์ตี้ · `J` เควสต์ · `T` สมุดสมบัติ · `K` ร้าน/กาชา · `M` แผนที่

## ฟีเจอร์ที่มีในเกมตอนนี้
- **ไม่มีอาชีพ**: ความเก่งมาจากสเตตัส + อาวุธที่ถือ (สกิลจะมาทีหลัง)
  - สเตตัส 6 ตัว: STR (ประชิด) / AGI (ความเร็ว) / VIT (HP, DEF) / DEX (ธนู) / INT (คฑา) / LUK (คริ) — ได้ 4 แต้มต่อเลเวล
  - ระยะโจมตีตามอาวุธ: มือเปล่า 55 · กิ่งไม้ 75 · ดาบ 80 · ธนู 260 · คฑา 230 (ธนู/คฑายิงกระสุนได้ไกล)
  - เริ่มต้นด้วย **กิ่งไม้** ไม่มีสกิล; แถบสกิล 1-9 ว่างให้ผู้เล่นตั้งเอง (ยังไม่มีสกิลให้ใส่)
  - เลเวลใช้เป็นเงื่อนไขสวมอาวุธ/เกราะหายาก (เช่น ดาบมังกร ต้อง Lv.75)
- **9 แผนที่** (ตอนนี้เป็นพื้นเรียบ + กริด 32px ไว้เติมของทีหลัง): Central Town (โซนปลอดภัย), Green Meadows, Misty Forest, Bandit Hideout, Goblin Caverns, Lava Volcano, Bone Crypt, Haunted Ruins, Dragon's Lair — แมพละ 4 ชนิดมอนสเตอร์ (Haunted Ruins มี 2 ชนิดเพราะมอนสเตอร์เหลือแค่นี้)
- **มอนสเตอร์** server คุมทั้งหมด: เดินเล่น/ไล่ผู้เล่น/โจมตี ทุกคนเห็นเหมือนกัน แย่งกันตีได้ (คนฆ่าได้รางวัล) รีสปอนอัตโนมัติ
- **ไอเทม**: อาวุธ กิ่งไม้/ดาบ/ธนู/คฑา, เกราะ, ยา HP, วัตถุดิบดรอป
- **คราฟต์ไอเทม** จากวัตถุดิบที่ดรอป
- **สมุดสมบัติ (Relics)**: สมบัติในตำนานดรอปจากมอนสเตอร์/บอส ให้โบนัสถาวร
- **เควสต์** พร้อมตัวติดตามเควสต์บน HUD
- **ร้านค้า & กาชา** (Gold / Token)
- **Auto Hunt**: ตั้งระยะ (ช่อง), เลือกมอนสเตอร์ที่จะตี, ใช้ยา HP อัตโนมัติ (% และชนิดยา) · ช่องยา HP ด่วน (ปุ่ม Q)
- **ปาร์ตี้** สูงสุด 6 คน: สร้าง/เชิญ/ออก, เปลี่ยนหัวหน้า, เปลี่ยนชื่อ, เตะสมาชิก, ประกาศคนเข้า-ออกในแชท
  - ตั้งค่าได้: หาร EXP (+25% โบนัส, เฉพาะคนที่อยู่แมพเดียวกัน) หรือ ใครฆ่าคนนั้นได้ / รับสมาชิกอัตโนมัติ / เงื่อนไขเลเวล
  - แยกแท็บ "สร้างปาร์ตี้" / "ค้นหาปาร์ตี้" — ค้นหากรองตามเลเวลหัวหน้าและแมพ, ขอเข้าร่วมแล้วหัวหน้าอนุมัติ
- **มัลติเพลเยอร์**: เห็นผู้เล่นอื่นแบบเรียลไทม์ พร้อมอนิเมชันเดิน/โจมตี/สกิล
- **ซูมเข้า/ออก**: ล้อเมาส์ (หรือปุ่ม +/- ข้างมินิแมพ / คีย์ + -) ซูมออกได้ไม่เกินขอบแมพ จำค่าไว้ · ทุกแมพเข้าได้ทุกเลเวล · ตัวละครใหม่ได้ชื่อสุ่มชั่วคราว (ยังไม่มีระบบล็อกอิน)
- **คลิกเควสต์** (ในแผงซ้ายหรือหน้าต่างเควสต์) → ถามยืนยันแล้วพาไปแมพที่มีมอนสเตอร์เป้าหมาย
- **หน้าต่างลอยหลายบาน**: เปิดค้างไว้พร้อมกันได้ ลากย้ายได้ จำตำแหน่งและหน้าต่างที่เปิดไว้ (Esc ปิดบานบนสุด) ส่วนแผงปาร์ตี้/เควสต์ซ้ายบนพับเก็บได้
- **แชท** แยกแท็บ (รวม / ระบบ / ดรอป / สมบัติ) และย่อเหลือแค่ไอคอน 💬 ได้ (มีตัวเลขข้อความที่ยังไม่อ่าน)
- **มินิแมพ**, เสียงเอฟเฟกต์ (เปิด/ปิดได้), เซฟข้อมูลผู้เล่นใน localStorage

## ยังไม่ได้ทำ (ดู `GAME_SPEC.md` และ `PLAN.md`)
- ระบบตีบวก +1 ถึง +10 (มีแค่ตารางข้อมูล)
- ระบบจับสัตว์เลี้ยง / Pet (มีแค่ตารางข้อมูล)
- ระบบบัญชี/ฐานข้อมูล, ตรวจโกงเต็มรูปแบบ (สเตตัสยังอยู่ที่ client)
- ระบบสกิลแบบสุ่มด้วยเงิน + ตั้งสกิลลงแถบ 1-9 (ยังไม่มีสกิลเลย) — ดูแผนใน `PLAN.md`

## Studio (`/studio`) — เครื่องมือ dev แก้ข้อมูลเกม
- รัน `npm start` แล้วดู token ใน terminal (หรือกำหนดเองด้วย `STUDIO_TOKEN=xxxx npm start`) จากนั้นเปิด `http://localhost:3000/studio`
- แก้ได้: **แมพ** (ชื่อ/คำอธิบาย/เลเวลปลดล็อก/ขนาดจัตุรัส/สี/**texture พื้น** 9 แบบ), **วางออบเจกต์** (แท็บ 🌳: คลิกวาง ลากย้าย ปรับขนาด ติ๊ก "ชนได้" — ต้นไม้ บ้าน หิน ฯลฯ), **หน้าจอ UI** (สีธีม HUD + ซ่อน/แสดงมินิแมพ แชท แผงปาร์ตี้ ปุ่มซูม), **มอนสเตอร์** (ชื่อ เลเวล HP ATK DEF EXP + พฤติกรรม ความเร็ว ระยะเห็น ระยะโจมตี ฯลฯ), **การเกิดของมอนสเตอร์** (ชนิด/จำนวน/เวลาเกิดใหม่ต่อแมพ), **ไอเทม**, **เควสต์**, **สกิล** (จดรายชื่อไว้ก่อน ยังไม่ผูกกับเกม)
- กดบันทึก → เขียนไฟล์ `data/overrides.json` + `data/spawns.json` (สำรองไฟล์เก่าไว้ใน `data/backups/` 20 ชุดล่าสุด) แล้วผู้เล่นที่ออนไลน์จะโหลดเกมใหม่เอง
- ค่าตั้งต้นยังอยู่ใน

BossevdK/gamegraph.readme:
# GameGraph

Een persoonlijke game-discovery-app voor Android. GameGraph combineert drie dingen:

1. **Discover Graph**: een interactieve netwerkkaart waarin games nodes zijn en verbindingen concrete overeenkomsten tonen (genre, gameplay, sfeer, ontwikkelaar, speelstijl).
2. **NextGame**: één gamekaart tegelijk; swipe of gebruik de knoppen om te liken, af te wijzen, te bewaren of de details te bekijken.
3. **My GameDNA**: een smaakprofiel (radardiagram) dat leert van je reacties en dat je handmatig kunt bijstellen.

Alles werkt **lokaal en zonder account**. Er is geen backend, geen Steam API-key, geen advertentie en geen verborgen telemetrie.

> **Let op:** de ingebouwde catalogus is een kleine **demo-catalogus** (ongeveer 40 games). Hij is niet compleet of actueel. Prijzen, reviews en screenshots ontbreken bewust; de app toont die nooit verzonnen.

## Schermen

| Scherm | Wat het doet |
| --- | --- |
| Home | Aanbevolen, nieuwe ontdekkingen, recent bekeken |
| Graph | Pan, zoom, tik op een node; detailpaneel met reden van de verbinding; genre-filter; maximaal 60 nodes zodat de kaart leesbaar blijft |
| NextGame | Swipe + knoppen, matchscore alleen bij genoeg gegevens, uitleg waarom, filters op genre/platform/prijs/speelstijl |
| Details | Info, kenmerken, bronvermelding, winkellink, gerelateerde games, beoordeling, favoriet/wishlist |
| Profiel (GameDNA) | Radardiagram, sliders per smaakas, welke feedback meetelt, profiel opnieuw instellen |
| Library | Favorieten, wishlist, beoordeeld, bewaard, afgewezen; zoeken en sorteren |
| Instellingen | Thema, updates, export/import, cache wissen, privacy, diagnostiek, versie-info |

## Architectuur

```
app/src/main/java/nl/gamegraph/app/
  domain/    Pure Kotlin, zonder Android: modellen, overeenkomst, smaakprofiel, aanbevelingen, graph-layout
  data/      Room (database), DataStore (instellingen), GameRepository, SeedCatalog, export/import
  update/    GitHub-updater: releaseparser, download + verificatie, PackageInstaller
  crash/     Globale crashhandler, rapporten, herstelstatus, CrashActivity (eigen proces)
  ui/        Compose: thema, componenten, navigatie, schermen
  AppContainer.kt   Handmatige dependency injection
  AppViewModel.kt   Eén ViewModel dat catalogus, gebruikersdata en profiel combineert
```

Principes:

- **Domeinlogica is deterministisch en testbaar** (`domain/` kent geen Android). Dezelfde invoer geeft altijd dezelfde aanbevelingen en dezelfde graph.
- **Het profiel is afgeleid, niet opgeslagen.** Het wordt berekend uit de huidige staat van elke game (liked, favoriet, rating...) en de handmatige voorkeuren. Daardoor is het idempotent: vaker tikken telt niet dubbel, en terugdraaien werkt. `TasteProfile.apply` werkt incrementeel bij; `TasteProfile.from` bouwt opnieuw op met hetzelfde resultaat.
- **Schrijfacties zijn transacties** (`GameRepository`), zodat een mislukte actie nooit een half resultaat achterlaat.
- **Fouten blijven lokaal.** Gewone fouten (netwerk, opslaan) worden een korte melding of foutstatus in het scherm. Alleen onverwachte, fatale fouten leiden naar de crashpagina.

## Aanbevelingsmodel (versie 1)

Gewogen en uitlegbaar, zonder externe AI. Per game:

| Onderdeel | Gewicht | Betekenis |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Affiniteit | 0,30 | Hoe positief de genres/mechanieken/sferen van de game in je profiel wegen |
| Smaakassen | 0,25 | Afstand tot je voorkeuren (exploratie, gevecht, verhaal, vrijheid, strategie, co-op, moeilijkheid, builds) |
| Lijkt op favorieten | 0,25 | Overeenkomst met games die je leuk vond |
| Ontdekking | 0,20 | Aandeel genres dat je nog niet kent |
| Lijkt op afgewezen | -0,35 | Straf voor games die lijken op wat je afwees |

Eerlijkheid: met minder dan 2 aanwijzingen toont de app *"Nog te weinig gegevens"*; met minder dan 5 een kwalitatief oordeel zonder percentage. Het NextGame-deck is gediversifieerd (geen reeks van hetzelfde genre) en elke vierde kaart is een bewuste ontdekking.

## Documentatie

- [BUILDING.md](BUILDING.md):

# Chess Analysis

A browser chess analysis platform powered by real Stockfish (WebAssembly, in a Web Worker): interactive board, live evaluation, multi-line analysis, full game review, PGN/FEN import/export, variations, opening names and optional Lichess explorer statistics.

## Commands

```bash
npm install          # also copies the Stockfish files from node_modules into public/engine (postinstall)
npm run dev          # dev server, http://localhost:5173
npm test             # unit tests (vitest)
npm run typecheck    # strict TypeScript (TypeScript 7)
npm run lint         # ESLint (typescript-eslint runs on the TS 6 API alias, see below)
npm run build        # typecheck + production build into dist/
npm run preview      # serve dist/ at http://localhost:4173
```

## Tooling notes

- `typescript` in `package.json` is an alias for `@typescript/typescript6` because typescript-eslint does not support TypeScript 7 yet; the real compiler is `@typescript/native` (TS 7), which provides `tsc`. Switch back when typescript-eslint supports it.
- CI (`.github/workflows/ci.yml`): typecheck, lint, tests, and a check that `public/data/lessons.json` is up to date with `data-src/`. `.github/workflows/pages.yml` builds with a relative base and deploys `dist/` to GitHub Pages (enable it once under Settings → Pages → Source: GitHub Actions).

## Engine

- Package: `stockfish` 19 (npm). `scripts/copy-engine.mjs` copies the **lite** builds (`.js` + matching `.wasm`) into `public/engine/`; they are served from your own origin, no CDN.
- Single-threaded lite (~1.8 MB) is the default. The multi-threaded lite build is used only when the page is cross-origin isolated (`COOP: same-origin`, `COEP: require-corp`; the dev and preview servers send these) **and** the machine has ≥3 cores; if it fails to start, the app falls back to the single-threaded build automatically.
- If you host `dist/` yourself, send the two headers above to enable threads; without them everything still works single-threaded.
- Strength (Skill Level / Elo limit), MultiPV, hash, threads, depth/time/infinite are in Settings. Reviews always run at full strength on a second engine instance.
- Newer requests always supersede older ones (stop → wait for `bestmove` → start the latest), and results for another position are never displayed.

## Conventions

- Engines report scores from the side to move; the app converts once (`toWhiteScore`) and shows **White's point of view** everywhere. The eval bar's white part is White's winning-chance share (flips with the board).
- Move classes use the loss of the mover's winning chances (thresholds configurable). Accuracy is an **estimate** adapted from Lichess's published formula, not Chess.com's or Lichess's number.

## Network use

Nothing is required at runtime except static files. The only external call is the **optional** Lichess opening explorer (`explorer.lichess.ovh`), off by default; it may require a Lichess API token (Settings). If it is unreachable the offline opening-name book still works and no numbers are invented. Games and settings are stored in the browser's localStorage only.

## Move grades (Chess.com-style labels)

The review and the move list use ten grades: Brilliant (!!), Great (!), Best, Excellent, Good, Book, Inaccuracy (?!), Mistake (?), Miss and Blunder (??). Chess.com's own algorithm is not public, so the rules are ours and documented in `src/analysis/classify.ts` and in the "How the grades are decided" box of the Review tab: the six base classes (winning-chance loss thresholds) stay the basis for accuracy; on top of them Book = opening-book move with every earlier move also book (Lichess opening database), Brilliant = best/near-best move that leaves you at least 2 points of material down after the exchanges in Stockfish's own line, while not already clearly winning (< 80 %) and not worse afterwards (>= 45 %), Great = Stockfish's best move with the second-best at least 15 winning-chance points worse (needs MultiPV 2, so rev

achallakiran/instant-chess.readme:
# Instant Chess

Chess with a twist: each turn, up to **N** of your pieces move (1 to 16), and the AI does the same.

- **Play it:** open `index.html` in any browser (single self-contained file).
- **Win rules:** king capture, or real checkmate (a check-giving move ends that side's turn).
- **Toggles:** castling, N, auto-move for your other pieces, first-turn cap, AI difficulty (easy/medium/hard).
- En passant is supported; promotion is auto-queen.

## Develop

```
npm install
npm test          # engine + AI tests
npm run typecheck
npm run build     # writes index.html (the game, served by GitHub Pages)
```

Layout: `src/engine` (rules, turn resolver, seeded RNG), `src/ai` (evaluator, auto-mover), `src/ui` (2D board, bundled into one HTML by `build.mjs`). A 3D Babylon.js renderer is planned next.

# Dokumentasi Dinas (Android)

Aplikasi Android native (Kotlin + Jetpack Compose) untuk mencatat dokumentasi lapangan dan laporan kunjungan:
titik GPS + foto, temuan dengan tiga lensa (Aset / Teknis Operasional / Administrasi), ringkasan, tindak lanjut,
lampiran PDF, export Excel (foto tidak terpotong), mode presentasi, dan cadangan terenkripsi.

## Cara membangun APK (tanpa Android Studio)

1. Buat repositori GitHub **privat**, unggah seluruh isi folder ini.
2. Buka tab **Actions** → workflow **Build APK** → tunggu selesai.
3. Unduh artefak **apk** (`app-debug.apk`) dan pasang di HP (izinkan "pasang dari sumber ini").
4. Bila build gagal, unduh/salin log merah dari Actions dan kirim ke Claude untuk diperbaiki.

APK debug cukup untuk pemakaian pribadi. Untuk APK rilis bertanda tangan, buat keystore lalu isi secret repositori:
`KEYSTORE_BASE64`, `KEYSTORE_PASSWORD`, `KEY_ALIAS`, `KEY_PASSWORD`.

## Membangun lokal
Butuh JDK 17 dan Android SDK (platform 36): `./gradlew assembleDebug`. Tes logika: `./gradlew testDebugUnitTest`.

## Struktur
- `domain/` model, parser koordinat, ringkasan (Kotlin murni)
- `security/` enkripsi berkas (AES-GCM berpotongan), Keystore, kunci aplikasi, penyimpanan media
- `data/` Room + SQLCipher, repository, cadangan (ZIP, opsional berkata sandi)
- `export/` penulis .xlsx sendiri (foto, gabung sel, tautan peta)
- `location/`, `media/` GPS, EXIF, pipeline foto, penampil terenkripsi
- `ui/` layar Compose, peta osmdroid (OSM + satelit Esri), tema Klasik/Langit

## Catatan versi
Versi pustaka di `gradle/libs.versions.toml` ditulis dari pengetahuan, belum diuji build. Bila Gradle menolak
satu versi, ganti ke versi stabil terdekat.
